sub_section: Welcome to the unit
original_sentence: Until her baby's old enough to leave the nest.
readingExamples: Until her baby's old enough to leave the nest.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a structure built by birds to hold their eggs and shelter their young
(2) n. a place where insects or small animals live and breed, such as a wasps' nest or a mouse's nest
(3) n. a warm, safe and comfortable home, especially the family home that children eventually leave
(4) vi. to build a nest and live or lay eggs in it

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 鸟窝,巢穴,窝(本义)
uncommonMeanings.example: The eggs lay warm inside the nest. 蛋温暖地卧在巢中。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (昆虫、小动物的)窝,穴(如 a wasps' nest 马蜂窝)
uncommonMeanings.example: They found a mouse's nest behind the wall. 他们在墙后发现一个鼠窝。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 安乐窝;避风港(比喻温暖安全的家)
uncommonMeanings.example: College was calling, yet part of him clung to the familiar nest — the smell of his mother's cooking, the creaky stairs, the quiet certainty of being loved. （读后续写·离家成长·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 筑巢;(鸟)在某处栖息繁殖
uncommonMeanings.example: Every spring, a pair of swallows nested under the eaves of Grandma's house, and their cheerful chirping became the alarm clock of my childhood. （读后续写·童年回忆·环境描写）

posExamples.sentence: Holding her breath, Lucy parted the branches and found the nest — three pale blue eggs lay inside, fragile and perfect, glowing softly in the morning light. （读后续写·自然探索·细节描写）
I am writing to invite you to join our bird-watching club, where members record how birds build nests and raise their young in the campus garden. （应用文·邀请信）
Just as young birds must leave the nest to learn to fly, teenagers need space to make their own decisions — overprotection, however well-intentioned, only delays their flight. （议论文·独立成长·类比论证）
Scientists observed that the rare cranes returned to nest in the restored wetland, powerful proof that years of environmental protection truly pay off. （应用文·调查报告）

wordForms.other: nestling (n. 雏鸟); nestle (v. 依偎,安卧); 复数为 nests; 熟词僻义 leave the nest 表"离家独立"为比喻用法, 需靠语境判断

idioms.translation: 离巢;离开父母独立生活
idioms.example: The day I left the nest for university, Dad said nothing, but at the station he hugged me longer than he ever had before. （读后续写·亲情离别）

idioms.translation: 空巢(子女离家后的家庭)
idioms.example: Facing an empty nest, my parents finally picked up the hobbies they had set aside for twenty years — proof that love also means learning to let go. （读后续写·亲情主题升华）
By saving a small sum every month, Grandpa built up a nest egg that later paid for my first year of college. （读后续写·家庭故事）
The official was widely criticized for feathering his own nest instead of serving the public interest. （议论文·社会诚信）

collocations.translation: 离巢(课文原句词块，比喻孩子长大离家独立)
collocations.example: Until her baby's old enough to leave the nest. 直到她的孩子长大到能够离巢独立。
My parents now live in an empty nest. 我父母如今住在空巢里。
The official feathered his own nest for years. 那名官员多年来中饱私囊。
High in the old oak, two magpies were busy building a nest, weaving twigs together with astonishing patience. （读后续写·自然观察）
The boy climbed down carefully, cupping the fallen bird's nest in both hands as if it were made of glass. （读后续写·善举·动作描写）
Psychologists point out that children who are encouraged to leave the nest at the proper time tend to adapt to society better. （议论文·独立教育）
Warning signs were put up after a wasps' nest was discovered near the playground, and all students are asked to keep clear of the area. （应用文·通知）
Our exchange students will visit the Bird's Nest, the main stadium of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, on the second day of the tour. （应用文·行程安排）
However far the young eagle flies, instinct always tells it where the nest lies — and so it is with us and home. （读后续写·主题升华）
The mother bird spread her wings over the nest, shielding her young from the pouring rain — a scene that instantly reminded me of my own mother. （读后续写·移情联想）

synonyms.example: The fox slipped silently back into its den as the first hunters' footsteps echoed through the forest. （读后续写·紧张氛围）
synonyms.usage: den 指狐狸、熊等兽类的巢穴,也可指人的小书房或匪徒窝点;nest 主要指鸟类、昆虫搭建的巢

synonyms.example: Rabbits dig complex burrows to escape from the cold and from predators. （应用文·科普介绍）
synonyms.usage: burrow 特指动物挖在地下的洞穴,强调'挖'的动作;nest 多为搭在树上或屋檐下的窝

synonyms.example: For the homeless man, the tiny room was more than a shelter; it was the first place in years he could call his own. （读后续写·温情主题）
synonyms.usage: shelter 泛指遮风避雨的处所,可用于人;nest 用于人时是比喻'安乐窝',带温馨色彩

advancedExpressions.expression: leave the nest / an empty nest / a nest egg / feather one's nest
advancedExpressions.example: leave the nest 离巢独立; an empty nest 空巢; a nest egg 储备金; feather one's nest 中饱私囊。（一词多短语，语义各异，靠搭配辨别）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"离家独立"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: leave the nest / leave home / spread one's wings / stand on one's own feet / become independent
advancedExpressions.example: 四种说法均可表"离家独立"：leave the nest 最形象, spread one's wings 强调施展, stand on one's own feet 强调自立。

advancedExpressions.expression: just as young birds must leave the nest, so must we ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as young birds must one day leave the nest, so must we step out of our comfort zone — for wings, like courage, grow only in the open sky. （类比+so must 倒装,结尾点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: encourage sb. to leave the nest and spread their wings
advancedExpressions.example: I strongly suggest that parents attend our lecture on adolescent independence, which offers practical tips on encouraging children to leave the nest and spread their wings with confidence. （比喻增色+定语从句衔接）

advancedExpressions.expression: a nest, however warm, is never meant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A nest, however warm, is never meant to hold a bird forever; likewise, parental care, however loving, should never become a cage. （however 插入让步+likewise 类比论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bird made a nest in the tree.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Twig by twig, straw by straw, the little bird wove its nest into the fork of the old elm, its patience quietly putting my restless heart to shame. （读后续写·细节描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Twig by twig 重复递进造节奏 + wove 精准动词 + its patience putting... 独立主格,由物及人

sentenceUpgrade.original: Children should leave home when they grow up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is widely acknowledged that just as fledglings must eventually leave the nest, young adults ought to embrace independence at the proper time, for it is in facing the world alone that true maturity takes root. （议论文·类比论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is widely acknowledged that 正式开头 + just as 类比 + for it is...that 强调句说理

classPractice.question: 父母应鼓励孩子在适当的时候离巢独立。Parents should encourage their children to ____ ____ ____ at the proper time.
classPractice.note: leave the nest 固定比喻搭配，表"离家独立"，nest 用单数加 the

classPractice.question: 用 nest 的适当形式填空：Every spring, a pair of swallows ____ under the eaves of the old house.
classPractice.note: nest 作不及物动词表"筑巢"；讲述习惯用一般现在时 nest，叙述过去用 nested

classPractice.question: 选词填空(nest/den/burrow)：Rabbits dig complex ____ underground to escape from predators.
classPractice.note: burrow 指兔、鼠在地下挖的洞；nest 多为树上或屋檐下的鸟巢；den 指狐、熊等兽穴

sub_section: Pre-reading
original_sentence: What do you think "strangers under the same roof" means?
readingExamples: What do you think "strangers under the same roof" means?
definitionEn:
(1) n. the structure that covers or forms the top of a building, vehicle, etc.
(2) n. the top part of the inside of your mouth (the roof of the mouth)
(3) n. the highest point or upper surface of something (e.g. the roof of the world)
(4) vt. to cover a building with a roof

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 屋顶,顶部(本义)
uncommonMeanings.example: Rain hammered on the tin roof all night. 雨整夜敲打着铁皮屋顶。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (引申)最高处,上部表面(如 the roof of the world 世界屋脊)
uncommonMeanings.example: Tibet is often called the roof of the world. 西藏常被称为世界屋脊。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上腭(口腔的顶部,the roof of the mouth)
uncommonMeanings.example: The peanut butter stuck to the roof of his mouth, and for one merciful moment the talkative boy fell silent. （读后续写·幽默细节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 给…盖屋顶
uncommonMeanings.example: The villagers worked together to roof the new schoolhouse before the rainy season arrived. （读后续写·互助友爱）

posExamples.sentence: Rain hammered on the tin roof all night, and Emma lay awake, counting the drops and rehearsing the apology she owed her mother. （读后续写·环境烘托心理）
Please note that the school library will be closed this weekend while workers repair the roof damaged in last week's storm; e-books remain available online. （应用文·通知）
True family harmony does not come from merely living under the same roof, but from the willingness to listen, understand and compromise. （议论文·家庭关系·对比论证）
Climbing onto the flat roof, Grandpa and I would watch the summer stars, and it was there, between silence and starlight, that I truly learned to talk to him. （读后续写·祖孙亲情）

wordForms.other: rooftop (n. 屋顶,楼顶); roofing (n. 屋顶材料); 复数为 roofs (以 f 结尾但不变 ves, 属特例, 对比 leaf→leaves)

idioms.idiom: under the same roof / under one roof
idioms.translation: 同住一个屋檐下;在同一处
idioms.example: Living under the same roof does not guarantee understanding; my father and I remained strangers until that snowy night changed everything. （读后续写·亲情破冰）
The charity's goal is simple yet noble: to make sure every child has a roof over their head and a school to go to. （应用文·倡议书）
When Dad saw the scratch on his new car, he hit the roof — but Mum's gentle laughter soon melted his anger away. （读后续写·家庭场景）
After the famous writer recommended the small bookshop online, its sales went through the roof overnight. （读后续写·励志转折）
The moment our team scored the winning goal, the whole gym raised the roof with cheers and thunderous applause. （读后续写·赛场氛围）

collocations.translation: 同住一个屋檐下(课文原句词块)
collocations.example: What do you think "strangers under the same roof" means? 你觉得"同一屋檐下的陌生人"是什么意思？
Every child deserves a roof over their head. 每个孩子都该有栖身之所。
Dad hit the roof when he saw the mess. 爸爸看到一片狼藉时勃然大怒。
The frightened kitten was stuck on the roof, mewing pitifully, until Uncle Li fetched a ladder and climbed up to the rescue. （读后续写·救助动物）
Known as the roof of the world, the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau attracts scientists and adventurers from all over the globe. （应用文·地点介绍）

collocations.phrase: a leaking roof / the roof leaks
collocations.example: I would appreciate it if you could send someone to fix the leaking roof of our dormitory as soon as possible. （应用文·求助信）
As the old saying goes, the wise repair the roof before the rain comes — preparation always defeats panic. （议论文·未雨绸缪）
The ancient town charmed us with its white walls and black tiled roofs mirrored in the quiet canals. （应用文·游记/景物描写）
The student union proposes turning the unused rooftop into a roof garden where students can relax and grow vegetables after class. （应用文·建议信）
We tied the tent firmly to the roof of the car and set off for the lake at dawn, our hearts as light as the morning air. （读后续写·出行叙事）

synonyms.example: Lying on his bed, Tom stared at the ceiling, replaying the argument with his father word by word. （读后续写·心理描写）
synonyms.usage: ceiling 指室内头顶的天花板,也可指数量'上限';roof 指建筑物外部的屋顶

synonyms.example: The bus stop offered little shelter from the driving rain, so we squeezed together under Grandpa's old umbrella. （读后续写·风雨温情）
synonyms.usage: shelter 强调'遮蔽、保护'的功能;roof 表'栖身处'时须用习语 a roof over one's head

advancedExpressions.expression: under the same roof / a roof over one's head / hit the roof / go through the roof / raise the roof
advancedExpressions.example: under the same roof 同一屋檐下; a roof over one's head 栖身之所; hit the roof / go through the roof 勃然大怒; raise the roof 欢声雷动。（同一名词，搭配一变意思全变）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"勃然大怒"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: hit the roof / go through the roof / fly into a rage / lose one's temper / blow up
advancedExpressions.example: 五种说法都表"大怒"：hit the roof / go through the roof 口语生动, fly into a rage 书面, lose one's temper 最中性。

advancedExpressions.expression: rain drummed / hammered on the roof as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rain drummed on the roof as the family sat in silence, each waiting for someone else to say sorry first. （拟声动词+环境烘托僵局）

advancedExpressions.expression: ensure that ... have a roof over their head
advancedExpressions.example: Let us donate what we can spare, so that every quake-stricken family will soon have a roof over their head and hope in their heart. （倡议结尾·roof/hope 对仗呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: living under the same roof does not necessarily mean ...
advancedExpressions.example: Living under the same roof does not necessarily mean living in the same world; genuine communication, not physical closeness, bridges the gap between generations. （否定转折+bridge the gap 隐喻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rain fell on the roof.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: All through the night, the rain tapped a restless rhythm on the roof, as if the sky itself shared the unease that kept me turning in my bed. （读后续写·环境与心理呼应）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: tapped a restless rhythm 拟人 + as if 比拟 + 环境描写与人物心理互相映衬

sentenceUpgrade.original: Family members live under the same roof.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It should be borne in mind that sharing the same roof is merely the beginning of family bonds; it is daily understanding and mutual respect that truly turn a house into a home. （议论文·递进论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It should be borne in mind 正式句式 + it is...that 强调句 + house/home 词义对比点睛

classPractice.question: 同住一个屋檐下并不能保证相互理解。Living ____ the same ____ does not guarantee understanding.
classPractice.note: under the same roof 固定介词搭配，表"同住一处"，介词用 under

classPractice.question: 选词填空(roof/ceiling)：Lying on his bed, Tom stared at the ____ , replaying the argument with his father.
classPractice.note: ceiling 指室内头顶的天花板；roof 指建筑物外部的屋顶，室内向上看用 ceiling

classPractice.question: 用含 roof 的习语填空：When Dad saw the scratch on his new car, he ____ ____ ____ .
classPractice.answer: hit the roof / went through the roof
classPractice.note: hit the roof / go through the roof 均表"勃然大怒"，此处叙述过去用过去式

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle?
readingExamples: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a fight between armed forces, ships or planes, especially during a war
(2) n. a violent argument, or a competition between people or groups striving for power or success
(3) n. a determined effort to solve a difficult problem or overcome something unpleasant (a battle against disease / for survival)
(4) v. to fight or struggle hard against sb/sth; to keep trying in a very difficult situation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】较量,争论(an argument or a competition between people；如 a battle with an insurance company 与保险公司的争执)
uncommonMeanings.example: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle? 你和父母的每顿晚饭是否都好像变成了一场"战斗"？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】战役,战斗(尤指战争期间的一场交战 a fight especially during a war)
uncommonMeanings.example: Many soldiers were killed in the battle of Waterloo. 许多士兵在滑铁卢战役中阵亡。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】奋斗,斗争(a determined effort to solve a difficult problem；the long battle against cancer / a battle for survival)
uncommonMeanings.example: The long battle against cancer requires both courage and patience. 与癌症的长期斗争既需要勇气也需要耐心。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 战斗,战役(军队间的交战)
uncommonMeanings.example: Many soldiers died in the battle. 许多士兵在这场战役中牺牲。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 争吵,激烈较量(比喻，如 turn into a battle)
uncommonMeanings.example: What began as a quiet dinner soon turned into a battle of raised voices. （读后续写·家庭冲突）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 斗争,奋战(a battle against disease/for survival)
uncommonMeanings.example: The battle against procrastination is never won overnight. （议论文·自我管理）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 搏斗,奋力对抗;艰难挣扎
uncommonMeanings.example: Battling against the biting wind, the exhausted runner fixed his eyes on the finish line. （读后续写·体育励志）

posExamples.sentence: What began as a quiet dinner soon turned into a battle of raised voices, and Amy fled upstairs, slamming the door on her parents' unfinished sentences. （读后续写·家庭冲突·动作细节）
Battling against the biting wind, the exhausted runner fixed his eyes on the finish line, telling himself that giving up was the only real failure. （读后续写·体育励志）
This orientation programme is designed to help freshmen win the battle against homesickness through weekly group activities and heart-to-heart talks. （应用文·活动介绍）
The battle against procrastination is never won overnight; it demands clear goals, small steps and, above all, the courage to start right now. （议论文·自我管理·排比论证）

wordForms.other: battlefield (n. 战场); battleground (n. 战场;争论的焦点); battle 名词动词同形; a battle against/with sb-sth (against 更强调对抗, with 侧重双方交锋)

idioms.translation: 打一场必败之仗;徒劳挣扎
idioms.example: Trying to keep the beach clean all by himself, the old man seemed to be fighting a losing battle — until the whole village joined him one Sunday morning. （读后续写·环保·感人转折）

idioms.translation: 成功的一半;最难的部分已完成
idioms.example: As our teacher often reminds us, a calm and confident beginning is half the battle in any examination. （应用文·经验分享）
The chess final was a silent battle of wits, each player reading the other's mind through the smallest movement of a hand. （读后续写·赛场描写）
Every June, millions of candidates do battle with each other for a place at their dream university. （议论文·竞争话题）

collocations.translation: 【课件】演变成一场争吵/较量（课文原句；battle=较量、争论 an argument/competition between people）
collocations.example: Does every dinner with your parents seem to turn into a battle? 你和父母的每顿晚饭是否都好像变成了一场"战斗"？

collocations.translation: 【课件】打仗；战胜/战败（v.+n. 搭配）
collocations.example: Our team fought a hard battle and finally won it. 我们队打了一场硬仗，最终获胜。

collocations.phrase: do battle against / with sb / sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人/某事物进行斗争、较量
collocations.example: Every June, millions of candidates do battle with each other for a place at their dream university. 每年六月，数百万考生为进入理想大学而相互较量。

collocations.translation: 【课件】无望取胜的/激烈的/艰难的仗（adj.+n. 搭配）
collocations.example: Persuading Grandpa to shop online was an uphill battle, but his delighted grin at the parcel made it worthwhile. 说服爷爷网购是一场硬仗，但他见到包裹时开心的笑容让一切都值得。

collocations.translation: 【课件】成功的关键；最难的部分已完成
collocations.example: He never gives in, and that's half the battle. 他从不屈服，这是成功的关键。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与…作斗争（against 更强调对抗，with 侧重双方交锋）
collocations.example: She battled against the disease with unbelievable willpower. 她凭借着惊人的意志力和病魔斗争。
It has been 3 years since they started the legal battle for the copyright. 他们这场为了争夺版权的法律斗争已经持续了三年。

collocations.phrase: be killed in the battle of ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】在…战役中阵亡（battle=战役，尤指战争中的一场战斗）
collocations.example: Thousands of soldiers were killed in the battle of Waterloo. 数千名士兵在滑铁卢战役中阵亡。

collocations.phrase: the long battle against cancer / racism
collocations.translation: 【课件】对抗癌症/种族主义的长期奋斗（battle=为解决难题而进行的持久努力）
collocations.example: He devoted his whole life to the long battle against racism. 他毕生投身于反对种族主义的长期斗争。
She won her battle against illness. 她打赢了与疾病的斗争。
She lost the first battle with her nerves, but that failure taught her how to win the war against stage fright. （读后续写·成长主题）
A heated battle over whether to tear down the old gym broke out at the student council meeting. （应用文·会议报道）
Throughout her battle against illness, Grandma never lost her gentle smile, which taught me more about courage than any book ever could. （读后续写·亲情励志）
For the stranded climbers, the freezing night became a battle for survival that tested both their bodies and their bond. （读后续写·险境互助）
Discussions about screen time often turn into a battle in many families, which could be avoided with a rule made jointly by both sides. （议论文·亲子沟通）
Persuading my tradition-minded grandfather to shop online was an uphill battle, but his delighted grin at the arriving parcel made every effort worthwhile. （读后续写·代际温情）
The two best debate teams will battle it out in the school hall this Friday afternoon — everyone is welcome to come and cheer. （应用文·海报）
The inventor was dragged into a long legal battle over the ownership of his design. （议论文·知识产权·例证）

synonyms.translation: 战争(大规模、长期的整体较量)
synonyms.example: She lost a battle but won the war against her fear. 她输了一仗，却赢得了对抗恐惧的整场"战争"。
synonyms.usage: war 指整体、长期的战争或斗争(可数, a war against poverty); battle 指其中一场具体的战斗/较量; fight 更口语、可指打架, 冲突规模最小

synonyms.example: After years of struggle, the deaf dancer finally stood in the spotlight of the national stage. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: struggle 强调艰难而持续的努力过程;battle 更突出对抗性,常有明确的'对手'(疾病、对手、困难)

synonyms.example: Open communication is the most effective bridge over the conflict between parents and teenagers. （议论文·家庭话题）
synonyms.usage: conflict 指利益或观点相冲突的状态,较正式,可指长期矛盾;battle 指具体的一场争斗或较量

synonyms.example: Their quarrel over a trifle ended with both sisters laughing at how silly they had been. （读后续写·和解）
synonyms.usage: quarrel 指日常口角,程度较轻;battle 表'争吵'时是比喻,冲突更激烈、更具画面感

advancedExpressions.expression: turn into a battle / a battle against / an uphill battle / half the battle / fight a losing battle
advancedExpressions.example: turn into a battle 演变成争斗; a battle against disease 与病抗争; an uphill battle 苦战; half the battle 成功的一半; fight a losing battle 徒劳挣扎。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"与…作斗争"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: battle against / fight against / struggle against / combat / wrestle with
advancedExpressions.example: 均可表"与…斗争"：battle/fight against 通用, struggle against 强调艰难, combat 较正式作动词, wrestle with 强调纠缠费力。

advancedExpressions.expression: what had begun as ... turned into a battle, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: What had begun as a casual chat turned into a battle of words, until Mum's trembling voice suddenly reminded me how deeply my words could wound. （过程推进+转折,标记情感拐点）

advancedExpressions.expression: believe that ... is half the battle
advancedExpressions.example: Please believe that daring to open your mouth is half the battle; our English corner will offer you the friendliest audience possible. （建议信·化用习语增强说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: the battle against ... cannot be won by ... alone; it calls for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The battle against plastic pollution cannot be won by governments alone; it calls for the daily choices of every single consumer. （否定+递进,呼吁共同责任）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I argued with my parents at dinner.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Dinner, once the warmest hour of our day, had quietly become a battlefield where every remark about grades could spark a battle neither side truly wanted. （读后续写·隐喻+今昔对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: once... 同位插入今昔对比 + battlefield/battle 隐喻链 + neither side truly wanted 点破双方心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should fight against pollution.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only when individuals, enterprises and governments join hands can the battle against pollution be transformed from a slogan into a victory. （议论文·倒装呼吁）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only when...can 倒装强调 + 三主体排比 + from a slogan into a victory 对比升华

classPractice.question: 【课件·翻译】他们这场为了争夺版权（copyright）的法律斗争已经持续了三年。It has been 3 years since they started the legal ____ ____ the copyright.
classPractice.note: battle for sth=为争夺…而进行的斗争；for 表"目标/争夺对象"；It has been+时间+since 从句用一般过去时 started（课件原题）

classPractice.question: 【课件·完成句子】她凭借着惊人的意志力和病魔斗争。She ____ ____ the disease with an unbelievable willpower.
classPractice.note: battle against sth=奋力对抗（疾病/困难），against 强调对抗；此处需过去式 battled（课件原题答案：battled against）。注：willpower 为不可数名词，规范写法应为 with unbelievable willpower（课件原题误加 an，此处保留课件原样，考点在 battled against）

classPractice.question: 你和父母的每顿晚饭是否都好像变成了一场"战斗"？Does every dinner with your parents seem to ____ ____ a battle?
classPractice.note: turn into 表"变成"，接名词 a battle；课文原句结构

classPractice.question: 选词填空(battle/war)：She lost a single ____ with her nerves, but eventually won the ____ against stage fright.
classPractice.note: battle 指一次具体较量，war 指整体长期斗争；固定对比 lose a battle but win the war

classPractice.question: Battling ____ the biting wind, the exhausted runner fixed his eyes on the finish line.
classPractice.note: battle against 表"奋力对抗(困难/自然力)"，此处 battle 作现在分词，介词用 against

word: see eye to eye with sb (on sth)
translation: 在某事上与人看法一致
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Do you feel that you just cannot see eye to eye with them on anything?
readingExamples: Do you feel that you just cannot see eye to eye with them on anything?
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to agree with someone about something; to share exactly the same opinion
(2) phr. (usually in negative sentences) to hold a different view from someone, often causing tension or distance

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与某人(在某事上)看法一致,意见相同
uncommonMeanings.example: The two managers finally saw eye to eye on the new plan. 两位经理终于在新方案上看法一致了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (多用于否定)看法不合,意见相左
uncommonMeanings.example: Parents and teenagers may not see eye to eye on everything. （议论文·家庭沟通）

posExamples.sentence: Grandpa and I never saw eye to eye on music — until the evening he heard me play his favourite folk song on my electric guitar, and his stern face softened into a smile. （读后续写·代际和解）
Although we didn't see eye to eye on the theme at first, our group finally reached an agreement through patient discussion, which taught me the true value of listening. （应用文·心得分享）
Parents and teenagers may not see eye to eye on everything, but respecting each other's viewpoint matters far more than winning every argument. （议论文·家庭沟通·让步论证）

wordForms.other: 固定习语, 主体动词 see 随时态/主语变化 (sees / saw / seen); 后跟 with sb 表"与谁", on/about sth 表"在何事上"; 全短语不可拆改, eye 均用单数

collocations.phrase: cannot see eye to eye with sb on anything
collocations.translation: 在任何事上都无法与某人看法一致(课文原句词块)
collocations.example: Do you feel that you just cannot see eye to eye with them on anything? 你是否觉得自己在任何事上都无法和他们看法一致？

collocations.phrase: see eye to eye with sb (on / about sth)
collocations.translation: 在某事上与某人看法一致
collocations.example: I don't see eye to eye with him on this. 在这件事上我和他看法不一致。

collocations.phrase: see eye to eye with sb
collocations.example: It took Jack years to see eye to eye with his father on what success really means. （读后续写·成长感悟）

collocations.phrase: see eye to eye on / about sth
collocations.example: The twins rarely see eye to eye on clothes, yet they always defend each other the moment trouble comes. （读后续写·亲情细节）

collocations.phrase: not / never see eye to eye
collocations.translation: 意见不合(最常见的否定用法)
collocations.example: My desk mate and I don't always see eye to eye, but our differences often spark better ideas for the class project. （应用文·合作感悟）

collocations.phrase: seldom / rarely see eye to eye
collocations.example: Though the two scientists seldom saw eye to eye, their fierce debates kept pushing the research forward. （议论文·分歧的价值·例证）

synonyms.example: I quite agree with you on the necessity of daily exercise, and I would like to add one more suggestion. （应用文·回信）
synonyms.usage: agree with 为中性常用表达,肯定否定皆可, 后接 with sb / on sth;see eye to eye 是习语,多用于否定句,语气更生动形象

synonyms.translation: 看法一致,达成共识(口语)
synonyms.example: Before we hand out the questionnaires, let's make sure everyone is on the same page about our survey goals. （应用文·活动安排）
synonyms.usage: 口语色彩浓,强调对目标或情况'理解一致', 后接 about sth;see eye to eye 强调观点、立场相同

synonyms.example: Most respondents share the same view that reading aloud improves both pronunciation and confidence. （议论文·数据引述）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面表达,常用于议论文引述观点, 后可接 that 从句;see eye to eye 更口语化、更具画面感

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"看法一致"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: see eye to eye with sb / agree with sb / be on the same page / share the same view / be of one mind
advancedExpressions.example: 五种说法都表"看法一致"：see eye to eye 生动多用于否定, agree with 最通用, be on the same page 口语, share the same view 正式书面。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·习语的时态与否定
advancedExpressions.expression: not / never / seldom + see eye to eye + with sb + on sth
advancedExpressions.example: 习语最常用于否定或半否定：cannot see eye to eye / never saw eye to eye / seldom see eye to eye。主体动词 see 需随时态变化(saw / seen)。

advancedExpressions.expression: though they had never seen eye to eye, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though they had never seen eye to eye, father and son now stood shoulder to shoulder, watching the seedlings they had planted together sway in the wind. （eye to eye 与 shoulder to shoulder 呼应,象征和解）

advancedExpressions.expression: even if you cannot see eye to eye on ..., you can still ...
advancedExpressions.example: Even if you cannot see eye to eye with your parents on your career choice, you can still win their support by showing them a well-thought-out plan. （让步+可行建议,典型建议信逻辑）

advancedExpressions.expression: the fact that ... do not see eye to eye is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The fact that generations do not always see eye to eye is not a wall to be feared but a window through which each may glimpse a wider world. （not...but 对比+wall/window 隐喻）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I don't agree with my parents.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On almost everything, from hairstyles to future careers, my parents and I failed to see eye to eye — two generations speaking the same language yet somehow never quite hearing each other. （读后续写·矛盾铺垫）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: from...to... 列举放大矛盾 + 习语 see eye to eye 替换 agree + 破折号后哲理评述

sentenceUpgrade.original: We finally agreed after talking.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only after an honest heart-to-heart talk did we begin to see eye to eye, realizing that beneath our differences lay the same unspoken love. （读后续写·和解升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only after...did 倒装 + heart-to-heart 与 eye to eye 结构呼应 + beneath...lay 倒装点出深层情感

classPractice.question: 你是否觉得自己在任何事上都无法和他们看法一致？Do you feel that you just cannot ____ ____ ____ ____ with them ____ anything?
classPractice.note: see eye to eye with sb on sth 固定习语，eye 用单数，"在某事上"用介词 on；课文原句

classPractice.question: Grandpa and I never agreed with each other on music.(用 see eye to eye 改写)Grandpa and I never ____ ____ ____ ____ on music.
classPractice.note: 习语替换 agree with；注意时态 never 配过去式 saw，主体动词随时态变化

classPractice.question: 尽管这两位科学家很少意见一致，他们激烈的争论却不断推动着研究。(用 seldom see eye to eye)
classPractice.answer: Though the two scientists seldom saw eye to eye, their fierce arguments kept pushing the research forward.
classPractice.note: seldom 为半否定副词，配习语 see eye to eye 表"很少看法一致"，全句用过去时

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Heated arguments and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents.
readingExamples: Heated arguments and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a disagreement or quarrel, especially an angry one, in which people exchange heated words
(2) n. a reason or set of reasons given to support or oppose an idea, action or opinion
(3) n. the act or process of reasoning and debating; discussion based on logic

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】争吵；辩论（have an argument with sb about/over sth；a heated argument）
uncommonMeanings.example: We had an argument with the waiter about/over the bill. 我们和服务员就账单发生了争吵。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】论据,理由（a reason that sb uses to prove sth is true；strong argument for/against sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: We have strong arguments for/in favor of banning high school students from using mobile phones on campus. 我们有强有力的理由支持禁止高中生在校园内使用手机的论点。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 争吵,口角(通常指激烈的)
uncommonMeanings.example: The argument over her test scores ended with a slammed door. （读后续写·冲突余波）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 论点,论据,理由(阅读理解高频考法:the author's argument 指"论点/论证",而非"争吵")
uncommonMeanings.example: The author's central argument — that failure educates more deeply than success — is supported by three striking examples. （议论文·阅读理解视角）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 论证过程,说理;辩论
uncommonMeanings.example: By careful argument, she led the audience step by step to her conclusion. 她凭严密的论证,引导听众一步步走向结论。

posExamples.sentence: The argument over her test scores ended with a slammed door, and in the sudden silence, both mother and daughter regretted the words they could not take back. （读后续写·冲突余波·心理描写）
To avoid unnecessary arguments during the group work, I suggest we set clear rules about task division at the very first meeting. （应用文·建议信）
The strongest argument for keeping our school reading hour is simple: students who read daily write better, think deeper and worry less. （议论文·论证结构）
Halfway through their argument, the lights suddenly went out, and in the darkness Dad's angry voice softened: "Where's your hand? Let me hold it." （读后续写·转折细节·对话描写）

wordForms.adjective: arguable (有争议的); argumentative (好争辩的)
wordForms.other: argue that + 从句 (主张…); argue with sb about/over sth (与某人争论); 注意拼写 argument 中 argue 去 e 加 ment, 无 e (易错点!)

idioms.translation: 为了便于讨论;姑且假定
idioms.example: Let's assume, for the sake of argument, that every student owns a smartphone — should classroom use still be banned? （议论文·假设论证）
That exercise benefits both body and mind is beyond argument; the real question is how to make it a daily habit. （议论文·让步递进）

collocations.translation: 【课件】激烈的争吵、辩论（课文原句词块；青少年与父母之间常见）
collocations.example: Heated arguments and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents. 激烈的争吵和冷漠的沉默在青少年和父母之间很常见。

collocations.phrase: have an argument with sb about / over sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】和某人就某事发生争吵
collocations.example: We had an argument with the waiter about/over the bill. 我们和服务员就账单发生了争吵。

collocations.phrase: get into an argument with sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】和某人吵起来，陷入争吵
collocations.example: He often gets into an argument with his neighbors, and now they do not even bother to talk with him. 他经常和邻居吵架，现在他们甚至懒得和他说话。
A chimpanzee can't win an argument with a modern man, but it can tear the man apart like a rag doll. 一只黑猩猩和一个现代人辩论会输，但是它可以把人像破布娃娃一样撕碎。
A single careless remark started an argument between the two old friends. 一句不经意的话引起了两位老友之间的争论。

collocations.phrase: a huge / heated / fierce / violent argument breaks out
collocations.translation: 【课件】一场大的/激烈的/猛烈的/暴力的争吵爆发（adj.+n. 搭配）
collocations.example: A heated argument breaks out between the two parties. 双方爆发了一场激烈的争吵。

collocations.phrase: a strong / powerful argument for / in favor of sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】支持某事的有力论据、论点（argument=论据、理由）
collocations.example: We have strong arguments for/in favor of banning high school students from using mobile phones on campus. 我们有强有力的理由支持禁止高中生在校园内使用手机的论点。
An argument against television is that it replaces reading as a form of entertainment. 一个反对电视的论点是，它取代了阅读这种娱乐方式。

collocations.phrase: a strong argument for / against sth
collocations.translation: 支持/反对某事的有力论点
collocations.example: There is a strong argument for daily reading. 每天阅读有一个有力的理由。
In her prize-winning speech, Lily put forward a convincing argument that failure is not the opposite of success but part of it. （应用文·活动报道）
The most convincing argument for volunteering is the growth it brings to the volunteers themselves. （议论文·观点句）
A single faded photograph settled the argument: there stood Grandpa, young and proud, beside the very bridge he claimed to have built. （读后续写·悬念揭晓）
Taking a deep breath before replying is a simple but surprisingly effective way to avoid an argument. （应用文·建议信）

synonyms.example: Their quarrel over the remote control seemed utterly childish the moment the power went off. （读后续写·幽默）
synonyms.usage: quarrel 指因琐事而起、感情色彩强的口角, 常 quarrel with sb about sth;argument 既可指争吵,也可指说理的'论点、论证',使用范围更广

synonyms.example: After a lively class debate on AI, we voted on whether robots should ever be allowed to grade our essays. （应用文·活动报道）
synonyms.usage: debate 指有组织、有规则的正式辩论或公众讨论, a debate on/over sth;argument 侧重个人之间的争执或单个论点

synonyms.example: The long-standing dispute between the two neighbours ended when a flood forced them to rescue each other's furniture. （读后续写·邻里和解）
synonyms.usage: dispute 较正式,常指持续较久的分歧(劳资、领土等), a dispute between/over;argument 多指一次性的争吵或论证

synonyms.example: The couple next door had a terrible row last night, yet this morning they were planting roses together as if nothing had happened. （读后续写·生活观察）
synonyms.usage: row /raʊ/ 为英式口语,指嗓门很大的争吵, have a row with sb;argument 书面口语皆宜,最为通用

advancedExpressions.expression: argue (v.) → argument (n.) → arguable (adj.) → arguably (adv.) → argumentative (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: 动词 argue 争论; 名词 argument 争论/论点(去 e 加 ment); 形容词 arguable 有争议的 / argumentative 好争辩的; 副词 arguably 可以说。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"争吵"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: have an argument / have a quarrel / have a row / fall out with sb / get into a dispute
advancedExpressions.example: 均可表"发生争吵"：have an argument 最通用, have a quarrel 因琐事, have a row 英式口语, fall out with sb 闹翻。

advancedExpressions.expression: an argument was brewing / the argument died down when ...
advancedExpressions.example: An argument was brewing over the map when the first raindrops hit the tent, instantly uniting the quarrelling campers against a common enemy. （brewing 隐喻酝酿+借外部事件化解冲突的叙事技巧）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than getting into arguments, it would be wiser to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than getting into endless arguments with your parents about screen time, it would be wiser to draw up a schedule together and stick to it. （rather than 对比+可操作建议）

advancedExpressions.expression: a further argument in favour of ... is that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A further argument in favour of campus recycling is that it turns abstract environmental slogans into daily, doable actions. （论点递进衔接语,段落展开利器）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We had an argument and I was sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The argument left a ringing silence between us, and I sat on the stairs, hugging my knees, replaying every sharp word I wished I could swallow back. （读后续写·冲突后心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: ringing silence 矛盾修辞 + hugging my knees 动作外化情绪 + replaying...wished I could swallow back 心理细节

sentenceUpgrade.original: There are many arguments for reading.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The arguments in favour of reading are as numerous as they are compelling: it sharpens the mind, softens the heart, and quietly widens the boundaries of our world. （议论文·排比论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as numerous as they are compelling 平行强调 + 冒号引出三动词排比(sharpens/softens/widens) + quietly 副词点睛

classPractice.question: 【课件·完成句子】一个反对电视的论点是它取代了阅读这种娱乐方式。____ ____ ____ television is that it replaces reading as a form of entertainment.
classPractice.note: an argument against sth=反对某事的论据；against 表"反对"；主语首字母大写（课件原题答案：An argument against）

classPractice.question: 【课件·完成句子】一只黑猩猩和一个现代人辩论会输，但是它可以把人像破布娃娃一样撕碎。A chimpanzee can't ____ ____ ____ ____ a modern man, but it can tear the man apart like a rag doll.
classPractice.note: win an argument with sb=赢得与某人的争论；此处 can't win an argument with=辩论会输；介词固定 with（课件原题答案：win an argument with）

classPractice.question: Heated ____ (argue) and cold silences are common between teenagers and their parents.
classPractice.note: argue 的名词是 argument(去 e 加 ment)，此处作主语需用名词复数；课文原句

classPractice.question: 用 argument 或 argue 的适当形式填空：I had a heated ____ with my best friend over a misunderstanding.
classPractice.note: have a heated argument with sb over sth 固定搭配，have 后接名词 argument

classPractice.question: 选词填空(argument/debate)：The most convincing ____ for volunteering is the growth it brings to the volunteers themselves.
classPractice.note: 此处指"论点、论据"，用 argument(argument for sth)；debate 指有组织的正式辩论

sub_section: Pre-reading
original_sentence: What physical and mental changes do you experience as you become a teenager?
readingExamples: What physical and mental changes do you experience as you become a teenager?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person between the ages of 13 and 19
(2) n. a young person going through the transition from childhood to adulthood; an adolescent

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 青少年(13至19岁的人,词根含 -teen 的年龄)
uncommonMeanings.example: Like most teenagers, Kevin wore his headphones as armour. （读后续写·青春孤独）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 处于从童年向成年过渡期的年轻人;青春期少年
uncommonMeanings.example: Teenagers need both freedom and guidance as they grow. 青少年在成长中既需要自由也需要引导。

posExamples.sentence: Like most teenagers, Kevin wore his headphones as armour, until the new deskmate's shy "hello" made him take them off for the first time in months. （读后续写·青春孤独与破冰）
Our radio station is launching a new programme called Teen Voice, which invites teenagers to share their campus stories and growing pains in English. （应用文·招募启事）
Teenagers are often accused of being addicted to screens, yet few people pause to ask what the real world has failed to offer them. （议论文·辩证思考）
The volunteers, mostly teenagers themselves, knew exactly how to make the nervous freshmen laugh within minutes. （读后续写·校园互助）

wordForms.noun: teen (n. 青少年,非正式); teens (n. 十几岁的年纪)
wordForms.adjective: teenage / teenaged (十几岁的,青少年的)
wordForms.other: in one's teens (在某人十几岁时); 构词 -teen: teen + age + er, 指 thirteen 到 nineteen 这些以 -teen 结尾数字对应的年龄段; teenage 只作定语(a teenage boy), 不作表语

collocations.translation: 步入青少年时期(课文原句词块)

As a teenager, Grandma walked two hours to school every day — a story she tells not for sympathy, but to show how fiercely she treasured learning. （读后续写·家史励志）
A typical teenager checks his phone dozens of times a day, which makes our "digital detox" weekend all the more worthwhile. （应用文·活动倡议）
Many scientists trace their lifelong passion back to a single experiment done in their teens. （议论文·例证）
The exhibition, made up of old photos and diaries, records the teenage years of students from the 1980s to today. （应用文·展览介绍）

synonyms.translation: 青少年(正式,常见于研究报告)
synonyms.example: The report notes that adolescents need at least eight hours of sleep to support their fast-developing brains. （议论文·引用研究）

synonyms.example: The city has opened three new sports centres to enrich the after-school life of its youth. （应用文·新闻报道）
synonyms.usage: youth 可作集合名词泛指年轻人(不可数), 或抽象指'青春';teenager 特指 13-19 岁的个体, 可数

synonyms.translation: 年轻人,孩子(口语,带亲切感)
synonyms.example: The old coach treats every youngster on the team as if he or she were a future champion. （读后续写·温情人物）
synonyms.usage: youngster 口语化,多为长辈口吻,范围比 teenager 宽,可包括儿童;teenager 年龄界定明确

advancedExpressions.expression: teen / teens / teenage / teenaged / teenager / in one's teens

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"青少年"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: teenager / adolescent / youngster / young people / a young person in their teens

advancedExpressions.expression: like most teenagers, sb. ..., but / until ...

advancedExpressions.expression: as teenagers shouldering tomorrow's responsibilities, we ...

advancedExpressions.expression: while teenagers are often ..., it is unfair to ...
advancedExpressions.example: While teenagers are often portrayed as impulsive, it is unfair to overlook the creativity and courage with which they embrace new ideas. （while 让步+对比反驳,树立辩证形象）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Teenagers often argue with their parents.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Caught between a child's need for care and an adult's hunger for freedom, teenagers often find themselves at war with the very people who love them most. （读后续写·矛盾刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Caught between... 过去分词短语开头 + care/freedom 对比 + at war with the very people 反差修辞

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should understand teenagers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only by remembering that every adult was once a teenager can society replace hasty judgement with genuine understanding. （议论文·倒装呼吁）

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: Teenagers' physical changes may result in such family tensions.
readingExamples: Teenagers' physical changes may result in such family tensions.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a feeling of nervousness or worry that makes it impossible to relax
(2) n. (often tensions) a situation in which people, groups or countries disagree with and feel anger towards each other
(3) n. the state of being stretched tight, or the degree to which sth such as a rope or muscle is stretched
(4) n. a balance between two opposing forces, ideas or demands that exist at the same time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】(常用复数 tensions)紧张关系/局势(a situation in which people, groups or countries disagree；international/political tensions；family tensions)
uncommonMeanings.example: Teenagers' physical changes may result in such family tensions. 青少年的身体变化可能导致这样的家庭紧张关系。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】精神紧张,焦虑(un. a feeling of anxiety and stress；nervous tension；ease the tension)
uncommonMeanings.example: We can feel the tension in the hall as the final result is to be announced. 最终结果即将揭晓，我们能感受到大厅里的紧张气氛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 紧张,焦虑(令人无法放松的情绪)
uncommonMeanings.example: The tension inside the vehicle grew so heavy that even my little sister stared silently out of the window. （读后续写·家庭冲突）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (绳索、肌肉等的)张力,拉紧状态
uncommonMeanings.example: He tested the tension of the climbing rope one last time, his knuckles white, before lowering himself over the cliff edge into the roaring dark. （读后续写·悬崖救援·动作细节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (两种对立需求或观点之间的)矛盾,对立
uncommonMeanings.example: There has always been a tension between what teenagers desperately want and what their parents firmly believe is good for them. （议论文·代际话题）

posExamples.sentence: The moment Dad slammed the car door, the tension inside the vehicle grew so heavy that even my little sister, usually a chatterbox, stared silently out of the window, not daring to breathe a word. （读后续写·家庭冲突·环境烘托）

I am writing to suggest that our school set up a weekly counselling session, where students under academic tension can pour out their worries to professional psychologists and regain their inner peace. （应用文·建议信）

It is my firm belief that honest communication, rather than cold silence, serves as the most effective medicine for easing the tension that inevitably arises between parents and their teenage children. （议论文·亲子沟通）
As the referee raised the whistle to his lips, tension rippled through the stadium; thousands of eyes fixed on Li Hua, who bounced the ball slowly, steadying his thundering heart. （读后续写·赛场时刻·心理描写）

wordForms.other: 表"人际/群体紧张关系"义时常用复数 tensions(如 family tensions, ease tensions); tense 既作形容词(a tense moment)也作动词(tense up); 拼写注意 -sion 结尾

idioms.idiom: the tension is so thick you could cut it with a knife
idioms.translation: 气氛紧张得几乎凝固(可感可触)
idioms.example: When the exam results were handed out, the tension in the classroom was so thick you could cut it with a knife — fifty heads bowed, fifty hearts pounding. （读后续写·考场氛围·夸张）

collocations.translation: 【课件】家庭矛盾、家庭紧张关系（课文原句词块；表"紧张关系"义常用复数）
collocations.example: Teenagers' physical changes may result in such family tensions. 青少年的身体变化可能导致这样的家庭矛盾。

collocations.translation: 【课件】国际/政治紧张局势（tension 表"紧张关系/局势"义时常用复数）
collocations.example: The talks were held against a background of rising international tensions. 会谈是在国际紧张局势加剧的背景下举行的。

collocations.translation: 【课件】精神紧张（un. a feeling of anxiety and stress）
collocations.example: Deep breathing can help to relieve nervous tension before an exam. 考前深呼吸有助于缓解精神紧张。

collocations.translation: 【课件】缓和紧张情绪、缓解紧张气氛
collocations.example: He changed the topic in order to ease the tension in the conversation. 他转换了话题，以缓和谈话的紧张气氛。
We can feel the tension in the hall as the final result is to be announced. 最终结果即将揭晓，我们能感受到大厅里的紧张气氛。
A joke from Grandma eased the tension. 奶奶的一句玩笑缓解了紧张气氛。
There is tension between study and rest. 学习与休息之间存在张力。
With each passing minute of the rescue, the mounting tension made the onlookers hold their breath, their eyes glued to the trembling ladder. （读后续写·救援现场）
Psychologists point out that comparing children with 'other people's kids' is one of the quickest ways to create tension at home. （议论文·家庭教育）
Taking a deep breath, she rolled her shoulders to release the tension that had been building up since the morning announcement. （读后续写·考前减压）
As the deadline drew near, tension built steadily in the newsroom, where reporters typed furiously under the cold glare of screens. （读后续写·工作场景）
The negotiation, full of tension at the beginning, ended unexpectedly in laughter and a warm handshake. （应用文·活动报道）

synonyms.example: Faced with mounting academic stress, many students have turned to jogging as a way to clear their minds. （议论文·减压方式）
synonyms.usage: stress 侧重外部压力对身心造成的负担,多与学习工作连用(under stress);tension 更强调紧绷、对立的状态,还可指人与人之间的紧张关系

synonyms.example: The long months of caring for his sick grandfather put a visible strain on Wang Lei, yet he never once complained. （读后续写·亲情担当）
synonyms.usage: strain 强调长期负荷带来的消耗,身体或关系被'拉扯到极限'(put a strain on);tension 偏向一触即发的紧张气氛

synonyms.example: Minor friction between roommates is unavoidable, but mutual understanding can always smooth it away. （议论文·宿舍关系）
synonyms.usage: friction 专指人际相处中的摩擦冲突,程度较轻(friction between);tension 可指尚未爆发、悬在空气中的紧张

advancedExpressions.expression: tense (adj./v.) → tension (n.) → tensely (adv.) → tenseness (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: 形容词/动词 tense 紧张的/绷紧; 名词 tension 紧张(关系)/张力; 副词 tensely 紧张地。人际紧张义多用复数 tensions。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"缓解紧张"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: ease / relieve / reduce / release / defuse the tension
advancedExpressions.example: 均可表"缓解紧张"：ease/relieve/reduce tension 通用, release the tension 释放情绪, defuse the tension 化解一触即发的紧张。

advancedExpressions.expression: the tension hanging in the air was almost touchable, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: The tension hanging in the air was almost touchable, until Mum reached across the table and covered my trembling hand with hers. （抽象情绪具象化+转折破局,续写高潮段常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: to ease the tension between ..., I would recommend that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To ease the tension between heavy schoolwork and personal interests, I would recommend that the school reserve every Friday afternoon for club activities. （先摆问题再给方案的委婉建议句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath the apparent tension between A and B lies ...
advancedExpressions.example: Beneath the apparent tension between tradition and innovation lies a simple truth: the former provides roots while the latter gives wings. （先立矛盾再揭本质,适合分论点展开）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was tension between me and my father.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: An invisible wall of tension stood between my father and me — every dinner passed in silence, every 'How was school?' died on his lips before it could reach me. （读后续写·家庭隔阂·细节具象化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词具象化(invisible wall) + 平行细节(every dinner..., every 'How was school?'...) + 拟人(died on his lips)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should reduce the tension between parents and children.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Only when both generations learn to listen — truly listen, with patience rather than judgement — can the long-standing tension between parents and children give way to genuine mutual understanding. （议论文·结尾升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Only when...部分倒装 + 破折号插入强调(truly listen) + give way to 高级替换 reduce

classPractice.question: 【课件·完成句子】他转换了话题，以缓和谈话的紧张气氛。He changed the topic in order to ____ ____ ____ in the conversation.
classPractice.note: ease the tension=缓和紧张（气氛/情绪）；此处 in order to 后接动词原形 ease（课件原题答案：ease the tension）

classPractice.question: 【课件·填空】The atmosphere of the discussion is becoming much ____ (tense) than before.
classPractice.note: much than 提示比较级；tense 单音节形容词比较级 tenser（课件原题答案：tenser）

classPractice.question: 【课件·填空】Faced with ____ (tense) between family members, we should try to ease them rather than ignore them.
classPractice.note: 介词 with 后需名词，表"（人际间的）紧张关系"用复数 tensions；后文 them 也提示复数（课件原题答案：tensions）

classPractice.question: Teenagers' physical changes may result in such family ____ (tension).
classPractice.note: 表"家庭紧张关系/矛盾"时 tension 常用复数 tensions；课文原句

classPractice.question: 用 tense 的适当形式填空：A gentle joke from Grandma instantly ____ (缓解) the ____ at the dinner table.
classPractice.note: ease the tension 缓解紧张，动词 ease 过去式 eased；名词填 tension

classPractice.question: 选词填空(tension/stress)：Faced with mounting academic ____ , many students have turned to jogging to clear their minds.
classPractice.note: academic stress 学业压力，stress 侧重学习工作带来的负担；tension 侧重紧绷对立状态或人际紧张

translation: 忧虑的，担心的；令人焦虑的；渴望的
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
readingExamples: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. feeling worried or nervous, especially about sth that is going to happen
(2) adj. causing worry; full of anxiety (an anxious wait / moment)
(3) adj. wanting sth very much, especially when it may not happen; eager (anxious to do sth / anxious for sth)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】担心的，忧虑的，焦虑的（feeling worry/nervousness/unease；be anxious about sth / for sb / that…，课文本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends. 你可能担心自己发育和朋友不同步。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】热切的，渴望的（be very eager；be anxious to do / for sth = long for；anxious that sb should do 从句常用虚拟语气）
uncommonMeanings.example: She was anxious to finish school and get a job. = She was anxious that she should finish school and get a job. 她渴望完成学业、找份工作。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】令人焦虑的，充满忧虑的（修饰时刻、等待等；an anxious moment/wait）
uncommonMeanings.example: There were a few anxious moments in the baseball game. 那场棒球赛中有些时刻令人焦虑不安。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 忧虑的，担心的（be anxious about / that，课文本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends. 你可能担心自己发育和朋友不同步。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 渴望的，急切的（anxious to do / anxious for sth，高考高频僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Anxious to prove that she was no longer the timid girl everyone remembered, Amy volunteered to give the opening speech. （读后续写·人物成长·动机交代）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 令人焦虑的，充满忧虑的（修饰时刻、等待等）
uncommonMeanings.example: There followed an anxious wait outside the operating room. 手术室外是一段令人揪心的等待。

posExamples.sentence: Hearing the footsteps pause outside her door, Lucy pressed the acceptance letter to her chest, her anxious eyes darting between the window and the doorknob. （读后续写·紧张时刻·目光描写）
I fully understand that you feel anxious about the coming entrance examination, but please believe that steady daily effort will eventually turn your nervousness into confidence. （应用文·安慰建议信）
In an age flooded with information, many young people grow anxious simply because they keep measuring their own lives against the carefully polished photos of others. （议论文·社交媒体与焦虑）
The scientists were anxious for the storm to pass, for the delicate instruments on the mountaintop could record the rare eclipse only under a clear sky. （读后续写·科考场景·渴望义）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：anxious(adj.)-anxiety(n.,注意ei拼写)-anxiously(adv.)。辨析记忆：be anxious ABOUT=担心，be anxious TO DO / FOR=渴望，介词/结构决定词义。名词短语 a wave of anxiety 一阵焦虑。

collocations.translation: 【课件】为……担心、焦虑（接名词/动名词，表"担心"，有不确定结果的事）
collocations.example: She seemed anxious about the exam. 她似乎对考试感到担心。

collocations.translation: 【课件】担心……（课文原句词块；that 从句表担忧内容）
collocations.example: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends. 你可能会担心自己发育的速度和朋友不一样。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为某人担忧；渴望得到某物（for 后接人=担忧，接物=渴望）
collocations.example: Parents are naturally anxious for their children. 父母天然地为孩子担忧。

collocations.translation: 【课件】渴望、急切地做某事（表"渴望"，= long for，不是担心）
collocations.example: She was anxious to finish school and get a job. 她渴望完成学业、找份工作。

collocations.phrase: be anxious for sth (= long for sth)
collocations.translation: 【课件】渴望得到某物（anxious for = long for，热切盼望）
collocations.example: She was anxious for her parents' understanding. 她渴望得到父母的理解。

collocations.phrase: be anxious that sb (should) do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】渴望/一心希望某人做某事（that 从句中常用虚拟语气 should + 动词原形，should 可省略）
collocations.example: My parents were anxious that I (should) get an education. 我父母一心希望我能受到教育。

collocations.translation: 【课件】令人焦虑不安的时刻/等待（anxious 表"令人焦虑的"）
collocations.example: There were a few anxious moments in the baseball game. 那场棒球赛中有些时刻令人焦虑不安。
Millions of parents feel anxious about their children's screen time, yet few set a good example themselves. （议论文·家庭教育）
Mum shot me an anxious glance in the rear-view mirror, but said nothing, letting the hum of the engine fill the silence. （读后续写·车内场景·无声胜有声）
As the clock ticked towards midnight with no sign of the rescue team, the trapped hikers grew increasingly anxious. （读后续写·野外困境）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】热切的，渴望的（对应 anxious 表"渴望"义，= long for）
synonyms.example: She was anxious/eager to finish school and get a job. 她渴望完成学业、找份工作。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：eager 是纯积极的期待，不含忧虑；anxious to do 是"急切中带着担心"。anxious for sth 表"渴望"时可与 long for 互换。句法：eager to do sth / eager for sth。

synonyms.translation: 【课件】渴望，盼望（= be anxious for sth）
synonyms.example: She was anxious for / longed for her parents' understanding. 她渴望得到父母的理解。
synonyms.usage: long for sth / long to do sth 表强烈盼望，与 be anxious for sth（渴望义）功能相同；区别于 be anxious about（担心）。

synonyms.example: She felt nervous before stepping onto the stage. 上台前她感到紧张。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：nervous 侧重面临具体事件（考试、演讲）时的"临场紧张"，程度可轻可重；anxious 更强调对未来不确定后果的"持续忧虑"。句法：be nervous about sth / be nervous of doing。

synonyms.example: Seeing the worried expression on my deskmate's face, I slipped her an encouraging note. （读后续写·同窗情谊）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：worried 是最通用的"担心"，程度中性；anxious 焦虑感更强、常伴坐立不安的生理反应，且另有"渴望"僻义。句法：be worried about sth / worried that 从句。

synonyms.example: An uneasy silence settled over the campsite as the wind carried in the first low growl of thunder. （读后续写·风暴前夕）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：uneasy 指隐隐的、说不清缘由的心神不宁，程度轻于 anxious。句法：feel uneasy about sth，多作表语。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·anxious 后接结构辨析（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】be anxious about sth（担心）｜be anxious for sb（为某人担忧）｜be anxious to do sth / for sth（渴望，= long for）｜be anxious that sb (should) do（渴望，从句用虚拟语气 should）
advancedExpressions.example: She was anxious about the exam（担心考试）; She was anxious to finish school（渴望毕业）; My parents were anxious that I (should) get an education（一心希望我受教育）。about 表担心，to do / for 表渴望，that 从句常用虚拟 should。

advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】anxious (adj. 担心的/令人焦虑的/渴望的) → anxiously (adv. 焦急地;急切地) → anxiety (n. 焦虑;担心;渴望)
advancedExpressions.example: He waited anxiously for the result, his heart full of anxiety. 他焦急地等待结果，内心充满焦虑。(with anxiety 焦急地)

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·anxious 后接结构辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: be anxious about sth（担心）｜be anxious to do / for sth（渴望）｜anxious that + 从句（担心，从句可用虚拟 should）
advancedExpressions.example: I'm anxious about the result（担心结果）; I'm anxious to hear the result（急于知道结果）。同一个词，about 表担心、to do 表渴望，务必看结构定义。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表达"担心"（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be anxious about ｜ be worried about ｜ be concerned about ｜ feel uneasy about
advancedExpressions.example: 写作中表"担心某事"可在这四者间替换升级：I'm worried about → I'm deeply concerned about the issue.（四者均+about+名词/动名词）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of anxiety washed over sb., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wave of anxiety washed over me as the curtain rose, but the warm glow of the stage lights felt strangely like courage. （情绪具象化为"浪潮"+转折，续写心理刻画）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is perfectly natural to feel anxious when ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is perfectly natural to feel anxious when standing at the crossroads of life, yet remember that every expert was once a beginner. （先共情再劝慰，安慰信黄金句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: much of the anxiety over ... stems not from ... but from ...
advancedExpressions.example: Much of the anxiety over exams stems not from the tests themselves but from our habit of equating one score with our entire worth. （not...but...对比归因，深化分析）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was very anxious before the competition.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Backstage, anxiety gnawed at me like a restless mouse — my palms grew damp, my mouth dry, and the lines I had recited a hundred times suddenly scattered like startled birds. （读后续写·赛前心理·多重感官）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟物比喻(gnawed like a restless mouse) + 生理细节排比(palms damp, mouth dry) + 比喻收尾(scattered like startled birds)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Don't be anxious about your future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than allowing anxiety about an uncertain future to paralyse the present, we would be well advised to pour our energy into what lies within our control — today's effort. （议论文·正式劝诫）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 对比开头 + 形容词名词化(anxious→anxiety) + we would be well advised to 正式建议句式

classPractice.question: 【课件·翻译】我们为你担心。We ____ ____ ____ you.
classPractice.note: be anxious for sb=为某人担忧（for 后接人表担忧）；此处主句用过去时 were（课件原题答案：were anxious for）

classPractice.question: 【课件·翻译】他非常希望不会出现延误。____ ____ ____ ____ there should be no delay.
classPractice.note: be anxious that…(should) do=渴望/一心希望……，从句用虚拟语气 should be；此处 should 保留（课件原题答案：He is anxious that，从句 there should be no delay）

classPractice.question: 【课件·翻译】我们都在焦急地等待消息。We ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: be anxious for sth=渴望得到某物，for news=急切盼望消息；all 放在系动词 were 之后；主句过去时（课件原题答案：were all anxious for news）

classPractice.question: Anxious ____ (prove) herself capable, Amy volunteered to give the opening speech at the ceremony.
classPractice.note: be anxious to do sth=渴望做某事；此处作原因状语，用不定式表"急于"。

classPractice.question: You may feel anxious ____ you are developing at a different rate to your friends. (about / to / that)
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：anxious that+从句表"担心……"；若接名词/动名词则用 about。

classPractice.question: 把"许多家长为孩子的屏幕时间感到焦虑"译成英文（用 anxious）。
classPractice.answer: Many parents feel anxious about their children's screen time.
classPractice.note: "担心某事"用 be/feel anxious about+名词，区别于表"渴望"的 anxious to do。

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
readingExamples: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the speed at which sth happens or changes over a period of time
(2) n. the number of times sth happens, or the number of examples of sth, within a certain period (the birth / unemployment rate)
(3) n. a fixed amount of money that is charged or paid for sth (exchange / interest rates)
(4) v. to have or give an opinion about the value or quality of sb/sth; to place sb/sth at a particular level on a scale

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 速度（单位时间内变化的快慢，课文本义，at a rate/at a different rate）
uncommonMeanings.example: You are developing at a different rate to your friends. 你发育的速度和朋友不一样。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 率，比率（发生频次，如 birth/success/unemployment rate）
uncommonMeanings.example: The success rate of the surgery is very high. 这项手术的成功率很高。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 费用，价格，费率（常用复数，如 postal rates 邮资，special rates 优惠价）
uncommonMeanings.example: The guesthouse offers special rates for students. 这家旅馆为学生提供优惠价。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 评价，评为；给……评级（高考高频僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The hand-made mooncakes were rated the most popular item. 手工月饼被评为最受欢迎的商品。

posExamples.sentence: The wildfire was spreading at an alarming rate, and through the choking smoke Jack could just make out the old man struggling with his frightened horse. （读后续写·火灾救援·紧迫感）
According to our survey, the participation rate in after-class sports has risen from 40% to nearly 75% since the new playground opened last autumn. （应用文·调查报告）
Statistics show that the recycling rate in our city has doubled over the past five years — solid proof that individual efforts, however small, add up to visible change. （议论文·环保·数据论证）
Critics may rate the film differently, but few can deny that it captures the quiet heroism of ordinary people in extraordinary times. （议论文·评价义）

wordForms.other: 构词法：first-rate(adj.一流的)、second-rate(adj.二流的)、third-rate(adj.三流的)由"序数词+rate"合成，作定语。派生 rating(评级/收视率)。易混：rate(比率/评价) ≠ ratio(比例，读/ˈreɪʃiəʊ/)。熟词僻义短语 at any rate=无论如何，at this rate=照这样下去。

idioms.translation: 无论如何；至少（熟词僻义，高考爱考）
idioms.example: The trip did not go as planned; at any rate, we returned home safe and with stories to tell for years. （读后续写·结尾自我宽慰）
At this rate, the little bookshop at the corner will have to close before winter, which is why I am calling on every book lover to pay it a visit. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.example: The population is growing at a rate of two percent a year. 人口以每年百分之二的速度增长。（课件搭配）
Eva finished the project at an alarming rate. Eva以惊人的速度完成了该项目。（课件原句）
The car is going at an average rate of 80 km an hour. 这辆车的平均速度为每小时80公里。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】无论如何；至少（熟词僻义 idiom）
collocations.example: I may be away on business next week but at any rate I'll be back by Friday. 下周我可能出差，但无论如何我周五之前会回来。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】高/低/不断增长的出生率
collocations.example: A high birth rate puts pressure on public services. 高出生率给公共服务带来压力。
The success rate of the operation is very high. 这项手术的成功率很高。
The exchange rate changes every day. 汇率每天都在变。

collocations.translation: 【课件】特惠价格（rate=a fixed amount of money 价格，费用）
collocations.example: We offer special reduced rates for students. 我们对学生有特惠价格。（课件原句）
Teachers rate Chris highly for her sense of responsibility. 老师们因克丽丝的责任心而高度评价她。（课件原句）
The university is highly rated for its research. 这所大学因其研究工作而受到高度评价。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: be rated (as) sth / rate as sth
collocations.example: The show was rated (as) a success by audiences. 这场演出被观众评为一次成功。This novel rates as a masterpiece of simplicity. 这部小说可以说是朴实的典范。（课件原句）
The booklet lists 10 top-rated tourist attractions in this city. 小册子里列出了这座城市里十个最受欢迎的旅游景点。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 以不同的速度（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends. 你可能担心自己发育的速度和朋友不一样。（课文原句）
A falling birth rate poses long-term challenges. 出生率下降带来长远挑战。

collocations.translation: 一流的，第一流的（合成形容词）
collocations.example: She gave a first-rate performance on stage. 她在台上表演一流。
Users rated the app as the best study tool. 用户把这款应用评为最佳学习工具。
Her heart rate quickened as the winner's name — her own name — echoed through the hall. （读后续写·获奖瞬间）
Before travelling abroad, it is wise to check the exchange rate and prepare a small amount of local currency. （应用文·出行建议）
A rising unemployment rate calls for more job-support policies. 失业率上升需要更多就业扶持政策。
The city's green-coverage growth rate speaks volumes about what determined environmental planning can achieve. （议论文·城市发展）

synonyms.example: The rescue boat cut through the waves at full speed. 救生艇全速破浪而行。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：speed 指运动快慢本身；rate 强调单位时间内的变化量或发生频次。句法：at high speed / at a rate of ...，rate 常与增长、比率连用。

synonyms.example: Living at a slower pace does not mean falling behind. 放慢节奏并不意味着落后。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：pace 侧重生活、工作、行走的节奏，主观色彩浓；rate 更客观、可量化。句法：at a slow/fast pace，keep pace with 跟上。

synonyms.example: The proportion of students who read for pleasure remains low. 出于兴趣阅读的学生比例仍然偏低。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：proportion 指部分占整体的比例；rate 指速率或发生率。句法：the proportion of ... / a high proportion，rate 更强调频次和速度。

synonyms.example: The judges evaluated each project on creativity and impact. 评委从创意和影响两方面评估每个项目。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：evaluate 是正式的"系统评估"；rate(v.) 侧重"给出等级/打分"，常"rate sb/sth as+级别"。句法：evaluate sth；rate sth (as) first-rate。

advancedExpressions.expression: at a (different / fast / alarming) rate 以……速度 ｜ at a rate of 以……的速率 ｜ at any rate 无论如何 ｜ at this rate 照这样下去 ｜ first-rate 一流的
advancedExpressions.example: 同一 rate，介词与搭配不同义随之变：at an alarming rate（速度）、the birth rate（比率）、special rates（费用）、rate it first-rate（评价）。

advancedExpressions.expression: first-rate（一流的）｜ second-rate（二流的）｜ third-rate（三流的）
advancedExpressions.example: a first-rate hotel 一流酒店；这类合成形容词作定语，中间必带连字符。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表"速度/增长率"（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: at a fast rate ｜ at high speed ｜ at a rapid pace ｜ at a growth rate of ...
advancedExpressions.example: 写"迅速增长"可替换：grow at a fast rate / grow rapidly / grow at a rapid pace（rate 常用于可量化数据）。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the ... rate climbing / falling to ..., it is high time that ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the myopia rate among teenagers climbing to a record high, it is high time that we put down our phones and picked up outdoor sports. （with独立结构引数据 + it is high time that 虚拟语气点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the fact that the rate of ... has doubled / halved speaks volumes about ...
advancedExpressions.example: The fact that the volunteering rate among students has doubled in three years speaks volumes about the younger generation's sense of social responsibility. （同位语从句作主语 + speak volumes about 高级表达）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... at a rate faster than sb. could ever have imagined
advancedExpressions.example: The flood water was rising at a rate faster than anyone could have imagined, swallowing the wheat field inch by greedy inch. （速率表达+拟人(greedy)，灾难场景压迫感）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The fire spread very fast.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fanned by the dry autumn wind, the fire raced up the hillside at a terrifying rate, turning decades-old pines into torches within minutes. （读后续写·火灾·分词开头）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语开头(Fanned by...) + at a terrifying rate 量化速度感 + turning... 结果状语造具象画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: More and more students are short-sighted.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That the myopia rate among Chinese teenagers has been climbing steadily should serve as a wake-up call for schools, families and policymakers alike. （议论文·主语从句开头）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: That 主语从句正式化 + serve as a wake-up call 高级替换 + alike 收尾列举

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 小册子里列出了这座城市里十个最受欢迎的旅游景点。（用 top-rated）
classPractice.answer: The booklet lists 10 top-rated tourist attractions in this city.
classPractice.note: 【课件】top-rated (adj.)=最受欢迎的、热门的，由"top+rate的过去分词"合成作定语。

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 这家被评为四星的酒店，不提供热水。（用 rate 的过去分词作后置定语）
classPractice.answer: The hotel, rated four star, does not offer hot water.
classPractice.note: 【课件】rated four star 为过去分词短语作后置定语，相当于 which is rated four star；rate作评价义。

classPractice.type: 翻译句子（课件·语境应用）
classPractice.question: 人们认为他是他那个时代最伟大的诗人之一。（用 rate ... as ...）
classPractice.answer: People rate him (as) one of the greatest poets of his time.
classPractice.note: 【课件】rate sb (as) sth=把某人评价/看作……；as可省。亦可说 He is rated (as) ... / He rates as ...。

classPractice.question: 用 rate/speed/pace 填空：Teenagers develop at a different ____ from one another, so there is no need to worry about growing faster or slower.
classPractice.note: 还原课文语境："发育速度/进度"用 rate，强调单位时间的变化量。

classPractice.question: The plan may fail, but ____ ____ ____ we have learned a valuable lesson. (无论如何)
classPractice.note: at any rate=无论如何/至少，rate 的熟词僻义，用于让步转折。

classPractice.question: The documentary was ____ (rate) the best film of the year by both critics and audiences.
classPractice.note: rate 作及物动词"评价、评为"，此处被动语态 be rated (as)。

translation: (使朝某方向)冲，奔；射击；射杀；摄影
sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
readingExamples: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to fire a gun or other weapon; to kill or injure sb/sth with a bullet or arrow
(2) v. to move suddenly or quickly in one direction; (of pain) to pass sharply through part of the body
(3) v. to take photographs or make a film
(4) v. (in football, basketball, etc.) to try to kick, hit or throw the ball into the goal or basket
(5) n. the new part of a plant as it begins to grow

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】击落；批驳，否决（shoot down，熟词僻义，可指驳倒观点/否决理论）
uncommonMeanings.example: His new economic theory has been shot down. 他的新经济理论被否决了。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使朝某方向）冲，奔，疾行（shoot up/out/past，课文 shoot up 义源）
uncommonMeanings.example: The boys shot out of the classroom like arrows. 男孩们像箭一样冲出教室。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 射击；射杀，射伤（fire a gun/arrow）
uncommonMeanings.example: The hunter shot the deer with a single arrow. 猎人一箭射中了鹿。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拍摄（电影、照片、视频）
uncommonMeanings.example: They shot the documentary over a whole year. 他们花了整整一年拍这部纪录片。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （足球、篮球）射门，投篮
uncommonMeanings.example: With five seconds left, Chen steadied himself and shot. 还剩五秒，陈稳住自己出手投篮。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 嫩芽，新枝（bamboo shoots 竹笋，熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Tender green shoots pushed through the scorched earth. 嫩绿的新芽从焦土中钻出。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （疼痛）突然穿过，骤然袭来（pain shoots through）
uncommonMeanings.example: A searing pain shot through his ankle. 一阵剧痛骤然袭上他的脚踝。

posExamples.sentence: Hearing the school bell, the boys shot out of the classroom like arrows released from a bow, their laughter bouncing down the long corridor. （读后续写·校园场景·比喻）
Our photography club will shoot a short documentary about the city's disappearing old teahouses, and we sincerely invite you to join us as our English narrator. （应用文·邀请信）
Just as a seed must break its shell before the shoot reaches for sunlight, a young person must endure growing pains before achieving true maturity. （议论文·类比论证）
With only five seconds left on the clock, Chen steadied himself and shot — the ball traced a silver arc through the air, and the whole gym held its breath. （读后续写·绝杀时刻）

wordForms.noun: shot (射击；投篮；照片) / shooting (射击；拍摄)
wordForms.other: 不规则变化：shoot-shot-shot（过去式=过去分词=shot，注意双写元音 oo→o）。词族：shoot(v.)-shot(n.一击/一枪/投篮/照片)-shooting(n.射击/拍摄)。熟记短语动词 shoot up 猛长/暴涨。名词 shoot 还指"嫩芽"。

idioms.example: The shy village girl shot to fame overnight when her hand-embroidered works appeared at the international exhibition. （读后续写·励志·命运转折）
Lying on the cool grass, we counted shooting stars and made wishes we were too shy to say aloud. （读后续写·夏夜·温情）
On lazy Sunday afternoons, Grandpa and his old comrades would sit under the banyan tree, shooting the breeze about their army days. （读后续写·怀旧·祖孙场景）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（朝某方向）疾行，飞快冲/掠/穿过
collocations.example: A plane shot across the sky. 一架飞机掠过天空。Ward's hand shot out, grabbing his arm. 沃德的手猛地伸出，抓住他的胳膊。Claudia felt a pain shoot through her chest. 克劳迪娅感到一阵疼痛穿过胸膛。（课件原句）
The soldiers were ordered not to shoot at the crowd. 士兵们奉命不得向人群射击。
He was shot in the back while trying to run away. 他试图逃跑时背部中弹。
The gunman shot two policemen dead. 持枪歹徒击毙了两名警察。
When I finally had the courage to speak to her she just shot me down. 我终于鼓起勇气跟她说话，她却把我一顿抢白。His new economic theory has been shot down. 他的新经济理论被否决了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】被拍摄（拍摄义，常用被动）
collocations.example: The movie was shot in the mountain. 这部电影是在山里拍摄的。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】远景/特写镜头（shot作名词=镜头）
collocations.example: The film opens with a long shot of the empty desert. 影片以空旷沙漠的远景镜头开场。

collocations.translation: 个子蹿高（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: ... shooting up in height or getting left far behind. ……个子猛长，或被远远落在后面。（课文原句）
The teacher shot me a meaningful glance. 老师意味深长地瞥了我一眼。
He shot at the basket and scored. 他投篮得分。
The crew shot the sunrise scene three mornings in a row. 剧组连拍三个清晨才拍成日出镜头。
A squirrel shot past our picnic blanket. 一只松鼠从我们的野餐布旁飞蹿而过。

collocations.translation: 连珠炮似的向某人提问
collocations.example: The students shot questions at the astronaut about life in space. 学生们向宇航员连珠炮般发问太空生活。
Fresh bamboo shoots are the taste of spring. 鲜竹笋是春天的味道。
Over that single summer, my little brother shot up so fast that all his trousers became embarrassingly short. （读后续写·成长细节）

synonyms.example: A small figure darted across the rain-swept street. 一个小小的身影飞奔着穿过被雨打湿的街道。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：dart 指像镖一样短促敏捷地移动，多用于小而灵活的对象；shoot 速度感更强，也可指长距离直线疾驰。句法：dart across/into/out of。

synonyms.example: The starter fired his pistol, and eight runners burst off the line. 发令员鸣枪，八名选手冲出起跑线。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：fire 侧重"开(枪、炮)"这一动作，宾语常是武器或子弹；shoot 可直接以人或目标为宾语表"射中"。句法：fire a gun / fire at；shoot sb/sth。

synonyms.example: The documentary team spent a year filming the antelopes' migration. 摄制组花一年拍摄羚羊迁徙。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：film 与 shoot 在"拍摄"义上基本可互换，shoot 更口语化、更强调拍摄动作本身。句法：film/shoot a movie/scene。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：表"疾速冲出/移动"（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: shoot out of ｜ dart out of ｜ dash out of ｜ burst out of ｜ rush out of
advancedExpressions.example: 写"猛冲出去"可替换升级：he ran out → he shot / darted / burst out of the room（后接 out of / across / past）。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·shoot 一词多义速记
advancedExpressions.expression: 射击(fire)→疾行(shoot out)→拍摄(shoot a film)→射门(shoot at goal)→嫩芽(n. shoot)→猛长(shoot up)
advancedExpressions.example: 一个 shoot 六层义：核心是"迅猛、直线地发出/生长"，由此辐射出各义项。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. shot out of / across ..., 现在分词伴随, before ...
advancedExpressions.example: Without a second thought, Mike shot out of the tent, zipping up his jacket as he ran, before the others even realized what the scream had meant. （连续动作+伴随状语+before从句，营造疾速反应）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are looking for ... to help shoot ..., through which ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are looking for students with a good eye for beauty to help shoot our campus promotional video, through which the charm of our school will reach thousands of families. （招募句式+through which定语从句拔高意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: like a young shoot breaking through the soil, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a young shoot breaking through the soil, every new idea needs both the courage to emerge and the patience to grow. （借僻义"嫩芽"设喻，议论文形象化开篇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He ran out of the room quickly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant the fire alarm shrieked, he shot out of the room, knocking over his chair, his heart hammering against his ribs like a trapped bird. （读后续写·紧急时刻·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant 时间状语从句 + shoot out 替换 run quickly + 伴随细节(knocking over his chair) + 心跳比喻(trapped bird)

sentenceUpgrade.original: She became famous quickly after the show.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Almost overnight, the once-unknown singer shot to fame, yet she kept reminding herself that applause, like fireworks, dazzles brightest just before it fades. （读后续写·成名与清醒·哲理收尾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: shot to fame 习语替换 became famous + yet 转折凸显人物品格 + 明喻(applause like fireworks)

classPractice.question: The instant the fire alarm shrieked, he ____ (shoot) out of the room, knocking over his chair.
classPractice.note: shoot-shot-shot 不规则变化；此处叙述过去动作用过去式 shot，表"猛冲"。

classPractice.question: 用 shoot 的适当短语填空：After the spring rain, bamboo ____ pushed through the soil overnight.
classPractice.note: shoot 作名词表"嫩芽"，bamboo shoots=竹笋，此处用复数。

classPractice.question: 把"那个害羞的女孩一夜之间一举成名"译成英文（用 shoot）。
classPractice.answer: The shy girl shot to fame overnight.
classPractice.note: shoot to fame=一举成名/迅速走红，shoot 用过去式 shot。

sub_section: Article: Strangers under the same roof?
original_sentence: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
readingExamples: You may feel anxious that you are developing at a different rate to your friends, shooting up in height or getting left far behind.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to increase very quickly and suddenly in number, size or amount
(2) phr. v. (of a child or plant) to grow taller very quickly
(3) phr. v. to move upwards suddenly (flames, hands, etc.)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （孩子、植物）快速长高，蹿个儿（课文本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Boys at this age often shoot up in height almost overnight. 这个年纪的男孩常常几乎一夜之间蹿个儿。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （价格、数量、温度等）飞涨，猛增（高考高频义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Air ticket prices shoot up whenever holiday demand peaks. 一到假期需求高峰，机票价格就飞涨。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （火焰、手等）突然向上蹿起/举起
uncommonMeanings.example: Flames shot up from the frying pan. 火苗从煎锅里蹿起来。
