sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: I'm eager for my parents' love.
readingExamples: I'm eager for my parents' love.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. wanting to do or have something very much, and showing this in the way you behave
(2) adj. showing keen interest, enthusiasm or impatience
(3) adj. (eager for / eager to do sth) strongly wishing to obtain or experience something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①渴望的，热切的（be eager for sth / eager to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: I'm eager for my parents' love. 我渴望父母的爱。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（神情、目光）热切的，急切的，充满兴致的
uncommonMeanings.example: A dozen eager faces pressed against the window. 一张张热切的脸贴在窗上。

posExamples.sentence: The moment the bell rang, a dozen eager faces pressed against the classroom window, their eyes shining as the first snow of the year drifted silently onto the playground. （读后续写·校园·期待）
I am writing to apply for the position of volunteer guide, for I am eager to contribute my energy to promoting our city's rich culture to foreign visitors. （应用文·申请信）
Young people today are increasingly eager to prove their worth, yet true growth demands not restless ambition but the patience to master one skill at a time. （议论文·青年成长）
Trembling with cold and fear, the stray puppy nonetheless wagged its tail, its eager eyes begging the boy for a scrap of warmth and companionship. （读后续写·人与动物·温情）

wordForms.other: 词族：eager (adj.) → eagerly (adv.) → eagerness (n.)。固定搭配：be eager for + 名词；be eager to + do；be eager that + 主语 + (should) do（从句虚拟）。易错：不说 eager of / eager doing。

collocations.phrase: be eager for sb's love / sth
collocations.translation: 渴望得到某人的爱/某物（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I'm eager for my parents' love. 我渴望父母的爱。（课文原句）
The children were eager for the holidays. 孩子们盼着放假。

collocations.translation: 渴望做某事，急于做某事
collocations.example: She was eager to help. 她很想帮忙。
He was eager that everyone (should) join in. 他急切希望人人都参加。
As an eager learner, Tom never let a single question go unanswered, staying behind after class until the teacher had explained every detail. （读后续写·师生·勤奋）
The children waited in eager anticipation, counting down the seconds until the fireworks would light up the winter sky. （读后续写·节日·期盼）
An eager crowd gathered outside the newly opened library, each person hoping to be among the first to borrow a book. （应用文·新闻报道）

collocations.translation: 工作卖力的人；过分热心的人
collocations.example: Always the eager beaver, Lily signed up for every committee, determined to leave her mark on the school before graduation. （读后续写·人物性格）

collocations.phrase: cast an eager glance / eye at
collocations.example: She cast an eager glance at the notice board, her heart pounding as she searched the list for her own name. （读后续写·揭晓·紧张）

collocations.translation: 急于讨好；一心想让人满意
collocations.example: The young waiter, eager to please, refilled our cups before they were even half empty. （读后续写·服务·细节）

synonyms.example: She was so keen on joining the debate club that she practised her arguments in front of the mirror every night. （读后续写·兴趣·执着）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：keen 英式常用，语气略平实，更强调持续的兴趣爱好；eager 更强调对某目标当下的急切向往。句法/搭配：be keen on doing / be keen to do；be eager for sth / eager to do。

synonyms.translation: 急切的，渴望的（此义中性偏急，另义"焦虑的"）
synonyms.example: He was anxious to explain himself before the misunderstanding grew any deeper. （读后续写·误会·澄清）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：anxious 作"急切想做"解时近于 eager，但常暗含担忧不安（anxious about 则纯表焦虑）；eager 是积极正面的渴望。句法/搭配：be anxious to do / anxious about sth。

synonyms.example: The volunteers gave the visitors an enthusiastic welcome, their warm smiles instantly putting everyone at ease. （应用文·活动报道）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：enthusiastic 侧重外露的热情与积极态度，强调情绪高涨；eager 侧重对某目标的向往和急切。句法/搭配：be enthusiastic about sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: be eager for + n. · be eager to do · eager anticipation 热切期待 · eager to please 急于讨好 · an eager learner 好学者
advancedExpressions.example: Eager for approval and eager to prove herself, she waited in eager anticipation for the results. （for 后接名词，to 后接动词，一组固定搭配理清）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·渴望（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be eager to do ≈ be keen to do ≈ long to do ≈ be dying to do ≈ can't wait to do
advancedExpressions.example: I am eager / keen / dying to see the results; I simply can't wait. （五种表达皆可替换表"迫切想做"，口语常用 can't wait / dying）

advancedExpressions.expression: eager 积极渴望 · anxious 急切但含担忧 · keen 持续兴趣（英式）
advancedExpressions.example: She was eager (兴奋期待) and a little anxious (略带不安) about the trip she had long been keen (一直感兴趣) on. （三词递进：期待→担忧→兴趣，语气各异）

advancedExpressions.expression: so eager was sb. to do sth that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So eager was he to catch a glimpse of his idol that he squeezed through the crowd, heedless of the elbows jabbing at his ribs. （so + adj. 倒装强调,前置渴望之强烈,续写高潮段增强张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am eager to ..., which is why I am writing to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am eager to broaden my horizons through cultural exchange, which is precisely why I am writing to apply for this exchange programme. （eager 开门见山表明动机,which 引导非限定从句自然衔接目的）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being merely eager, sb. must also ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being merely eager for success, the young generation must also cultivate the resilience to endure repeated failure. （far from 让步转折,由"渴望"提升到"更需坚韧"的辩证论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The boy was eager to open the gift.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The boy's fingers trembled with eager impatience as he tore at the wrapping paper, his heart drumming against his ribs at the thought of what lay hidden beneath. （读后续写·动作+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 化"渴望"为具体动作(fingers trembled, tore at) + 心理外化(heart drumming) + at the thought of 引出期待的对象,画面感陡增

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students are eager to succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is undeniable that today's students are eager to succeed; yet genuine achievement, I would argue, springs not from restless haste but from patient, deliberate effort. （议论文·辩证升级）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is undeniable that... 让步开篇 + 分号连接对立观点 + I would argue 插入语增强论证口吻 + not from...but from 平行对比点明主张

classPractice.question: 我渴望父母的爱。I'm ____ ____ my parents' love.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be eager for + 名词，表"渴望得到"

classPractice.question: Every new intern was eager ____ (make) a good impression on the very first day.
classPractice.note: be eager to do sth 渴望做某事；后接动词不定式

classPractice.question: 选词填空（eager / anxious）：He was ____ to start the adventure, his eyes shining with excitement rather than worry.
classPractice.note: 语境"兴奋无忧"用积极的 eager；anxious 多含焦虑不安

translation: 青年时期；青春；(the youth)年轻人
sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree.
readingExamples: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the period of time when someone is young, especially the time before a child becomes an adult
(2) n. the quality or state of being young; the energy and freshness associated with being young
(3) n. a young man, typically a teenager or young adult
(4) n. (the youth) young people considered as a group

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①青年时期，青春（不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Youth is a time for adventure. 青春是冒险的时光。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②年轻、朝气（青春的活力状态，不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her face glowed with youth and health. 她的脸上洋溢着青春与健康。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（the youth）年轻人（作集合名词，指年轻群体）
uncommonMeanings.example: The youth of today shoulder great responsibilities. 当今的年轻人肩负重任。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④小伙子，青年男子（可数，单数，常含轻微贬义或距离感）
uncommonMeanings.example: A hooded youth loitered at the corner of the alley, and the old shopkeeper instinctively drew the bolt across his door. （读后续写·街头·戒备氛围）

posExamples.sentence: In his youth, my grandfather had roamed the mountains barefoot, and even now, at eighty, his eyes still sparkled whenever he spoke of those carefree, sunlit days. （读后续写·怀旧·祖辈回忆）
On behalf of the student union, I sincerely invite the youth of our school to join the tree-planting campaign and devote their energy to a greener campus. （应用文·倡议书）
Youth is not merely a stage of life to be hurried through, but a precious window in which curiosity, courage and ideals should be nurtured for a lifetime. （议论文·青春的价值）
The gymnast moved with a grace and vigour that spoke of youth, yet her disciplined focus revealed a maturity far beyond her years. （读后续写·人物·矛盾特质）

wordForms.adjective: youthful (adj. 年轻的，朝气蓬勃的)
wordForms.other: 词族：young (adj.) → youth (n. 青春/年轻人) → youthful (adj. 富有青春活力的) → youngster (n. 年轻人)。单复数与主谓一致小贴士：作"青春/年轻"讲不可数（youth is...）；the youth 指"年轻人（群体）"作主语，视整体用单数动词（The youth of today is / are... 均见，作集合体多用单数）；作"小伙子"讲可数，复数 youths。辨析 youthful（褒义"朝气蓬勃"）≠ young（客观"年轻"）。

idioms.idiom: in the flower / bloom of one's youth
idioms.example: Cut down in the bloom of his youth, the young pilot became a symbol of sacrifice that the whole nation would remember. （读后续写·纪念·崇高）

idioms.translation: 青春之泉（永葆青春的源泉）
idioms.example: She laughed that gardening was her fountain of youth, keeping both her hands busy and her heart forever young. （读后续写·晚年·豁达）

collocations.phrase: youth is a time for adventure
collocations.translation: 青春是冒险的时光（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree. 人人都说青春是冒险的时光，可我父母不同意。（课文原句）
In his youth he loved to travel. 他年轻时爱旅行。

collocations.phrase: the youth of today / today's youth
collocations.example: The youth of today face new challenges. 当今的年轻人面临新挑战。
With all the energy of youth, they finished the work in a day. 凭着青春的活力，他们一天就干完了。
He deeply regretted having wasted his youth on trivial pleasures instead of pursuing a craft that could have defined his life. （读后续写·悔悟）
Time spares neither youth nor beauty, but it can never erase the wisdom a person earns along the way. （议论文·时间与成长）

collocations.translation: 青年中心 / 青年旅舍
collocations.example: The newly built youth centre offers free reading rooms and workshops where teenagers can spend their weekends meaningfully. （应用文·通知）
From youth to old age, he remained loyal to the small village school where he had first learned to read. （读后续写·坚守·一生）

synonyms.example: Adolescence is a turbulent bridge between childhood and adulthood, when the soul searches restlessly for its own shape. （议论文·成长阶段）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：adolescence 特指从儿童到成人的过渡期（约13-19岁），更学术、更强调身心变化；youth 泛指年轻阶段，范围更广。句法/搭配：during adolescence；不可数。

synonyms.example: As a teenager, she filled countless notebooks with poems she was too shy to show anyone. （读后续写·少女·内向）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：teenager 具体指十几岁的人，口语常用；youth 可指人也可指时期，更书面、更文学化。句法/搭配：as a teenager；可数。

synonyms.example: The line between youth and adult is drawn not by age alone but by the readiness to take responsibility. （议论文·成长界定）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：作对照概念时反衬 youth，强调成熟与责任；写作中常与 youth 并列构成对比。句法/搭配：youth and adult 并列作对比。

advancedExpressions.expression: in one's youth 年轻时 · the youth of today 当今青年 · the vigour of youth 青春活力 · spend / waste one's youth 度过/虚度青春
advancedExpressions.example: In his youth he had the vigour of youth to spare, yet he wasted those golden years. （in one's youth 指时期，the youth 指人群，一组理清"青春/年轻人"两义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·青年时期（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: youth ≈ one's early years ≈ one's teens ≈ the springtime of life ≈ younger days
advancedExpressions.example: In his youth / early years / younger days, he had crossed half the country on foot. （四种表达皆可替换表"年轻时"，the springtime of life 最文学化）

advancedExpressions.expression: young (adj.) → youth (n.) → youthful (adj.) → youthfully (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Though no longer young, she kept a youthful spirit and moved youthfully through the crowd. （形容词 young 派生抽象名词 youth 及"朝气蓬勃"义的 youthful，一族记全）

advancedExpressions.expression: the sb. of his youth had ..., but now ...
advancedExpressions.example: The carefree boy of his youth had vanished; in his place stood a man weathered by years, yet strangely at peace. （名词短语 the...of his youth 凝练往昔 + but now 时空对照,续写人物弧光）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the youth of a new era, we ought to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the youth of a new era, we ought to shoulder our responsibilities and devote our talents to the service of society. （身份定位开篇 + ought to 义务情态,增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: youth lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Youth lies not in the smoothness of one's face but in the vigour of one's spirit and the boldness of one's dreams. （lies not in...but in 抽象定义句式,由外在转向内在,升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He remembered his youth happily.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Whenever the scent of osmanthus drifted through the autumn air, he was carried back to his youth — to barefoot races down the hillside and laughter that echoed until dusk swallowed the light. （读后续写·感官触发回忆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 气味触发记忆(scent of osmanthus) + 破折号引出具体画面 + 平行意象(races, laughter) + 拟人(dusk swallowed the light),营造怀旧氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: Young people should work hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that the youth of our nation should not squander these irreplaceable years, but rather channel their boundless energy into pursuits that will enrich both themselves and the world. （议论文·正式倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 正式主句 + not...but rather 转折递进 + channel...into 隐喻用法 + 双宾并列(themselves and the world)升华格局

classPractice.question: 人人都说青春是冒险的时光。Everyone says that ____ is a time for adventure.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；youth 作"青春/青年时期"讲不可数，前不加冠词

classPractice.question: ____ his youth, my grandfather roamed the mountains barefoot and feared nothing.
classPractice.note: in one's youth 在某人年轻时，固定短语

classPractice.question: The teacher spoke highly of the ____ (youth) energy the whole team brought to the project.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 energy 需形容词 youthful（富有青春活力的）

sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree.
readingExamples: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an exciting experience in which dangerous or unusual things happen
(2) n. the excitement produced by new, dangerous or exotic experiences; a willingness to take risks
(3) n. an unusual, exciting or daring undertaking
(4) n. a commercial or financial venture involving risk

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冒险经历，刺激的经历（本义，可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: The trip turned into a real adventure. 那次旅行变成了一场真正的冒险。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冒险精神，冒险乐趣（不可数，抽象）
uncommonMeanings.example: Youth is a time for adventure. 青春是冒险的时光。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 投机的商业冒险,风险事业(书面/旧义)
uncommonMeanings.example: The merchant sank his entire fortune into a single trading adventure to the East, gambling everything on winds he could not control. （读后续写·大航海·孤注一掷）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冒险；大胆前往（书面，较少用）
uncommonMeanings.example: They adventured deep into the jungle. 他们冒险深入丛林。

posExamples.sentence: The narrow mountain trail, the sudden storm, the shelter found by sheer luck — that unforgettable night turned an ordinary hike into the greatest adventure of my life. （读后续写·徒步·意外）
I would like to invite you to join our summer expedition to the Gobi Desert, an adventure that promises breathtaking scenery and lifelong friendships. （应用文·邀请信）
Life without any sense of adventure would be a still pond; it is the courage to step into the unknown that gives our days their colour and depth. （议论文·冒险与人生）
For the shy new student, simply raising her hand in class felt like an adventure, each word a small leap across the chasm of her own fear. （读后续写·成长·突破自我）

wordForms.other: 构词法：adventur(e)+-ous→adventurous(形)，+-er→adventurer(人)；单复数：adventure 可数，复数 adventures；易错：形容词是 adventurous（结尾 -ous，不是 adventureous）；辨析 adventurous(人爱冒险/事有冒险性) vs. adventurer(名词，冒险家)。

collocations.phrase: youth is a time for adventure
collocations.translation: 青春是冒险的时光（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Everyone says that youth is a time for adventure, but my parents disagree. 人人都说青春是冒险的时光，但我父母不同意。
A true explorer is driven by a spirit of adventure. 真正的探险家由冒险精神驱使。
Her sense of adventure took her to every continent. 她的冒险精神把她带到了每个大洲。
As a boy he loved adventure stories. 小时候他喜欢冒险故事。

collocations.phrase: set off / embark on an adventure
collocations.example: At dawn they embarked on an adventure. 黎明时他们踏上了冒险之旅。

collocations.phrase: seek / go in search of adventure
collocations.example: The young sailor left home to seek adventure. 年轻水手离家去寻求冒险。
We had quite an adventure getting here. 我们来这儿一路可真是场冒险。
Nothing could quench his thirst for adventure. 什么也无法浇灭他对冒险的渴望。
The exchange programme offered us the adventure of a lifetime, plunging us into a culture utterly different from our own. （应用文·感想）

synonyms.example: The scientific expedition to the polar region lasted six gruelling months and rewrote the textbooks on climate change. （议论文·科考·意义）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：指有明确目的、有组织的探险或考察，常涉科研或征服；句法/搭配：可数名词，常接 to+地点（an expedition to the Antarctic），go on an expedition。adventure 更泛指一般刺激经历，不必有正式目标。

synonyms.example: Starting a business straight out of school was a bold venture, but she was determined to prove the doubters wrong. （读后续写·创业·决心）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：多指商业或有风险的尝试，强调可能失败的投入；句法/搭配：可作名词（a business venture）也可作动词（venture into/out）。adventure 更偏重刺激与经历本身的乐趣。

synonyms.example: His quest for the lost manuscript took him across three continents and into the dustiest corners of forgotten libraries. （读后续写·追寻·执着）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：强调为某一崇高或长期目标的持续追寻，带文学色彩；句法/搭配：常接 for（a quest for truth）或 to do。adventure 更侧重单次的、刺激的经历。

advancedExpressions.expression: a spirit / sense / thirst for adventure｜seek / embark on / have an adventure｜an adventure story
advancedExpressions.example: Full of a spirit of adventure, they embarked on an adventure of a lifetime. 满怀冒险精神，他们踏上了一生难忘的冒险。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"刺激经历"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: an adventure ≈ an exciting experience ≈ a thrilling journey ≈ a daring undertaking
advancedExpressions.example: That hike was an adventure / a thrilling journey we would never forget. 那次徒步是一场我们永生难忘的冒险／惊险之旅。

advancedExpressions.expression: adventure→adventurous；danger→dangerous；fame→famous（去e加ous/直接加ous）
advancedExpressions.example: An adventurous spirit thrives on the unknown. 爱冒险的性情在未知中茁壮成长。

advancedExpressions.expression: little did sb. know that ... would turn into an adventure
advancedExpressions.example: Little did they know that a simple detour to avoid the traffic would turn into the wildest adventure of their summer. （little did 倒装 + 埋伏笔,续写开篇预示情节反转）

advancedExpressions.expression: join us for an adventure that will ...
advancedExpressions.example: Join us for an adventure that will not only challenge your limits but also forge friendships to last a lifetime. （祈使句号召 + not only...but also 双重卖点,增强吸引力）

advancedExpressions.expression: adventure is not about ... but about ...
advancedExpressions.example: True adventure is not about escaping danger but about embracing uncertainty with an open and fearless heart. （not about...but about 重新定义 + 抽象名词化升华主旨）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They went on an exciting adventure.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With their hearts pounding and the wind roaring in their ears, they plunged into an adventure that would test not only their strength but the very depths of their courage. （读后续写·动作+情感渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with 独立主格铺垫氛围(hearts pounding, wind roaring) + plunge into 动词强化投入感 + not only...but the very depths of 递进升华内涵

sentenceUpgrade.original: Adventure makes life interesting.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is precisely the willingness to embrace adventure — to venture beyond the comfortable and the familiar — that transforms a life of mere existence into one of genuine meaning. （议论文·强调句升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is...that 强调句突出核心 + 破折号插入解释(venture beyond...) + transform...into 对比句式(existence vs. meaning)拔高立意

classPractice.question: Everyone says that youth is a time for ____ (adventure), but my parents disagree.
classPractice.note: 考"a time for + n."，此处 adventure 作不可数抽象名词，不加冠词、不变复数。

classPractice.question: Backpackers with an ____ (adventure) spirit are eager to explore places off the beaten track.
classPractice.note: 名词前作定语用形容词 adventurous，注意 -ous 拼写（无 e）。

classPractice.question: 满怀冒险精神，三个朋友踏上了一生难忘的冒险。With a spirit of ____, the three friends ____ (踏上) an adventure of a lifetime.
classPractice.answer: adventure; embarked on / set off on
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 a spirit of adventure 与 embark on / set off on an adventure。

word: be on sb's back about sth
sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: ' They're always on my back about something.
readingExamples: ' They're always on my back about something.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to keep criticizing, nagging or pressuring someone about something in a way that annoys them
(2) phr. to repeatedly urge or remind someone to do something, often causing irritation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不停批评／数落／施压某人（使其厌烦，本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Stop being on my back! 别再数落我了！

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反复催促／提醒某人做某事（常令人不耐烦）
uncommonMeanings.example: Mum is on my back about tidying my room. 妈妈一直催我收拾房间。

posExamples.sentence: My coach had been on my back about my sloppy footwork for weeks, but the day I finally nailed the routine, his stern face broke into the widest grin I had ever seen. （读后续写·师徒·严厉背后的期望）
I understand that parents are constantly on their children's backs about grades because they love them, yet endless nagging often does more harm than good. （议论文·亲子沟通）
"Stop being on my back about it," she snapped, then instantly regretted the sharpness in her voice as she saw the hurt flicker across her mother's face. （读后续写·冲突·愧疚）

wordForms.other: 习语，形式固定：be/get/keep on sb's back about sth；核心名词 back 不变，物主代词随人称变（my/his/their back）；反向习语 get off sb's back（别再烦某人）。整体作谓语，不可拆分套用其他句型。

idioms.example: "Just get off my back and let me try it my own way for once," he pleaded, his voice cracking under the weight of everyone's expectations. （读后续写·压力·渴望自主）
Her condescending tone immediately got my back up, though I forced myself to stay polite. （读后续写·摩擦·隐忍）

collocations.phrase: always on my back about something
collocations.translation: 总是为某事缠着我／数落我（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: They're always on my back about something. 他们总是为点什么事缠着我／数落我。
His parents were always on his back. 他父母总是数落他。

collocations.phrase: be on sb's back about the homework / grades
collocations.example: My teacher was on my back about the essay. 老师为那篇作文一直催我。
She had to keep on her brother's back about practice. 她得一直催弟弟练习。

collocations.translation: 被某人缠着，被某人施压
collocations.example: With his boss on his back over the deadline, he could hardly concentrate on doing the job well. （读后续写·职场·压力）

synonyms.example: His grandmother nagged at him gently to wear a scarf, and only years later did he understand that nagging was her language of love. （读后续写·祖孙·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：指反复唠叨琐事使人厌烦，是 be on sb's back 最贴近的近义；句法/搭配：nag (at) sb (to do sth)，nag sb about sth，可作动词也有名词 nagging。

synonyms.example: The children pestered their father about the promised trip to the seaside until he finally gave in. （读后续写·孩童·央求）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：强调反复请求或打扰以求达到目的，常用于孩子缠大人；句法/搭配：pester sb (about sth) / (to do sth)。be on sb's back 更侧重批评施压。

synonyms.example: My mother kept on at me to apply for the scholarship, and in the end her persistence paid off. （读后续写·母亲·坚持）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：英式口语，指持续不断地催促或劝说；句法/搭配：keep on at sb (to do sth / about sth)。与 be on sb's back 语气相近，但结果可正可负。

advancedExpressions.expression: be on sb's back（缠着数落）｜get off sb's back（放过某人）｜get / put sb's back up（激怒某人）
advancedExpressions.example: The more they stayed on my back, the more I wished they would get off it. 他们越缠着数落我，我越希望他们放过我。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"反复唠叨施压"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be on sb's back ≈ nag (at) sb ≈ pester sb ≈ keep on at sb ≈ go on at sb
advancedExpressions.example: They were always on my back / always nagging me about my grades. 他们总是为成绩数落我。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·always + 进行时表反复（含情绪）
advancedExpressions.expression: be always on sb's back（always 与进行/习惯连用，含厌烦语气）
advancedExpressions.example: They're always on my back about something. 他们总是为点什么事缠着我。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had always been on my back about ..., and only then did I realize ...
advancedExpressions.example: My father had always been on my back about my carelessness, and only then, standing amid the wreckage of my mistake, did I realize how right he had been. （only then did 倒装 + 事后顿悟,续写情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than constantly being on sb's back, it would be wiser to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than constantly being on your child's back about every small failing, it would be far wiser to offer gentle encouragement and trust. （rather than...it would be wiser to 委婉建议句式,应用文劝导口吻）

advancedExpressions.expression: when parents are always on their children's backs, ... ; conversely, ...
advancedExpressions.example: When parents are always on their children's backs, they may breed rebellion rather than obedience; conversely, patient guidance often earns lasting respect. （对比句式 conversely 引出辩证,议论文两面论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My parents are always on my back about studying.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Day after day my parents were on my back about my studies, their well-meant reminders gradually hardening into a wall between us that neither side knew how to climb. （读后续写·亲子隔阂·比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Day after day 时间状语强化持续感 + well-meant 让步点明善意 + harden into a wall 隐喻代际隔阂 + that 定语从句延展画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is not good to keep criticizing children.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Being perpetually on a child's back, however well-intentioned, tends to erode confidence rather than build it, for constant criticism whispers a quiet message: you are not enough. （议论文·因果论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词作主语正式化 + however well-intentioned 插入让步 + erode...rather than build 对比动词 + for 引出原因 + 冒号后拟人化点明危害

classPractice.question: 他们总是为点什么事缠着我。They're always ____ my back ____ something.
classPractice.note: 课文原句结构 be on sb's back about sth；always 与 be 连用含厌烦语气。

classPractice.question: "Just ____ ____ my back and let me try it my own way!" he shouted, tired of being nagged.
classPractice.note: 反向习语 get off sb's back = 别再烦某人，与 be on sb's back 相对。

classPractice.question: My mother keeps nagging me about my untidy room. → My mother is always ____ my ____ about my untidy room.
classPractice.note: nag sb about sth ≈ be on sb's back about sth，注意物主代词 my。

sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: However, just as a baby kangaroo must learn to protect itself when it leaves its mother's pocket, I will have to learn to protect myself when I grow up.
readingExamples: However, just as a baby kangaroo must learn to protect itself when it leaves its mother's pocket, I will have to learn to protect myself when I grow up.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large Australian mammal that moves by jumping on its powerful hind legs and carries its young in a pouch on the front of its body
(2) n. (kangaroo court) an informal, unofficial court that ignores standards of justice and law

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 袋鼠（澳大利亚有袋哺乳动物，用后腿跳跃，可数，复数 kangaroos）
uncommonMeanings.example: Kangaroos are found only in Australia. 袋鼠仅见于澳大利亚。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (kangaroo court)非法私设的法庭,不公正的裁决场合
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole hearing felt like a kangaroo court, its verdict decided long before the first witness had even spoken. （读后续写·蒙冤·不公）

posExamples.sentence: At the first light of dawn, a kangaroo bounded across the dusty road, its powerful hind legs propelling it over the fence in a single, breathtaking leap. （读后续写·澳洲·自然画面）
During our trip to Australia, we were thrilled to feed a gentle kangaroo by hand, an experience that made the whole class fall in love with wildlife. （应用文·游记 / 报道）
Just as a baby kangaroo must one day leave its mother's pouch, every young person must eventually step out of the shelter of family and learn to stand alone. （议论文·独立成长·比喻论证）

wordForms.other: 专有/动物名词；单复数：以 -oo 结尾直接加 -s→kangaroos（不是 kangarooes）；主谓一致：A kangaroo is... / Kangaroos are...；固定短语 kangaroo court（私设法庭）；澳洲同类：wallaby（小袋鼠）、joey（幼崽）。

idioms.translation: 非法私设的法庭;不公正的审判
idioms.example: He refused to defend himself before what he rightly called a kangaroo court, where the outcome had been fixed from the start. （读后续写·正义·抗争）

collocations.phrase: a baby kangaroo leaves its mother's pocket
collocations.translation: 袋鼠幼崽离开母亲的育儿袋（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Just as a baby kangaroo must learn to protect itself when it leaves its mother's pocket, I will have to learn to protect myself. 正如袋鼠幼崽离开母亲的育儿袋时必须学会保护自己，我长大后也必须学会保护自己。
The baby kangaroo peeped out from the pouch. 袋鼠幼崽从育儿袋里探出头。
A kangaroo's pouch shelters its tiny joey. 袋鼠的育儿袋庇护着幼小的幼崽。

collocations.translation: 一群袋鼠（袋鼠复数 kangaroos）
collocations.example: A mob of kangaroos grazed on the grassland. 一群袋鼠在草原上吃草。
The puppy bounded like a kangaroo across the lawn. 小狗像袋鼠一样蹦过草坪。
The reserve is home to hundreds of wild kangaroos, and visitors are urged to keep a respectful distance. （应用文·须知/告示）

synonyms.example: The joey stayed in the pouch until it grew strong. 幼崽待在育儿袋里直到长壮。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：joey 专指袋鼠/考拉等有袋动物的幼崽，是 baby kangaroo 的地道对应词；句法/搭配：可数名词 a joey。kangaroo 泛指袋鼠这一物种（成体或统称）。

synonyms.example: A wallaby looks like a small kangaroo. 沙袋鼠看起来像小型袋鼠。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：wallaby 是与袋鼠同科但体型较小的近亲，形近易混；句法/搭配：可数名词，复数 wallabies。二者不可互换指同一动物。

advancedExpressions.expression: a baby kangaroo / joey｜a kangaroo's pouch｜a mob of kangaroos｜a wild kangaroo｜kangaroo court
advancedExpressions.example: A joey peeped out of the kangaroo's pouch as the mob moved on. 幼崽从袋鼠的育儿袋里探头张望，鼠群则继续前行。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·名词复数（-oo 结尾）
advancedExpressions.expression: kangaroo→kangaroos；zoo→zoos；bamboo→bamboos（-oo 直接加 s）
advancedExpressions.example: Dozens of kangaroos crossed the road at dusk. 黄昏时数十只袋鼠横穿马路。

advancedExpressions.expression: with each powerful leap, the kangaroo ...
advancedExpressions.example: With each powerful leap, the kangaroo seemed to defy gravity itself, sailing across the open plain as if the earth could scarcely hold it. （with 独立主格 + 拟人 defy gravity,续写自然动态描写）

advancedExpressions.expression: we should protect ... such as the kangaroo, before ...
advancedExpressions.example: We should act now to protect precious species such as the kangaroo, before human carelessness robs future generations of these living wonders. （祈使呼吁 + before 从句强化紧迫感,倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a kangaroo ..., so too must sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a kangaroo must trust its own legs once it leaves the pouch, so too must the young learn to rely on their own judgement once they leave home. （just as...so too 类比句式,以自然现象论证成长道理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A kangaroo jumped across the field.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In one fluid, effortless bound, the kangaroo cleared the field and vanished into the shimmering heat, leaving only a trail of dust dancing in the morning light. （读后续写·动态+环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in one...bound 强调动作干脆利落 + clear 精准动词表"跃过" + vanish into 营造消失感 + leaving 现在分词收尾定格画面(dust dancing)

sentenceUpgrade.original: A young kangaroo must leave its mother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Nature offers no gentler teacher than necessity: just as the young kangaroo must one day abandon the safety of the pouch, so every fledgling soul must brave the wide, uncertain world alone. （议论文·哲理升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 冒号引出格言式主句 + just as...so 类比结构 + fledgling soul 隐喻年轻人 + brave 动词化"勇敢面对" + 形容词叠加(wide, uncertain)渲染世界之广

classPractice.question: At dusk, a mob of ____ (kangaroo) grazed peacefully across the golden grassland.
classPractice.note: a mob of + 复数名词；kangaroo 以 -oo 结尾直接加 -s。

classPractice.question: 正如袋鼠幼崽离开母亲的育儿袋时必须学会保护自己一样……Just as a baby kangaroo must learn to protect ____ when it leaves its mother's pocket, ...
classPractice.note: 课文原句：主语 a baby kangaroo（单数中性）→反身代词 itself。

classPractice.question: 袋鼠仅见于澳大利亚，用它们强壮的后腿跳跃。（用 be found / powerful hind legs）
classPractice.answer: Kangaroos are found only in Australia, and they jump / move on their powerful hind legs.
classPractice.note: 复数主语 Kangaroos 谓语用 are；注意复数拼写与主谓一致。

translation: 灵活的，可变动的；柔韧的
sub_section: Part A — 三位青少年的问题
original_sentence: I wish they could be more flexible so that I can make my own choices about what to do in my spare time.
readingExamples: I wish they could be more flexible so that I can make my own choices about what to do in my spare time.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. able to change or be changed easily according to the situation; adaptable
(2) adj. (of a person) willing to change plans or ideas in order to suit new conditions
(3) adj. (of a material or object) able to bend or be bent easily without breaking
(4) adj. (of arrangements, time, etc.) able to be altered to suit different needs

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （安排、时间等）可变动的，弹性的
uncommonMeanings.example: The schedule is flexible. 日程是有弹性的。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人）能随机应变的，愿意变通的
uncommonMeanings.example: A good leader must be flexible. 好的领导必须能变通。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （材料、物体）柔韧的，易弯曲不易折断的
uncommonMeanings.example: Rubber is a flexible material. 橡胶是一种柔韧的材料。

posExamples.sentence: When the sudden downpour ruined our outdoor plans, our teacher stayed remarkably flexible, turning the crowded classroom into the liveliest storytelling session we had ever had. （读后续写·师生·应变）
I would suggest that the schedule be made more flexible, so that students with different talents can arrange their study time in a way that best suits them. （应用文·建议信）
In a world that changes faster than ever, those who remain flexible in thought and open to new ideas are far more likely to thrive than those who cling to old certainties. （议论文·适应变化）
The gymnast's body was astonishingly flexible, bending and folding with a grace that made the impossible look effortless. （读后续写·体育·惊叹）

wordForms.adjective: flexible (灵活的；柔韧的)｜inflexible / rigid (死板的，反义)
wordForms.other: 构词法：flex(词根"弯")+-ible→flexible(形)，+-ibility→flexibility(名，去e加ibility)，+-ibly→flexibly(副)；反义前缀 in-→inflexible；易错：名词是 flexibility（不是 flexibleness），形容词后缀 -ible 不是 -able。

collocations.translation: 【课件】在某方面灵活变通，愿随情况调整
collocations.example: You can save money if you're flexible about where your room is located. 如果你可以适应不同的房间位置，则可以省钱。（课件原句）
A more flexible approach often works better than stubbornness. 更灵活的方法往往比固执更奏效。（课件搭配）
The company offers flexible working hours. 公司提供弹性工作时间。（课件搭配）
Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater for the needs of everyone. 我们的计划必须足够变通，以满足每个人的需要。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 更灵活变通以便……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I wish they could be more flexible so that I can make my own choices. 我希望他们能更灵活些，好让我自己做选择。
A flexible timetable lets us pursue our hobbies. 弹性课表让我们能发展爱好。
A flexible attitude often works better than stubbornness. 灵活的态度往往比固执更有效。
Even under pressure, the captain remained flexible. 即便承压，队长仍保持灵活。
She kept her options flexible, refusing to burn any bridges before the final decision. （读后续写·人物·睿智）
Engineers chose flexible materials so the bridge could sway safely in strong winds instead of snapping. （议论文·科技/说明）
A flexible approach often works better than stubbornness. 灵活的方式往往比固执更有效。

synonyms.example: Highly adaptable, the new student blended into the strange environment within days, making friends where others would have felt lost. （读后续写·转学·融入）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：侧重能主动适应新环境或变化，多形容人或生物；句法/搭配：be adaptable to sth，作表语/定语。flexible 既可指人也可指安排、材料，含义更广。

synonyms.example: A versatile actor, he could switch from comedy to tragedy in a single breath, leaving the audience spellbound. （读后续写·才华·惊艳）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：强调多方面能力或多种用途；句法/搭配：a versatile tool / player，作定语常见。flexible 强调可弯曲、可变通，不必然指"多才"。

synonyms.example: The rules proved surprisingly elastic, stretching to accommodate every unexpected circumstance. （议论文·制度·弹性）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：本义指物理弹性，引申指规则、计划可伸缩；句法/搭配：an elastic band，作定语。flexible 更常用于日常"灵活变通"之意。

synonyms.example: His rigid schedule left no room for surprises. 他刻板的日程容不下任何意外。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：flexible 的反义词之一，指人固执/规则安排不可变通，或物体硬而不易弯；句法/搭配：a rigid rule / structure。另一反义为 inflexible（同 rigid，更强调不肯变通）。

advancedExpressions.expression: be flexible about/with sth｜a flexible schedule / timetable｜flexible working hours｜remain / stay flexible｜flexible enough to do
advancedExpressions.example: Flexible about the timing and flexible enough to change plans, she was easy to work with. 时间上灵活、又足够能随机应变，她很好合作。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"灵活可变"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: flexible ≈ adaptable ≈ versatile ≈ elastic（反义 rigid / inflexible）
advancedExpressions.example: A flexible / adaptable mind copes better with change than a rigid one. 灵活／能适应的头脑比僵化的头脑更能应对变化。

advancedExpressions.expression: flexible→flexibility→flexibly；possible→possibility→possibly；responsible→responsibility→responsibly
advancedExpressions.example: Her flexibility allowed the team to adapt flexibly to every setback. 她的灵活性让团队能灵活应对每次挫折。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·wish + 从句(过去/could)表虚拟
advancedExpressions.expression: I wish sb. could be more flexible so that ...（wish 后接虚拟，could 表委婉愿望）
advancedExpressions.example: I wish they could be more flexible so that I can make my own choices. 我希望他们能更灵活些，好让我自己做选择。

advancedExpressions.expression: flexible yet firm, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Flexible yet firm, she adapted her methods to every child while never once bending on her core principle: no one would be left behind. （形容词短语前置 + yet 对比,续写塑造立体人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: it would be advisable to make ... more flexible so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It would be advisable to make the club's rules more flexible so that members with heavy academic loads can still take part. （it would be advisable to 委婉建议 + so that 目的状语,应用文标准句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who stay flexible ..., whereas those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who stay flexible in the face of change often turn crises into opportunities, whereas those who rigidly resist are swept aside by the tide of the times. （whereas 对比句 + 隐喻 tide of the times,议论文两面论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was flexible and changed her plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than clinging stubbornly to her original plan, she chose to stay flexible, reshaping her approach the instant she saw that the old one no longer served. （读后续写·抉择·成熟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 让步开篇对比僵化 + cling stubbornly 反衬灵活 + reshape 动词升级 + the instant 引导时间从句强化应变的敏捷

sentenceUpgrade.original: Being flexible is important in modern life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an age of relentless change, the capacity to remain flexible — to bend without breaking, to adapt without losing one's core — has become not merely an asset but a necessity for survival. （议论文·抽象升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In an age of 时代背景开篇 + capacity to remain flexible 名词化主语 + 破折号排比(bend without breaking, adapt without losing) + not merely...but 递进拔高结论

classPractice.question: 我们的计划必须足够变通，以满足每个人的需要。Our plans need to be ____ ____ ____ cater for the needs of everyone.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；flexible enough to do sth 足够灵活以做某事

classPractice.question: 如果你可以适应不同的房间位置，则可以省钱。You can save money if you're ____ ____ where your room is located.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；be flexible about sth 在某方面灵活变通 = be ready to adapt to different situations

classPractice.question: I wish they could be more flexible so that I can make my own choices, showing greater ____ (flexible) than they do now.
classPractice.note: 介词/形容词 greater 后需名词，flexible→flexibility（去 e 加 -ibility）。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（flexible / rigid）：Instead of sticking to a ____ plan, a wise leader stays ____ enough to change course.
classPractice.note: rigid（死板的）与 flexible（灵活的）为反义对照，据语境定唯一答案。

classPractice.question: 日期上我可以灵活安排。I can be ____ ____ the date if that helps you.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 be flexible about/with sth。

translation: 账户；描述；解释；认为是，视为
sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: Mama and Her Bank Account Every Saturday night Mama would sit down by the kitchen table and count out the money Papa had brought home.
readingExamples: Mama and Her Bank Account Every Saturday night Mama would sit down by the kitchen table and count out the money Papa had brought home.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a written or spoken description of an event, giving details of what happened
(2) n. an arrangement with a bank to keep your money there and take it out when you need it
(3) n. a record of the money a person or business has received and spent
(4) vt. to consider or regard someone or something in a particular way

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①【课件】描述，叙述（a full/vivid/detailed account of sth；give an account of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She gave the police a full account of the incident. 她向警方完整叙述了事件经过。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②【课件】account for：解释，说明（原因）；（数量/比例）占
uncommonMeanings.example: The poor weather may have accounted for the small crowd. 天气不好可能是人来得少的原因。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③【课件】认为是，视为（be accounted，较正式，常用被动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The event was accounted a success. 这次活动被认为是成功的。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④【课件】缘故，理由（on account of 因为；on no account 决不）
uncommonMeanings.example: Don't change your plans on my account. 别因为我而改变你的计划。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 银行账户（an arrangement with a bank）
uncommonMeanings.example: She opened a bank account. 她开了个银行账户。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 账目，账单（收支记录，常复数 accounts）
uncommonMeanings.example: Mama kept the family's accounts. 妈妈记着家里的账。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 描述，叙述（对某事经过的完整交代）
uncommonMeanings.example: He gave a full account of the accident. 他把事故经过完整讲述了一遍。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 缘故，理由（用于 on account of / on this account 等）
uncommonMeanings.example: On account of the sudden storm, the mountain rescue team was forced to abandon the search until dawn, though not a single member had wanted to turn back. （读后续写·山地救援）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: account for：解释；（数量/比例）占
uncommonMeanings.example: Farming accounts for 20% of the country's income. 农业占该国收入的20%。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 认为，视为（较正式，常用被动 be accounted）
uncommonMeanings.example: In that remote village, a man who could read and write was accounted a scholar, and the old teacher was treated with a reverence bordering on worship. （读后续写·乡村敬学）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling, the boy gave a breathless account of how he had dragged his little sister from the icy river, his voice cracking as the frozen memory came rushing back. （读后续写·英雄叙事）
Enclosed is a detailed account of the charity fund, listing every donation received and every yuan spent, so that all members may see exactly where their generosity has gone. （应用文·公开信）
History accounts him one of the greatest reformers of his age, yet in his own lifetime he was mocked, misunderstood and driven into exile. （议论文·历史人物评价）
Every Saturday my grandmother would open a battered notebook and count out the coins, keeping a faithful account of the family's meagre earnings. （读后续写·家庭记忆）

wordForms.noun: account (账户/描述/账目) / accountant (会计) / accounting (会计学) / accountability (问责，责任) / accountancy (会计工作)
wordForms.verb: account (account for 解释/占；be accounted 被视为)
wordForms.adjective: accountable (负有责任的，应作解释的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：account+-ant→accountant(会计师，人)，+-ing→accounting(会计学)，+-able→accountable(形)，+-ability→accountability(名，问责)；辨析 accountant(人) vs. accounting(学科)；固定搭配 account for≠account of：account for sth（解释/占比），an account of sth（对……的描述）。

idioms.example: A wise leader must take into account not only the profit of the moment but the well-being of generations yet unborn. （议论文·领导力）

idioms.translation: 决不，绝对不（否定副词置句首常倒装）
idioms.example: On no account should you reveal the surprise to Grandma before her birthday, whispered Mum, pressing a finger to her lips. （读后续写·对话/悬念）

idioms.idiom: give a good account of oneself
idioms.example: Though the youngest player on the pitch, Tom gave a good account of himself, chasing every ball as if the whole match rested on his shoulders. （读后续写·赛场拼搏）

collocations.phrase: give a full / vivid / detailed account of sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】对某事作完整/生动/详尽的描述、叙述
collocations.example: She gave the police a full account of the incident. 她向警方完整叙述了事件经过。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】叙述/说明某事（描述；也可指交代、解释）
collocations.example: He demanded that I (should) give an account of my failure. 他要求我说明我失败的原因。（课件原句，demand that 从句用虚拟 (should) do）

collocations.translation: 【课件】解释，说明（原因）；（数量/比例）占
collocations.example: The poor weather may have accounted for the small crowd. 天气不好可能是人来得少的原因。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】被认为是；被视为（较正式，常用被动）
collocations.example: In English law a man is accounted innocent until he is proved guilty. 依英国法律，一个人在被证明有罪之前被视为无罪。The event was accounted a success. 这次活动被认为是成功的。（课件原句）
Many obese children are bullied at school on account of their weight. 许多肥胖儿童因为其体重问题在学校受到欺负。Don't change your plans on my account. 别因为我而改变你的计划。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: on no account / not on any account
collocations.translation: 【课件】决不，绝对不（= not for any reason，用于强调；置句首句子部分倒装）
collocations.example: On no account should the house be left unlocked. 离开住宅时千万要锁门。I will never forgive him, not on any account. 我绝不会原谅他。（课件原句）
A wise plan takes every factor into account. 明智的计划会把每个因素都考虑在内。（课件搭配）
I've never been there, but it's a lovely place, by all accounts. 我从未去过那里，但据说是个美丽的地方。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】accountable 应负责的、需作解释的；accountant 会计
collocations.example: Someone must be held accountable for the traffic accident. 必须有人对这起交通事故负责。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 妈妈和她的银行账户（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Mama and Her Bank Account — Every Saturday night Mama would count out the money. 《妈妈和她的银行账户》——每个周六晚上妈妈都会把钱数出来。
She gave a vivid account of the flood. 她生动地描述了那场洪水。
The day I opened my first bank account, my father handed me a single coin and said the rest was up to me. （读后续写·成长节点）
At the end of each month Mama would settle the accounts at the kitchen table, her brow furrowed over every last cent. （读后续写·家庭生计）

collocations.translation: 追究某人责任，要某人担责
collocations.example: A truly just society holds its powerful to account, refusing to let wealth or status place anyone above the law. （议论文·公平正义）
To the proud minister the beggar's plea seemed of no account, yet that single dismissal would one day cost him everything. （读后续写·因果转折）

collocations.translation: 解释；（比例）占；说明……的原因
collocations.example: How do you account for his sudden absence? 你怎么解释他的突然缺席？

collocations.phrase: take sth into account / take account of sth
collocations.example: We must take the cost into account. 我们必须把成本考虑进去。
Her diary offered a vivid account of the flood, so lifelike that readers could almost hear the water clawing at the doors. （读后续写·灾难叙事）

synonyms.example: The witness's calm description of the accident helped the police piece together exactly what had happened. （应用文·报告）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：description 泛指对人、物、场景的客观描绘；句法/搭配：a description of sth。account 更强调对某一事件经过的完整叙述，常含亲历色彩（give an account of）。

synonyms.example: The captain kept a meticulous record of every storm the ship weathered on its long voyage home. （读后续写·航海）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：record 侧重书面留存的资料/数据，可查证；句法/搭配：keep a record of sth。account 侧重讲述的过程（可口头或书面），或指账目/银行账户。

synonyms.example: The committee considered her proposal both bold and practical, and approved it at once. （应用文·会议纪要）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：consider 是最常用的"认为"，口笔语皆宜；句法/搭配：consider sb/sth (to be) + n./adj.。account（作"认为"）偏正式书面、略显古典，多用被动 be accounted。

synonyms.example: Can you explain why the results differ so much? 你能解释为什么结果差这么多吗？
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：explain 直接接宾语或从句表"解释"；句法/搭配：explain sth (to sb) / explain that...。account 表"解释"须接 for（account for sth），且还能表"占比例"。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·让步状语从句（疑问词 + ever = no matter ...）
advancedExpressions.expression: "疑问词 + ever" 引导让步状语从句，等于 "no matter + 疑问词"；whatever/whichever/whoever/whenever/wherever 在从句中作成分（体现代词/副词特征）
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever happened, we always knew we still had the Bank to depend upon.（= No matter what happened）无论发生什么，我们始终知道还有银行可以依靠。（课件原句 + 语法讲解）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·疑问词+ever 引导名词性从句（= anyone who / anything that）
advancedExpressions.expression: "疑问词 + ever" 还可引导名词性从句（主语/宾语从句），此时不能用 "no matter + 疑问词"替代，相当于 anyone who / anything that
advancedExpressions.example: Whoever (= Anyone who) gets the job will have lots of work to do. 得到这份工作的人将有很多事要做。I'll do whatever (= anything that) you ask me to do. 你要我做什么我都会做。（课件原句·两种用法对比）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·让步状语从句（疑问词+ever 翻译）
advancedExpressions.expression: Whenever/Whoever ... = No matter when/who ...（引导让步状从）；whoever is in charge of ...（引导名词性从句作宾语）
advancedExpressions.example: Whenever (No matter when) I fell down, I always knew I still had the courage to stand up. 无论何时我跌倒，我总知道自己还有站起来的勇气。I would like to have a talk with whoever is in charge of the company. 我想和任何一位负责你们公司的人谈谈。（课件翻译原句）

advancedExpressions.expression: account for（解释/占比）｜an account of（描述）｜take sth into account（考虑）｜on account of（由于）｜on no account（决不，倒装）｜by all accounts（据说）
advancedExpressions.example: Taking every factor into account, we called it off on account of the storm. 把每个因素都考虑在内后，我们因风暴取消了它。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（account for 表"解释原因"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: account for sth ≈ explain sth ≈ give the reason(s) for sth ≈ throw light on sth
advancedExpressions.example: This new theory accounts for / explains why prices rose so fast. 这个新理论解释了物价为何涨得这么快。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表"占比例"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: account for X% ≈ make up X% ≈ take up X% ≈ constitute X%
advancedExpressions.example: Renewable energy accounts for / makes up nearly a third of the total. 可再生能源占了总量的近三分之一。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·on no account 置句首倒装
advancedExpressions.expression: On no account + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语（否定副词提前，部分倒装）
advancedExpressions.example: On no account should you tell anyone. 你绝不能告诉任何人。

advancedExpressions.expression: on no account + 倒装, ... or ...
advancedExpressions.example: On no account was he to look back, the old man had warned — or the door to the past would slam shut forever. （否定副词提前倒装+破折号制造悬念，续写埋伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: enclosed is a full account of ..., so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Enclosed is a full account of how the funds were used, so that every donor may rest assured that their kindness bore fruit. （倒装开头+目的状语，透明说明）

advancedExpressions.expression: several factors account for ...; chief among them is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Several factors account for the nation's rapid rise; chief among them is an unshakeable faith in the power of education. （主谓框架+同位强调最重要因素）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He told us what had happened.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Between ragged breaths, he poured out a broken account of what had happened, each word tumbling faster than the last, until the whole terrible scene stood before us as vividly as if we had been there ourselves. （读后续写·紧张叙述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 伴随状语(Between ragged breaths)营造气喘状态 + poured out生动动词 + each word tumbling现在分词 + as vividly as if虚拟比喻

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should think about the risks.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before rushing to a decision, we would be wise to take into account the hidden risks that lie beneath so promising a surface, for what glitters is not always gold. （议论文·审慎论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Before + 动名词状语开头 + would be wise to委婉建议 + take into account固定短语 + for引导原因分句 + 谚语化尾句(glitters...gold)

classPractice.question: 用 account 的相关短语完成句子：She ____ ____ ____ (描述) of what she saw in China.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；give an account of sth 描述/叙述某事

classPractice.question: 用 account 的相关短语完成句子：The plane didn't take off on time ____ ____ ____ (因为) the bad weather.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；on account of = 因为，由于（后接名词）

classPractice.question: 用 account 的相关短语完成句子：____ ____ ____ (决不) will you miss the chance.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；on no account 置句首，句子部分倒装（will you），意为"决不"

classPractice.question: 用 account 的相关短语完成句子：The nurse was unable to ____ ____ (解释) the disappearance of the patients that were under her care.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；account for sth 解释/说明某事的原因

classPractice.question: 用 account 的短语填空：Online sales now ____ ____ nearly half of the company's total income.（占……比例）
classPractice.note: account for + 数字/比例 = 占……；此处表比例，主语第三人称复数用 account。

classPractice.question: Before making the final plan, we must take the students' different needs into ____.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 take sth into account = 考虑到；亦可写 take account of sth。

classPractice.note: on no account 置句首，句子部分倒装（should you），意为"决不"。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（account for / an account of）：The witness gave ____ ____ what she had seen, which helped police ____ ____ the strange fire.
classPractice.note: an account of sth＝对……的描述；account for sth＝解释……的原因，注意二者不可混。

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: "For the rent." Mama would count out the big silver pieces.
readingExamples: "For the rent." Mama would count out the big silver pieces.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a regular amount of money that you pay to use a house, room, etc. that belongs to someone else
(2) vt. to pay money regularly in order to use a house, car, etc. that belongs to someone else
(3) vt. to allow someone to use a house, car, etc. in return for regular payment (often rent out)
(4) vi. (of property) to be available for renting at a stated price

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 裂口，裂缝（rend“撕裂”的过去式/过去分词转化的名词，文学用法；与“租金”义同形异源，勿混）
uncommonMeanings.example: Through a great rent in the storm clouds a single shaft of sunlight fell, striking the drowned village like a blessing long delayed. （读后续写·灾后景物·希望隐喻）

posExamples.sentence: When the landlord raised the rent yet again, Mama's smile did not falter; she simply took up more sewing and stayed awake an hour longer each night. （读后续写·母爱坚韧）
Since our own hall was under repair, I am writing to ask whether your community could kindly let us rent your auditorium for the coming charity concert. （应用文·请求信）
The old widow rented out the upstairs room to a penniless student, asking not for money but only that he read to her each evening. （读后续写·温情人物）
Those who argue that soaring rents drive young talent from the cities overlook a deeper truth: it is opportunity, not cheap housing, that ultimately holds a generation in place. （议论文·城市与青年）

wordForms.other: tenant (n. 租户); landlord/landlady (n. 房东)。易错拼写：rent 双写吗？不需要，rented/renting 直接加。区分 rent（租）与 rend（撕裂，过去式 rent），拼写相近勿混。

collocations.example: They rented two rooms from an old widow. 他们从一位老寡妇处租了两间房。（课件搭配）
She rents out two rooms to students. 她把两间房出租给学生。（课件原句）
I do have a room for rent. 我确实有一间房要出租。（课件原句）
I cannot even afford to pay the rent on this flat. 我甚至连这套公寓的房租都付不起。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】rent 作名词指租金、租用费（= rental）
collocations.example: "For the rent." Mama would count out the big silver pieces. "这是交房租的。"妈妈会数出那些大银币。（课文/课件原句）

collocations.translation: 用来交房租（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: "For the rent." Mama would count out the big silver pieces. 妈妈会数出那些大银币，说："这是交房租的。"（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 供出租（美式；英式常用 to let）
collocations.example: The sign said the flat was for rent. 招牌上写着这套公寓供出租。
As we could not afford a hotel, we rented a small seaside flat for the summer and cooked our own meals to save every yuan. （读后续写·旅行）
When the greedy owner threatened to raise the rent, the whole street of tenants stood together and refused to be driven out. （读后续写·邻里团结）
In gratitude for the boy's honesty, the old shopkeeper offered his family the back room rent-free for a whole year. （读后续写·善有善报）
The monthly rent alone swallowed half of Papa's wages, and yet Mama never once let us feel the pinch. （读后续写·家庭生计）
They rented out the spare room to a student. 他们把空房间租给了一个学生。

synonyms.translation: 租用，租借（英式，多指短期）
synonyms.example: We hired bicycles for the afternoon and wound our way through the old town's narrow lanes. （读后续写·旅行）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：英式英语中 hire 多指短期租用（自行车、礼服、设备）；rent 多指较长期租用房屋、车辆，美式则一律用 rent。句法/搭配：hire a car / hire a dress / hire out（出租）；作宾语多为可短期使用之物。

synonyms.translation: 租赁（长期，通常有正式合同）
synonyms.example: The company leased the entire top floor of the tower under a ten-year contract. （应用文·商务）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：lease 强调有正式书面合同的长期租赁，法律色彩浓；rent 更口语、更日常，长短皆可。句法/搭配：lease sth (from/to) sb、a ten-year lease（n. 租约）；既可作动词也可作名词。

synonyms.translation: 出租（英式，等于 rent out）
synonyms.example: The notice on the door read simply 'Flat to Let', promising a fresh start to whoever answered it. （读后续写·环境）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：let（out）是英式"出租"，站在房东角度；rent 既可指承租也可指出租，语义更宽。句法/搭配：a house to let（供出租）、let a flat to sb；过去式和过去分词均为 let。

advancedExpressions.expression: for rent（供出租）/ rent out（出租给他人）/ pay the rent（付房租）/ raise the rent（涨租）/ rent-free（免租）
advancedExpressions.example: The room upstairs was for rent, so the widow rented it out to a poor student, who paid the rent late but was never once turned away. （一句串联 for rent → rent out → pay the rent）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·租用（供替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: rent = hire（英式短期）= lease（长期合同）= let / let out（英式出租）
advancedExpressions.example: You may rent / lease / hire an apartment depending on how long you plan to stay. （据租期长短挑词，正式度递增）

advancedExpressions.expression: when the rent came due, ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: When the rent came due and the purse lay empty, Mama did not despair; instead she rolled up her sleeves and worked through the night. （时间状语制造压力+yet转折突出品格）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to ask whether we might rent ... for the purpose of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to ask whether we might rent your hall for the purpose of hosting a book fair that will benefit the whole neighbourhood. （委婉请求句式+目的状语，礼貌得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: soaring rents are more than ...; they are ...
advancedExpressions.example: Soaring rents in our great cities are more than an economic burden; they are a quiet force reshaping where a whole generation dares to dream. （递进否定+隐喻，透视现象本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They could not pay the rent, so they were worried.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With the rent long overdue and the landlord's footsteps already echoing on the stairs, the whole family sat frozen in silence, each pretending to read yet hearing only the loud drumming of their own hearts. （读后续写·紧张氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With独立主格营造背景压力 + 拟声(echoing/drumming) + each pretending现在分词 + yet对比表里 + 心理外化(drumming of hearts)

sentenceUpgrade.original: House rents are too high, and young people find it hard.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导伴随状语 + climb to dizzying heights拟人化 + ever more比较级递进 + crushed beneath the weight隐喻具象化抽象压力

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered.
readingExamples: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a shop that sells food and other things used in the home (often grocery store / grocer's)
(2) n. (groceries) the food and other goods sold in such a shop, especially the ones you buy for your home
(3) n. (uncountable, esp. AmE) the business of selling food and household goods

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（单数）食品杂货店（= grocery store / grocer's）
uncommonMeanings.example: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered. （课文即此义，指杂货店这一场所）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（复数 groceries）食品杂货，家用食品和日用品
uncommonMeanings.example: She spent half her wages on groceries that week. 那一周她把半数工资花在了日用食品上。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（不可数，尤美式）食品杂货零售业
uncommonMeanings.example: He made his fortune in grocery before opening a chain of stores. 他先在杂货零售业发家，之后才开了连锁店。

posExamples.sentence: The bell above the grocery door tinkled as Nels stepped in, and the warm smell of fresh bread and coffee wrapped around him like an old friend's welcome. （读后续写·温馨场景）
We warmly invite every family in our community to donate non-perishable groceries, so that no elderly neighbour will face the coming winter with an empty shelf. （应用文·倡议书）
Some dismiss a part-time job at the local grocery as beneath an ambitious student, yet such humble work often teaches lessons no textbook ever could. （议论文·劳动教育）
Clutching the crumpled shopping list, the little girl weaved between the towering grocery shelves, determined to buy her mother's birthday flour all by herself. （读后续写·童年勇气）

wordForms.other: grocer (n. 杂货店老板)。单复数特例：单数 grocery 多指"杂货店"这一场所；复数 groceries 才表"买回的食品杂货"，两义勿混。拼写：-y 变复数去 y 加 ies → groceries。

collocations.translation: 在迪伦的杂货店里（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered. "放学后我要去迪伦的杂货店干活。"内尔斯主动说道。（课文原句）
After school Nels worked at Dillon's grocery store, stacking tins until his arms ached, yet whistling all the while. （读后续写·勤劳少年）

Every Saturday morning it fell to me to do the grocery shopping, and I took a secret pride in bringing home the best bargains. （读后续写·家庭责任）
Mama pressed a grocery list and a few worn coins into my palm, trusting me, for the first time, to bring the family's supper home. （读后续写·信任成长）
On my way home I stopped to pick up a few groceries, never guessing that this small errand would change the course of my evening. （读后续写·转折铺垫）
He insisted on carrying the heavy groceries up all five flights of stairs for the frail old woman next door. （读后续写·助人为乐）
A single bag of groceries, quietly left on the doorstep of the struggling family, spoke louder than any words of comfort. （读后续写·无声善意）

synonyms.example: The bright, humming supermarket at the corner had long since drawn customers away from the little family shop. （读后续写·时代变迁）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：supermarket 指大型自助超市；grocery(store) 多指规模较小、卖食品杂货的商店，年代感、社区感更强。句法/搭配：at the supermarket / a supermarket trolley；作场所名词。

synonyms.example: Before the long crossing, the sailors loaded enough provisions to last three cold months at sea. （读后续写·航海）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：provisions 较正式、书面，指为旅途或长期储备的食物；groceries 指日常从商店买回的家用食品，更口语化。句法/搭配：常用复数 provisions，load / stock up provisions。

advancedExpressions.expression: a grocery store（杂货店）/ do the grocery shopping（采购食品）/ a grocery list（购物清单）/ a bag of groceries（一袋杂货）
advancedExpressions.example: Clutching a grocery list, she went to the grocery store, filled a bag of groceries, and headed home. （一句串联 list → store → groceries）

advancedExpressions.expression: grocer（杂货商）+ -y（场所/行业名词后缀）→ grocery（杂货店／杂货业）
advancedExpressions.example: 同类：bake→bakery（面包店）、brew→brewery（酿酒厂）、laundr-→laundry（洗衣店），-y/-ery 表示场所或行业。

advancedExpressions.expression: the smell of ... drifted from the grocery, and ...

advancedExpressions.example: Far from being trivial, honest work behind a grocery counter can forge the patience and humility that lie at the heart of every worthy character. （Far from否定前置+抽象升华）

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: It gave us such a warm, secure feeling.
readingExamples: It gave us such a warm, secure feeling.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. feeling happy and confident about yourself or a situation, without worry or fear
(2) adj. safe and protected from danger, loss, or harm
(3) adj. firmly fixed and not likely to move, fall, or fail
(4) vt. to get or achieve something, especially after a lot of effort
(5) vt. to make something safe or firmly fixed

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①【课件】安心的，无忧虑的（feel secure about；secure in the knowledge that）
uncommonMeanings.example: She finished the match, secure in the knowledge that she was through to the next round. 她打完比赛，知道自己已进入下一轮，心里踏实了。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②【课件】可靠的，稳定的（certain/safe，a secure job/income）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was lucky to have a secure job. 他有一份稳定的工作，很幸运。（课件搭配）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③【课件】（经过努力）获得，取得（secure a place / contract / deal）
uncommonMeanings.example: He secured a place for himself at law school. 他被法学院录取了。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（历经努力后）获得，取得（正式，高考高频熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: After months of tireless practice and countless rejections, she finally secured a place in the national orchestra, and only then did the tears she had held back come flooding out. （读后续写·梦想达成）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②把……固定牢，拴牢，使安全
uncommonMeanings.example: He secured the small boat to the crumbling pier with trembling hands, praying the frayed rope would hold against the rising tide. （读后续写·危急时刻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③安心的，无忧虑的（课文即此义）
uncommonMeanings.example: It gave us such a warm, secure feeling. （课文原句，指心理上的踏实）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④安全的，受保护的；牢固的，不会松脱倒塌的
uncommonMeanings.example: Make sure the ladder is secure before you climb. 爬之前先确认梯子稳固。

posExamples.sentence: Wrapped in Mama's old shawl and lulled by the crackle of the fire, the children felt so warm and secure that the howling storm outside seemed a world away. （读后续写·家庭温情）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua, whose diligence and integrity, I firmly believe, will help him secure the scholarship he so richly deserves. （应用文·推荐信）
A nation is truly strong not when its borders are secure, but when every child within them can grow up free from fear and full of hope. （议论文·国家与民生）
Only by working shoulder to shoulder can nations secure a future in which prosperity is shared rather than seized. （议论文·合作共赢）

wordForms.other: insecure (adj. 不安的); insecurity (n. 不安全)。构词：前缀 in- 表"不"；名词 security 去 e 加 ity。注意 secure 一词身兼形容词与动词，靠句法判断词性（feel secure 形容词 / secure a job 动词）。

collocations.example: People want to feel secure about the future of their country. 人们希望对自己国家的未来感到安心。（课件原句）
She finished the match, secure in the knowledge that she was through to the next round. 她打完比赛，知道自己已进入下一轮，心里踏实了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】稳定的工作／收入（可靠的，certain/safe）
collocations.example: He was lucky to have a secure job and a secure income. 他有一份稳定的工作和收入，很幸运。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】secure 作"牢固的"义，副词 securely 意为牢牢地、稳固地
collocations.example: Make sure the ropes are securely fastened. 务必把绳子拴牢。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（经过努力）获得名额/合同；达成协议（熟词僻义 v.）
collocations.example: He secured a place for himself at law school. / He secured himself a place at law school. 他被法学院录取了。（课件原句；secure a contract / deal 达成协议）

collocations.translation: 【课件】secure 的反义词，前缀 in- 表"不"
collocations.example: The future of the company looks insecure. 公司的前景看起来不稳定。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】安全感（security = 感到安全幸福的状态）
collocations.example: Parents are encouraged to give their children love and a sense of security. 鼓励父母给予孩子爱与安全感。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】国家安全；安全检查（security = 保护国家的安全工作）
collocations.example: They carried out security checks at the airport. 他们在机场实行了安全检查。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 一种温暖而安心的感觉（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It gave us such a warm, secure feeling. 它给了我们一种如此温暖、安心的感觉。（课文原句）
Held tightly in her father's arms, the frightened child gradually stopped trembling and, at last, felt secure. （读后续写·亲情安抚）
Mama's careful saving, coin by coin, made us feel financially secure even in the leanest of winters. （读后续写·家庭理财）
Before the hurricane struck, the villagers rushed to make every door and window secure. （读后续写·灾前防备）
To secure the support of the whole class, she explained her plan patiently, answering every doubt with a smile. （应用文·活动组织）
Years of honest labour had laid a secure foundation on which the family could at last build their dreams. （议论文/读后续写·奋斗）
The old sailor kept the faded photograph secure inside his coat, close to the heart it had never left. （读后续写·情感物件）
Sturdy dykes were built to secure the low-lying town against the fury of the spring floods. （议论文/说明·防灾）

collocations.translation: 获得工作／名额／胜利（熟词僻义 v.）
collocations.example: After months of interviews he finally secured a job at the hospital. 面试数月后，他终于谋得了医院的一份工作。

synonyms.example: Not until the last child was safe on the riverbank did the exhausted teacher allow herself to collapse. （读后续写·师者大爱）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：safe 泛指"无危险的"，最常用；secure 强调受到保护而"稳固可靠、令人安心"，也可指心理上的踏实感，语气更强。句法/搭配：safe and sound 安然无恙 / keep sb safe；作表语或定语皆可。

synonyms.example: After years of research she finally obtained the results that would rewrite the textbook. （议论文·科研）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：obtain 是正式的"得到"，中性；secure（作动词）强调"历经努力后争取到"，含来之不易之意。句法/搭配：obtain / secure a job / a place / support；secure 后接的宾语常是竞争得来的资源。

synonyms.example: He fastened the child's seat belt and checked it twice before starting the car. （读后续写·细心）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：fasten 具体指系、扣、拴等固定动作；secure（作"固定"）更强调"确保牢固、防止松脱"，程度更重、更正式。句法/搭配：fasten your seat belt / secure sth to sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: feel secure（感到安心）/ financially secure（经济有保障）/ secure a job（谋得工作，v.）/ make sth secure（使牢固）/ secure sth against（保护……免受）
advancedExpressions.example: Only when he secured a steady job did the family feel financially secure at last. （一句展示 secure 由"获得"义到"安心"义的呼应）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·获得（供替换，v.）
advancedExpressions.expression: secure = obtain = gain = win = land（口语，谋得）
advancedExpressions.example: She worked hard to secure / obtain / gain a place at her dream university. （"努力争取到"皆可替换，正式度略有差异）

advancedExpressions.expression: in-（否定前缀）+ secure → insecure（不安的）；secur- + -ity → security（安全，n.）
advancedExpressions.example: 同类否定前缀：in-（incorrect）、im-（impossible）、il-（illegal）、ir-（irregular），据后接词首字母而变。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time in years, sb. felt truly secure
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time in years, wrapped in her grandmother's arms, she felt truly secure — as though the whole weary world had finally set down its burden. （时间状语反差+破折号补充比喻，情感落点）

advancedExpressions.expression: his ... will surely help him secure ...
advancedExpressions.example: His unwavering diligence and warm heart will surely help him secure not only this position but the respect of all who work beside him. （not only...but递进，推荐信有力收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: true security lies not in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True security lies not in the walls we build around ourselves, but in the trust and kindness we build between one another. （not...but对照+隐喻，深化"安全"的内涵）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The warm home made us feel safe and happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Bathed in the amber glow of the oil lamp and cradled by the low hum of Mama's lullaby, we felt so warm and secure that no storm, however fierce, could ever reach us there. （读后续写·家庭温情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词并列开头(Bathed/cradled) + 感官意象(amber glow/low hum) + so...that结果状语 + however fierce让步插入语强化对比
