sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: When Nels graduated from grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school.
readingExamples: When Nels graduated from grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to complete a course of study at a school, college, or university and receive a degree or diploma
(2) n. a person who has completed a course of study, especially at a university
(3) vi. (graduate to / from) to move up to a more advanced or more difficult level or position
(4) vt. (formal) to arrange or mark something in regular divisions or degrees

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（从学校）毕业（graduate from，课文即此义）
uncommonMeanings.example: When Nels graduated from grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school. （课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②毕业生（尤指大学毕业生）；a graduate of + 学校
uncommonMeanings.example: As a distinguished graduate of this school, she returned to give the opening speech. 作为本校杰出毕业生，她回来致开幕辞。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③逐步升级，进阶到（更高层次）（graduate to / from ... to ...，高考爱考的引申义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Starting with a battered second-hand bicycle, the boy patiently graduated to a real racing bike, and at last to the winner's podium he had once only dreamed of. （读后续写·励志进阶）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（把量具等）刻上刻度，分等级（正式）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old scientist carefully graduated the glass tube, marking each fine line as though the fate of the whole experiment depended on it. （读后续写·科研匠心）

posExamples.sentence: The morning Nels graduated from grammar school, he stood a little taller, his eyes already fixed on the high school gates that had once seemed impossibly far away. （读后续写·成长节点）
As a recent graduate of this very school, I am writing to encourage every junior student to treasure these precious years before they slip, as mine did, through your fingers. （应用文·倡议信/寄语）
Those who insist that a diploma alone guarantees success forget a simple truth: what you become after you graduate matters far more than the day you do. （议论文·教育与成长）
We are honoured to invite Ms. Wang, a distinguished graduate and now a celebrated surgeon, to address our graduating class this June. （应用文·邀请函）

wordForms.other: postgraduate / undergraduate (n. 研究生／本科生); graduated (adj. 有刻度的)。发音区别：动词 /ˈɡrædʒueɪt/，名词/形容词 /ˈɡrædʒuət/，词尾读音不同。构词：post-（在…之后）+ graduate = postgraduate；under-（在…之下/未…）+ graduate = undergraduate。搭配注意：graduate 是不及物动词，"从…毕业"须加 from，切勿说 graduate the school。

collocations.example: When Nels graduated from grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school. 当内尔斯从文法学校毕业时，他想继续上高中。（课文/课件原句）
She graduated in law from Peking University. 她以法律专业从北京大学毕业。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】under-（在…之下/未…）+ graduate，指大学本科生
collocations.example: As an undergraduate, he already published two papers. 还是本科生时，他就已发表了两篇论文。（课件构词）

collocations.translation: 【课件】post-（在…之后）+ graduate，指硕士或博士研究生
collocations.example: After college she became a postgraduate in physics. 大学毕业后她成了物理学的研究生。（课件构词）
Upon graduation, she was offered the position of treasurer. 一毕业，她就获得了司库一职。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 从文法学校毕业（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When Nels graduated from grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school. 当内尔斯从文法学校毕业时，他想继续上高中。（课文原句）
At the graduation ceremony, the old headmaster's voice trembled as he shook, one by one, the hands he had guided for so long. （读后续写·师生情）
After college she went straight on to graduate school to study law. 大学毕业后她直接进了研究生院攻读法律。

collocations.phrase: graduate with a degree / with honours
collocations.translation: 获得学位／以优异成绩毕业
collocations.example: Against every expectation, the once-failing student graduated with honours, silencing all who had written him off. （读后续写·逆袭）
As a recent graduate, I still remember how terrifying and thrilling it felt to step, unprotected, into the wide world. （应用文·经验分享）
A proud graduate of this school, she never forgot the teacher who had first believed in her. （读后续写·感恩）
From copying a single line of code, the curious boy graduated to writing programs that would one day astonish his teachers. （读后续写·成长进阶）
On the day she graduated from university, Mama wept openly, for she had sold her wedding ring years ago to keep her daughter in school. （读后续写·母爱牺牲）
The village celebrated its first university graduate as if he had brought home not a diploma but the sunrise itself. （读后续写·乡村荣光）

synonyms.example: After two gruelling years, he finally qualified as a doctor and returned to serve the mountain village of his birth. （读后续写·学成归乡）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：qualify 强调通过考核取得从事某职业的资格；graduate 侧重完成学业、从学校毕业，未必立刻具备职业资格。句法/搭配：qualify as a doctor / qualify for（有资格获得）；graduate from（学校）。

synonyms.example: Step by step, her spoken English progressed from halting phrases to confident speeches. （读后续写·语言成长）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：progress 是普通的"进步、前进"；graduate to 特指"上升到更高一级的水平/阶段"，隐含一个可分辨的等级跃迁。句法/搭配：progress from ... to ... / graduate to sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: graduate from（从…毕业）/ graduate with honours（以优异成绩毕业）/ graduate school（研究生院）/ a graduate of（…的毕业生）/ graduate to（进阶到）
advancedExpressions.example: A graduate of this very school, she graduated with honours and later went on to graduate school abroad. （一句串联 graduate 名词、动词、进阶多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: under-（未／低于）+ graduate → undergraduate（本科生）；post-（在…之后）+ graduate → postgraduate（研究生）；graduate + -ion → graduation（毕业，n.）
advancedExpressions.example: 同类前缀：postwar（战后）、underground（地下的）、underestimate（低估），前缀 post-/under- 表时间或程度。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·graduate 不及物 + from
advancedExpressions.expression: graduate from + 学校（不可直接跟宾语）
advancedExpressions.example: 误：He graduated the university. 正：He graduated from the university. （graduate 为不及物动词，"从…毕业"必须加介词 from）

advancedExpressions.expression: the day sb. graduated marked not an ending but ...
advancedExpressions.example: The day she graduated marked not an ending but the first uncertain step onto a road she would have to build with her own two hands. （not...but对照+隐喻，转折点升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: as a graduate of this school, I urge you to ...
advancedExpressions.example: As a graduate of this very school, I urge you to seize each fleeting day, for the years here are gone before you know their worth. （身份+呼吁，寄语真挚）

advancedExpressions.expression: to graduate is not the destination but ...
advancedExpressions.example: To graduate is not the destination but the doorway; what truly defines us is the road we choose once the cheering fades. （否定同一+隐喻，深化教育意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: When he graduated, his family was very proud of him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment he crossed the stage to graduate, his weathered parents rose together in the crowd, and in their brimming eyes he read a whole lifetime of sacrifice quietly, gloriously repaid. （读后续写·感恩场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment引导时间状语从句 + 细节(weathered parents/brimming eyes) + read...repaid隐喻情感外化 + 副词并列(quietly, gloriously)节奏

sentenceUpgrade.original: Graduating from school is not the end of learning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To graduate, far from being the end of one's education, is merely to close one book and open a far vaster one whose pages we must write ourselves. （议论文·终身学习）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式作主语(To graduate) + far from being插入否定 + close one book/open another平行隐喻 + 定语从句(whose pages)升华主动学习

classPractice.question: 根据提示用 graduate 的适当形式：All three were ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ (同一所大学的毕业生).
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a graduate of + 学校，此处主语复数用 graduates

classPractice.type: 语境应用·单句语法填空
classPractice.question: Upon __________ (graduate), she was offered the position of treasurer of the school.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；upon/on + 名词，用名词 graduation（一……就……）

classPractice.question: After ____ ____ (从…毕业) Peking University, the young man volunteered to work in Tibet.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；介词 After 后接动名词，graduate from（从…毕业）→ graduating from

classPractice.question: When Nels graduated ____ grammar school, he wanted to go on to high school.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；graduate 是不及物动词，"从…毕业"须加介词 from

classPractice.question: 作为本校应届毕业生，我想给学弟学妹们一些建议。As a recent ____ of this school, I'd like to give some advice to the younger students.
classPractice.note: 此处作名词"毕业生"，读音 /ˈɡrædʒuət/；a graduate of + 学校

classPractice.question: The whole family attended her ____ (graduate) ceremony with tears of joy.
classPractice.note: graduation ceremony 毕业典礼；此处需名词作定语

translation: 聚集，集合；收拢；搜集，收集；聚集
sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: Eagerly we gathered around the table.
readingExamples: Eagerly we gathered around the table.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to come together in a group; to assemble in one place
(2) vt. to bring together people or things, often from different places
(3) vt. to collect information, facts, or things gradually over a period of time
(4) vt. to increase gradually in speed, force, or strength (e.g. gather speed / momentum)
(5) vt. to understand or conclude something from what someone has said or from the facts

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①聚集，集合（人群聚拢一处，课文即此义 gather around）
uncommonMeanings.example: Eagerly we gathered around the table. （课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②搜集，收集（信息、资料、散落之物）
uncommonMeanings.example: She gathered the scattered papers from the floor. 她把散落一地的文件收拢起来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③推断，认为，领会（常用 I gather / as far as I can gather，高考阅读高频熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: From the tremor in her voice and the letter she quickly hid, I gathered that something had gone terribly wrong at home. （读后续写·察言观色）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（渐渐）积聚，增强（gather speed / strength / courage）
uncommonMeanings.example: The runaway sledge gathered speed with every heartbeat, and the boy clung on, the wind tearing tears from his wide, terrified eyes. （读后续写·惊险时刻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤把（衣物）拉拢，将（布料）打褶
uncommonMeanings.example: Mama gathered her thin coat tightly around her against the biting wind and pressed on through the snow. （读后续写·风雪坚韧）

posExamples.sentence: Eagerly we gathered around the kitchen table, our small faces glowing in the lamplight, each waiting breathlessly for Mama to open the little tin bank. （读后续写·家庭温情）
We sincerely invite all volunteers to gather at the school gate this Saturday morning, where together we will bring warmth to the lonely elderly of our town. （应用文·倡议书）
Before rushing to any conclusion, a wise thinker first gathers the facts, weighs the evidence, and only then dares to speak. （议论文·理性思考）
Taking a deep breath, she gathered every ounce of courage she had left and stepped onto the stage before a thousand waiting faces. （读后续写·鼓起勇气）

wordForms.other: gathering (n. 聚会，集会；a family gathering 家庭聚会)。拼写：gather 以 -er 结尾，重读在前音节，加 -ing/-ed 不双写 → gathering / gathered。注意 gather 既可作不及物（人聚集）也可作及物（收集某物），据宾语判断。

idioms.example: She paused at the doorway to gather her thoughts, knowing that the words she chose next might change everything between them. （读后续写·关键抉择）

idioms.idiom: a rolling stone gathers no moss
idioms.translation: 滚石不生苔（谚语，喻常变动者难有积累）
idioms.example: Grandfather liked to say that a rolling stone gathers no moss, urging me to stay the course when my resolve began to waver. （议论文/读后续写·坚持）

collocations.translation: 【课件】聚集，集合（= come together 人聚拢一处）
collocations.example: Gather round, everyone, so that you can see the screen. 大家围拢过来，这样就都能看到屏幕了。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把……收拢／整理到一起（= bring sth together = collect）
collocations.example: I gathered up the paper and went to the door. 我把纸张收拢起来，走向门口。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】搜集证据／收集资料（vt. 搜集，收集）
collocations.example: Detectives have spent months gathering evidence. 侦探们花了几个月搜集证据。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】加快速度／积满灰尘（vt. 积聚，增加）
collocations.example: The truck gathered speed. 卡车加快了速度。Thousands of these machines are gathering dust in stockrooms. 数千台这样的机器在储藏室里尘封已久（弃置不用）。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】泪水盈眶／天色渐暗／乌云聚集（vt. 积聚，增加）
collocations.example: Tears gathered in her eyes. 她眼泪盈眶。Darkness was gathering. 天色渐暗。The storm clouds were gathering. 暴风雨的乌云正在聚集。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】集中精神／喘口气歇息／积蓄力量
collocations.example: She was still trying to gather her thoughts when the door opened. 门打开时她还在努力集中精神。He gathered all his strength for a tremendous leap. 他积攒起全部力量纵身一跃。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】使自己镇定下来，稳住心神（= prepare oneself to do sth）
collocations.example: Fortunately the short delay gave him time to gather himself. 幸好这短暂的耽搁给了他镇定心神的时间。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: gather sb in one's arms / gather sth around
collocations.translation: 【课件】把某人拢过来抱在怀里／用……把身子裹紧（vt. 收紧，拢住）
collocations.example: He gathered his cloak around him. 他用披风把身子裹紧。She gathered the child in her arms and held him close. 她把那孩子拢过来紧紧抱在怀里。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】家庭聚会（n. gathering 聚会）
collocations.example: The three sisters decided to take turns to host family gatherings in their own home. 姐妹三人决定轮流在各自家里主办家庭聚会。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 围拢到桌旁（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Eagerly we gathered around the table. 我们急切地围拢到桌子旁。（课文原句）
As night fell, the whole village gathered round the fire, and the old storyteller's voice wove magic into the dark. （读后续写·温情场景）

collocations.translation: 我推断／我听说……（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: I gather that you've decided to leave. 我推断你已决定要走了。
For weeks the young journalist patiently gathered information, refusing to publish a single line until every fact stood firm. （议论文·求真）
The small campaign, once ignored, gathered momentum until it swept through the entire school like wildfire. （读后续写·运动壮大）
It took her a long, trembling minute to gather the courage to knock on the door she had avoided for years. （读后续写·和解）
Wordlessly he gathered his few belongings, and the empty room seemed to grow colder with every drawer he closed. （读后续写·离别）
All summer the family had toiled, and now, at last, they gathered the golden harvest with aching backs and grateful hearts. （读后续写·劳动收获）

collocations.translation: 积满灰尘（喻被搁置不用）
collocations.example: The old violin gathered dust in the attic, until one rainy afternoon a curious child lifted it and unlocked a forgotten gift. （读后续写·转折）

collocations.translation: 渐起的风暴／聚集的人群
collocations.example: Beneath a gathering storm, the anxious crowd pressed closer to the harbour, straining for any sign of the missing fishing boat. （读后续写·紧张环境）

synonyms.example: For years the old man collected discarded books, dreaming of the free library he would one day open. （读后续写·执着理想）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：collect 强调有目的、有系统地收集（藏品、资料、款项）；gather 更宽泛，可指人自然聚集，也指随手把散落之物收拢，随意性更强。句法/搭配：collect stamps / data / money；gather round（不及物聚集）。

synonyms.example: The whole staff assembled in the hall to hear the principal's final address. （应用文·通知/正式场合）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：assemble 正式，多指为特定目的把人有组织地召集在一起；gather 口语化，聚集可以是自发、随意的。句法/搭配：assemble in the hall / assemble a team；亦可指"组装"。

synonyms.example: Small acts of kindness accumulate over the years into a reputation no money can buy. （议论文·品格）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：accumulate 强调数量随时间逐渐增多、堆积；gather（作"积聚"）也含渐增之意，但更常搭配 speed/strength/courage 等抽象名词。句法/搭配：accumulate wealth / experience；gather speed / momentum。

advancedExpressions.expression: gather around（围拢）/ gather information（收集信息）/ gather speed（加速）/ gather courage（鼓起勇气）/ I gather that（我推断）/ gather dust（积灰被搁置）
advancedExpressions.example: As the crowd gathered round, she gathered her courage, gathered her thoughts, and finally spoke. （一句串联 gather 的"聚集/积聚/理清"多义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·推断（供替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: I gather that = I take it that = I understand that = As far as I can tell（我推断/我听说）
advancedExpressions.example: I gather / take it / understand that you won't be coming tomorrow. （婉转表"我据此推断"，皆可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. gathered every ounce of courage and ...
advancedExpressions.example: She gathered every ounce of courage she had left, squared her shoulders, and stepped into the light before she could think better of it. （量化夸张(every ounce)+连续动作，鼓起勇气的经典写法）

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly invite all ... to gather at ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly invite all who love our old town to gather at the square this Sunday to give it, together, the care it has so long deserved. （集合号召句式+目的状语，倡议温度）

advancedExpressions.expression: only after gathering the facts can one ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only after gathering the facts and weighing them without prejudice can one hope to arrive at a judgement worthy of the name. （Only状语倒装+递进动词，凸显理性程序）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The family sat around the table and waited for Mama.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Eagerly we gathered around the worn kitchen table, our small hands folded and our eyes fixed on Mama's, as the single lamp threw a golden circle of warmth against the winter dark pressing at the windows. （读后续写·家庭温情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 副词开头(Eagerly)定情绪 + 独立主格并列(hands folded/eyes fixed)细节 + as引导背景 + 光影对比(golden circle vs winter dark)营造画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should collect all the facts before you decide.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before rushing to judgement, one would do well to gather every relevant fact, sift the true from the false, and let reason, not impulse, hold the final word. （议论文·理性决策）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Before+动名词状语 + would do well to委婉建议 + 三动词递进(gather/sift/let) + not...but式对照(reason not impulse)拟人收束

classPractice.question: 这位教授正在为他的下一本书收集资料。（用 gather）
classPractice.answer: The professor is gathering materials for his next book.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；gather materials 搜集资料（vt. 搜集，收集）

classPractice.question: 姐妹三人决定轮流做东，在各自的家里主办家庭聚会。（用 gathering）
classPractice.answer: The three sisters decided to take turns to host family gatherings in their own home.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；a family gathering 家庭聚会（n.）；take turns to do 轮流做

classPractice.question: Eagerly we gathered ____ the table, waiting for Mama to open the little tin bank.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；gather around/round 围拢过来

classPractice.question: From the tremor in her voice, I ____ that something had gone wrong at home.
classPractice.note: gather 熟词僻义"推断、领会"；I gather that... 我据此推断

classPractice.question: It took her a long minute to gather the ____ to knock on the door she had avoided for years.
classPractice.note: gather courage 鼓起勇气；gather 表"积聚"抽象名词

classPractice.question: The librarian spent years ____ (gathering / assembling) old newspapers scattered across the county.
classPractice.note: 随手收拢散落各处之物用 gather 更自然；assemble 偏正式、有组织地召集

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: It was used for sudden emergencies, such as the time when Christine broke her arm and had to be taken to a doctor.
readingExamples: It was used for sudden emergencies, such as the time when Christine broke her arm and had to be taken to a doctor.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an unexpected and dangerous situation that must be dealt with immediately
(2) n. a serious medical condition requiring urgent treatment
(3) adj. done, arranged, or used suddenly to deal with an urgent situation
(4) n. (as modifier) relating to the services or resources kept ready for urgent use, e.g. an emergency exit

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①突发事件，紧急情况（须立即处理的意外危险状况，课文即此义）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was used for sudden emergencies, such as the time when Christine broke her arm. （课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②（医疗）急症，急诊
uncommonMeanings.example: The patient was a genuine emergency and was seen at once. 这名病人是真正的急症，立刻得到了诊治。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③备用的，应急的（作定语，熟词僻义：emergency exit / measures）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the plane suddenly lurched, the flight attendant pointed calmly to the emergency exits, her steady voice a lifeline in a cabin thick with panic. （读后续写·危机时刻·镇定的力量）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the old man collapsed on the crowded platform, Tom knew this was a real emergency, and without a second thought he dropped his bag and pushed his way through the startled crowd toward him. （读后续写·突发救人·当机立断）
I am writing to suggest that our school hold a monthly drill so that every student knows exactly what to do in an emergency such as a fire or an earthquake. （应用文·建议信·校园安全）
In an age when natural disasters strike ever more frequently, the ability of a community to respond swiftly to an emergency is not a luxury but a necessity for survival. （议论文·防灾减灾）
Volunteers were trained to perform emergency first aid, so that the precious minutes before the ambulance arrived would never again be wasted. （读后续写·志愿救援·争分夺秒）

wordForms.other: emergence (n. 出现，兴起); emergency 复数为 emergencies（-y 变 -ies）。词族溯源：动词 emerge（浮现、出现）+ -ency → emergency，本义"突然浮现的状况"。区分 emerge（出现）/ emergency（紧急情况）/ emergence（出现这一过程），勿混。

idioms.example: A note taped above the phone read, 'In case of emergency, dial 120' — words she had ignored a thousand times until the night they suddenly meant everything. （读后续写·家庭急救·悔悟）
As the floodwaters rose past the second floor, the mayor declared a state of emergency and called on every able-bodied resident to help. （读后续写·抗洪·全城动员）

collocations.translation: 【课件】以备急需／在紧急情况下
collocations.example: The old man is used to gathering old things, as he believes they can be used for emergencies. 老人习惯收集旧东西，因为他相信这些东西可以备急需。The hammer on the bus can only be used in an emergency. 公交车上的锤子只能在紧急情况下使用。（课件原句）
The government declared a state of emergency after the hurricane hit the city hard. 飓风重创城市后，政府宣布进入紧急状态。（课件原句）
In case of fire, leave the building at once through the nearest emergency exit. 万一失火，请立即从最近的紧急出口离开。
The rescue team took emergency action the moment the alarm sounded. 警报一响，救援队就采取了紧急措施。
Trucks loaded with emergency supplies rolled into the flooded town before dawn. 天亮前，满载救援物资的卡车驶入了被淹的城镇。

collocations.translation: 【课件】如遇紧急情况（以备不时之需）
collocations.example: It would be safer to take more money with you in case of emergency. 多带些钱以防紧急情况会更稳妥。（课件填空原句）

collocations.translation: 突发的紧急情况（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It was used for sudden emergencies, such as the time when Christine broke her arm and had to be taken to a doctor. 它是留着应对突发紧急情况的，比如克里斯汀摔断胳膊、得送去看医生的那次。（课文原句）
Knowing how to stay calm in an emergency can make the difference between panic and rescue. （议论文·应急教育）
In case of fire, leave the building at once through the nearest emergency exit. 万一失火，请立即从最近的紧急出口离开。
The government declared a state of emergency and mobilised the army within hours of the earthquake. （应用文·新闻报道）
She was rushed to the emergency room, where a team of doctors worked through the night to save her. （读后续写·抢救·希望）
The training taught us how to handle an emergency without losing our heads. （应用文·活动总结）
Firefighters are trained to respond to an emergency at a moment's notice, day or night. （议论文·职业精神）

collocations.translation: 紧急呼叫 / 会议 / 措施
collocations.example: An emergency meeting was called the instant the news of the landslide reached the town hall. （读后续写·灾难应对）
Mother always kept a little money aside for emergencies, tucked in an old tea tin on the top shelf. （读后续写·亲情·未雨绸缪）

collocations.translation: 医疗 / 国家紧急事件
collocations.example: The pandemic was soon recognised as a global medical emergency demanding unprecedented cooperation. （议论文·全球合作）

synonyms.example: In the middle of the crisis, it was her quiet composure, not her strength, that held the family together. （读后续写·家庭危机·母亲形象）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：crisis 强调局势严重、后果深远的转折关头，可指经济、政治、感情等抽象危机；emergency 强调突发且需即刻处理，多为具体事件（火灾、事故、疾病）。句法/搭配：a financial / political crisis；复数 crises。

synonyms.example: There was an urgency in his voice that made everyone stop and listen. （读后续写·紧张氛围）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：urgency 是抽象名词，指"紧迫感"这一属性；emergency 指"紧急事件"这一事物本身，两者不可互换。句法/搭配：a sense of urgency / with urgency。

synonyms.example: Moved by the plight of the flood victims, students across the city organised a fundraising campaign overnight. （应用文·倡议书·同情）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：plight 侧重令人同情的持续性困境，带情感色彩；emergency 侧重时间紧迫、须立即应对的突发状况。句法/搭配：the plight of + 人群 / be in a sorry plight。

advancedExpressions.expression: in an emergency（紧急情况下）/ an emergency exit（紧急出口）/ in case of emergency（如遇紧急情况）/ a state of emergency（紧急状态）/ respond to / handle an emergency（应对处理）
advancedExpressions.example: In an emergency, stay calm, head for the nearest emergency exit, and, if trained, help others respond. （一句串联三个 emergency 搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: emerge（浮现，v.）+ -ency → emergency（紧急情况，n.）；emerge + -ence → emergence（出现，n.）；emerge + -ent → emergent（新兴的，adj.）
advancedExpressions.example: 同类 -ence/-ency 后缀：differ→difference、depend→dependence、frequent→frequency，动词或形容词转名词。

advancedExpressions.expression: Not until ... did sb. realise it was an emergency
advancedExpressions.example: Not until she saw the smoke curling under the door did she realise this was no drill but a true emergency. （Not until 倒装 + 场景递进，续写高潮段制造紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is imperative that we be prepared for any emergency
advancedExpressions.example: It is imperative that every household be prepared for any emergency, for disaster gives no warning before it strikes. （imperative that + 虚拟语气动词原形，建议信增强说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: how a society responds to an emergency reveals ...
advancedExpressions.example: How a society responds to an emergency reveals, more clearly than any speech, the true measure of its unity and compassion. （how 引导主语从句 + 'reveals the true measure of' 深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was an emergency and everyone was scared.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In an instant the ordinary afternoon shattered into an emergency: alarms shrieked, chairs toppled, and a cold wave of fear swept through the room, freezing every face into the same wide-eyed mask of dread. （读后续写·突发灾难·环境+群像描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'shatter into' 动态比喻 + 三组并列短句造节奏（alarms shrieked, chairs toppled, fear swept）+ 群像特写（every face...same mask）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should prepare for emergencies.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm conviction that only by rehearsing our response to potential emergencies in advance can we transform helpless panic into purposeful action when disaster finally comes. （议论文·防灾主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm conviction that... 立论主句 + only by...can 倒装强调条件 + 对比升华（helpless panic → purposeful action）

classPractice.question: It would be safer to take more money with you in case of e________. 如遇紧急情况
classPractice.note: 课件原题；in case of emergency 如遇紧急情况（此处不可数，泛指"紧急情况"）

classPractice.question: It was used for sudden ____ (emergency), such as the time when Christine broke her arm.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；emergency 复数为 emergencies，-y 变 -ies

classPractice.note: in an emergency 在紧急情况下（固定短语，注意冠词 an）

translation: 主动建议(或告诉)；自愿做，义务做；志愿者
sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered.
readingExamples: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who does a job, especially a helpful one, willingly and without payment
(2) n. a person who freely offers to serve, e.g. in the armed forces
(3) v. to offer to do something without being forced or paid to do it
(4) v. to tell someone something without being asked; to say or suggest of one's own accord

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①主动说出，自愿提供（信息、意见——高考课文正是此义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Though no one had asked, Nels quietly volunteered that he would work in the grocery after school, and in that single sentence a boy stepped forward to become a man. （读后续写·家庭担当·成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②主动提出（去做某事），毛遂自荐（volunteer to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the teacher asked who would look after the new student, Lily was the first to volunteer, raising her hand before she had even thought it through. （读后续写·善良·本能之举）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③志愿者，义务工作者
uncommonMeanings.example: As dawn broke, a line of volunteers in orange vests was already digging through the rubble. 天刚亮，一排穿橙色马甲的志愿者已在废墟中挖掘。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（自愿入伍的）志愿兵
uncommonMeanings.example: Hundreds of volunteers signed up for the army the very next morning. 第二天一早就有数百名志愿兵报名参军。

posExamples.sentence: As dawn broke over the ruined village, a line of volunteers in orange vests was already digging through the rubble, their hands raw but their hope unbroken. （读后续写·灾后救援·希望之光）
We are looking for enthusiastic volunteers to help run the charity book sale next weekend; no experience is needed, only a warm heart and a willing pair of hands. （应用文·招募启事·社区活动）
Every summer, thousands of college students volunteer to teach in remote mountain schools, carrying knowledge and possibility to children the cities have forgotten. （议论文·青年责任·支教）
Seeing his mother struggle with the heavy boxes, the boy volunteered to carry them upstairs, and the small act of kindness lit up her tired face. （读后续写·亲情·懂事）

wordForms.other: voluntary work 志愿工作。构词/拼写：volunteer 名动同形；形容词 voluntary、副词 voluntarily 拼写变化较大（注意 voluntar-i-ly 中的 i），常考拼写。搭配注意：volunteer to do sth（不定式），不用 volunteer doing。

collocations.example: Aunt Mary volunteered to clean up the kitchen. 玛丽姨妈自告奋勇去收拾厨房。（课件原句）
Several staff members volunteered for early retirement. 几位职员自愿提前退休。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】自愿充当……（主动提供服务）
collocations.example: He volunteered his services as a driver. 他自愿服务充当司机。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】做志愿活动（volunteer n. 志愿者；主动提供帮助者；义工）
collocations.example: Every weekend she does volunteer work at the community centre. 每个周末她都在社区中心做志愿活动。

collocations.translation: 【课件】做义务工作／义务服务（voluntary adj. 自愿的，义务性的）
collocations.example: A volunteer is a voluntary worker who does voluntary work without pay. 志愿者就是无偿从事义务工作的人。（课件辨析 voluntary services / organizations 义务服务／组织）

collocations.translation: 内尔斯主动说道（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels volunteered. "放学后我要去迪伦的杂货店干活。"内尔斯主动说道。（课文原句）
For three unforgettable summers, I worked as a volunteer at the local nursing home, listening to stories that time had almost swept away. （读后续写·感悟成长）

collocations.translation: 志愿工作者 / 支教老师 / 志愿团队
collocations.example: A group of volunteer teachers brought not only textbooks but also laughter to the isolated village school. （议论文·教育公平）
The organising committee called for volunteers to guide visitors during the international sports meeting. （应用文·通知）

collocations.translation: 志愿服务 / 志愿活动
collocations.example: Regular volunteer service, I have come to believe, shapes character far more powerfully than any classroom lesson. （议论文·品格培养）

collocations.translation: 主动提供信息 / 发表意见
collocations.example: Nobody pressed him, yet he volunteered the whole story, as if a weight had been lifted the moment he spoke. （读后续写·坦白·释怀）
There was never a shortage of willing volunteers when the community needed a helping hand. （应用文·社区精神）

synonyms.example: Without hesitation, he offered to walk the frightened child all the way home through the dark streets. （读后续写·善意·主动）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：offer 泛指主动提出给予帮助或事物，语气中性、使用最广；volunteer 强调"自愿、无偿、不被要求"，更突出奉献精神。句法/搭配：offer to do sth / offer sb sth；volunteer to do sth。

synonyms.example: Inspired by the recruitment poster, hundreds of young men enlisted the very next morning. （读后续写·历史·从军）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：enrol 侧重正式登记加入（课程、组织）；enlist 特指参军；volunteer 强调出于自愿而非义务，可与它们搭配（volunteer to enlist）。句法/搭配：enrol in / on a course；enlist in the army。

synonyms.example: When the teacher asked for a witness, only one timid girl came forward, her voice trembling but her resolve firm. （读后续写·正义·勇气）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：come forward 是短语，强调在关键时刻主动站出来（作证、承担）；volunteer 更泛，可用于日常小事，两者都含"主动"之意。句法/搭配：come forward to do sth / come forward with information。

advancedExpressions.expression: volunteer to do sth（自愿做某事）/ volunteer for sth（报名参加）/ work as a volunteer（做志愿者）/ call for volunteers（招募志愿者）/ volunteer information（主动提供信息）
advancedExpressions.example: She volunteered for the campaign and volunteered to lead it, then volunteered the very idea that made it a success. （一句展示 volunteer 的"报名/自愿做/主动说"三义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·主动提出（供替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: volunteer to do = offer to do = step forward to do = be the first to do（主动/自告奋勇去做）
advancedExpressions.example: Without being asked, he volunteered / offered / stepped forward to shoulder the heaviest task. （强调"没人要求就主动"，皆可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: volunteer（志愿者，n./v.）→ voluntary（自愿的，adj.）→ voluntarily（自愿地，adv.）
advancedExpressions.example: -ary 构形容词（necessary、ordinary），-ily 构副词；注意副词由 -ary 变 -arily，非简单加 -ly。

advancedExpressions.expression: without being asked, sb. volunteered to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Without being asked, and without expecting a word of thanks, he volunteered to shoulder the burden that no one else would touch. （without being asked 独立结构 + 双重否定强调无私，塑造高尚人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: we sincerely invite you to volunteer, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely invite you to volunteer for this meaningful cause, for every helping hand brings us one step closer to a warmer community. （招募信 for 引导原因，情理并重发出邀约）

advancedExpressions.expression: to volunteer is not to lose, but to gain ...
advancedExpressions.example: To volunteer is not to lose time or effort, but to gain something money can never buy — the quiet, lasting joy of having made a difference. （not...but 对比 + 破折号升华，论证奉献的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He volunteered to help the old man.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before anyone else could move, he had already stepped forward, volunteering to help the trembling old man to his feet — a gesture so natural that it seemed less a choice than an instinct of the heart. （读后续写·善良·瞬间反应）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去完成时（had stepped）抢出时间差 + 现在分词状语（volunteering）+ 破折号点评升华（less a choice than an instinct）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should volunteer more.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that students stepped out of their comfort zones to volunteer in their communities, for service to others is, in truth, the surest path to discovering oneself. （议论文·青年成长）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 过去式虚拟 呼吁 + for 引导论据 + in truth 插入语强化观点（service → discovering oneself）

classPractice.question: "I will work in Dillon's grocery after school," Nels ____ (volunteer).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；此处 volunteer 作"主动说出"讲，填过去式

classPractice.question: Seeing his mother struggle with the boxes, the boy volunteered ____ (carry) them upstairs.
classPractice.note: volunteer to do sth 自愿做某事，接不定式，不用动名词

classPractice.question: 整个暑假，成千上万的大学生自愿去山区支教。Every summer, thousands of college students ____ ____ teach in remote mountain schools.
classPractice.note: volunteer to do 自愿做；主语为复数用原形 volunteer

classPractice.question: The committee ____ (called for / offered) volunteers to guide visitors during the games.
classPractice.note: call for volunteers 招募志愿者；offer 不与 volunteers 这样搭配

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: Then he took his pipe out of his mouth and looked at it for a long time.
readingExamples: Then he took his pipe out of his mouth and looked at it for a long time.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a tube through which liquid or gas flows
(2) n. an object used for smoking tobacco, consisting of a small bowl with a thin tube attached
(3) n. a simple tube-shaped musical instrument; (plural) the pipes of an organ or bagpipes
(4) v. to send liquid, gas, etc. through a pipe; to play music on a pipe

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①烟斗（课文即此义 take his pipe）
uncommonMeanings.example: Then he took his pipe out of his mouth and looked at it for a long time. （课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②管子，管道（输送液体或气体的中空硬管）
uncommonMeanings.example: A burst pipe had flooded the whole kitchen. 一根爆裂的水管淹了整个厨房。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（复数 the pipes）管风琴的音管；风笛
uncommonMeanings.example: As the wedding began, the pipes swelled through the ancient church, and even the sternest guests felt their eyes grow warm. （读后续写·婚礼·动情场面）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④用管道输送（水、气、信号等）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fresh spring water was piped down from the mountain into every home in the village, and for the first time the children could drink without walking miles. （读后续写·扶贫·生活巨变）

posExamples.sentence: Grandfather took the pipe from his mouth, gazed at it in silence for a long moment, and only then did we sense the weight of the decision he was about to make. （读后续写·长辈·沉思时刻）
We regret to inform residents that a burst water pipe on the third floor has cut off the supply, and repairs are expected to be completed by this evening. （应用文·通知·社区公告）
Just as a single leaking pipe can gradually flood an entire building, a small habit left unchecked can quietly undermine one's whole life. （议论文·习惯·类比论证）
The new project will pipe clean water into thousands of remote households, turning what was once a daily struggle into a simple turn of a tap. （议论文·基础设施·民生）

wordForms.other: pipeline (n. 管道，输送管线；进程，渠道)。构词：pipe + line → pipeline（合成词）；pipe + -r → piper（吹风笛者）。名动同形：pipe 既是名词"管子/烟斗"，也是动词"用管道输送"，据句法判断。习语 in the pipeline 表"在酝酿中"。

idioms.translation: （口语）安静下来，别吵了（熟词僻义）
idioms.example: 'Pipe down, everyone,' the captain whispered sharply, 'or the guards will hear us.' （读后续写·紧张潜行·压低声音）

idioms.translation: 白日梦，空想，不切实际的幻想
idioms.example: For years, studying abroad had seemed a mere pipe dream, until the acceptance letter landed on her desk like a small miracle. （读后续写·梦想成真·转折）

idioms.idiom: put that in your pipe and smoke it
idioms.translation: （口语）你就好好想想我这话吧，接受这个事实吧
idioms.example: 'I got the scholarship after all — so put that in your pipe and smoke it,' she said, unable to hide her triumphant grin. （读后续写·反转·扬眉吐气·非正式）

collocations.phrase: take his pipe out of his mouth
collocations.translation: 把烟斗从嘴里拿出来（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Then he took his pipe out of his mouth and looked at it for a long time. 然后他把烟斗从嘴里拿出来，端详了好一会儿。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 水管 / 煤气管 / 排水管
collocations.example: A rusty drain pipe ran down the side of the old house, dripping steadily like a clock that refused to stop. （读后续写·环境描写·老屋）

collocations.translation: 爆裂的 / 漏水的管子
collocations.example: A burst pipe had flooded the kitchen overnight, and by morning the floor gleamed like a shallow lake. （读后续写·意外·清晨发现）
In the amber glow of the fire, the old sailor smoked his pipe and began, at last, to tell his story. （读后续写·氛围·讲述往事）
He lit his pipe slowly, buying himself a few seconds to choose his words with care. （读后续写·人物·从容）
Workers laboured for weeks to lay new pipes beneath the street, and finally clean water reached every doorstep. （应用文·工程报道）
The factory pipes its waste water into a treatment plant before it is ever released into the river. （议论文·环保·责任）

collocations.translation: 在酝酿中，在进行中（引申义）
collocations.example: The headmaster hinted that several exciting new courses were already in the pipeline for next term. （应用文·校园通讯）

synonyms.example: She squeezed the last of the paint from a crumpled tube, determined to finish the picture before dark. （读后续写·坚持·作画）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：tube 泛指各种中空的细管（试管、软管、地铁），可小可软；pipe 通常指较硬、用于输送液体/气体的固定管道，多为金属或塑料制成。句法/搭配：a test tube / the Tube（伦敦地铁）；a water pipe。

synonyms.example: The farmers dug a channel to guide the mountain stream toward their thirsty fields. （读后续写·农耕·智慧）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：channel 指开放的水道或抽象的"渠道、途径"，范围更广更抽象；pipe 是封闭的管子，具体实在。句法/搭配：a channel of communication / through official channels。

synonyms.example: The internet has become the main conduit through which knowledge now flows across borders. （议论文·信息时代）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：conduit 较为书面正式，常用于比喻"传输渠道"（信息、资金）；pipe 更口语化、更具体，多指实物管道。句法/搭配：a conduit for / through which。

advancedExpressions.expression: smoke a pipe（抽烟斗）/ a burst pipe（爆裂的水管）/ pipe water into（用管道引水）/ pipe down（安静下来）/ a pipe dream（白日梦）/ in the pipeline（在酝酿中）
advancedExpressions.example: The old man smoked his pipe by the fire, unaware that a burst pipe upstairs was already flooding the floor. （一句串联 pipe 的"烟斗/水管"两义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·管子/管道（供替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: pipe = tube（软管/细管）= conduit（正式导管）= channel（水道/抽象渠道）
advancedExpressions.example: Water can flow through a pipe, a tube, or an open channel, depending on how it must travel. （据软硬、开闭与正式度择词）

advancedExpressions.expression: pipe + line → pipeline（输油/水管线；进程渠道）；pipe + -r → piper（吹笛人）
advancedExpressions.example: 同类合成词：pipework、pipe organ；in the pipeline 由实物"管道"引申为"在酝酿进行中"。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. took the pipe from his mouth and ...
advancedExpressions.example: He took the pipe from his mouth, tapped the ash into the fire, and let the silence stretch until it grew almost unbearable. （连续动作 + 让沉默'stretch'烘托张力，刻画沉稳人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: we regret to inform ... that a burst pipe has ...
advancedExpressions.example: We regret to inform all tenants that a burst pipe has temporarily disrupted the water supply; your patience during the repair is greatly appreciated. （通知固定套语 we regret to inform，客观说明 + 致谢）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a leaking pipe ..., so too ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a leaking pipe wastes water drop by drop, so too does procrastination drain away our precious time without our ever noticing. （just as...so too 类比结构，把抽象道理具象化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man smoked his pipe by the fire.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By the crackling fire the old man sat motionless, drawing slowly on his pipe, each curl of smoke rising like a small ghost of the memories he could not bring himself to speak. （读后续写·氛围+心理·怀旧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置造画面 + 现在分词伴随（drawing）+ 明喻（smoke...like a small ghost of memories）暗示人物心事

sentenceUpgrade.original: The village finally got clean water through new pipes.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 时间状语铺垫 + 'came coursing through' 动态动词 + 群像场面 + 明喻收束（laughter...as bright as the water）

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: Then she wrote down another figure.
readingExamples: Then she wrote down another figure.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a number, especially one that forms part of official statistics or a calculation
(2) n. a person of a particular kind, especially an important or well-known one
(3) n. the shape of a person's body, especially a woman's; a bodily shape seen indistinctly
(4) v. to think or decide that something will happen or is true; to be an important or noticeable part of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①数字，数额（尤指统计或计算中的具体数字）
uncommonMeanings.example: Then she wrote down another figure. 然后她又写下另一个数字。（课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②人物，尤指重要/知名人物（a historical / public figure）
uncommonMeanings.example: Lu Xun remains a towering figure in modern Chinese literature. 鲁迅仍是中国现代文学中的一位泰斗级人物。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③体形，身材（尤指女性）
uncommonMeanings.example: She works out daily to keep her slim figure. 她每天健身以保持苗条身材。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（隐约可见的）人影，身形（高考读后续写高频！）
uncommonMeanings.example: Through the swirling snow a lonely figure came staggering toward the cabin, and Grandma's heart leapt. （读后续写·风雪归人·团圆铺垫）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤认为，估计，料想（美式口语）
uncommonMeanings.example: I figured she would refuse, so her sudden 'yes' left me too stunned to speak. （读后续写·意外·心理反应）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑥占有一席之地，是重要部分（figure prominently in）
uncommonMeanings.example: Kindness had always figured prominently in the way Grandpa taught us to live. （读后续写·家风·传承）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑦图形，图表，插图（see Figure 2 见图2）
uncommonMeanings.example: The results are shown in Figure 3 on the next page. 结果见下页图3。

posExamples.sentence: Mother frowned at the household accounts, crossed out a number, and slowly wrote down another figure, as if hoping the paper would somehow show more than it did. （读后续写·家庭·精打细算）
The latest figures show that over eighty per cent of the students surveyed would welcome an after-school reading club, which fully justifies our proposal. （应用文·调查报告·数据支撑）
Lu Xun remains a towering figure in modern Chinese literature, a writer whose sharp pen awakened a whole generation. （议论文·文化名人·评价）
I figured that if I set out before dawn, I would reach the summit in time to watch the sun break over the clouds. （读后续写·登山·计划与期待）

wordForms.other: 构词法·figure 家族：figure(数字/人物/计算) + -ative→figurative(比喻的) + -ine→figurine(小雕像)。小贴士：figure 作'数字/人物/身材/图形'时可数(a figure, two figures)；短语动词 figure out(弄清楚)最常考，宾语可为从句 figure out why/how/what。图表 Figure 首字母常大写。

idioms.example: For hours she stared at the puzzle, and just as she was about to give up, the answer suddenly figured itself out in her mind. （读后续写·思考·灵光一现）

idioms.translation: 父亲 / 母亲般的人物（精神依靠）
idioms.example: To the orphans, old Mr. Lin was more than a caretaker; he was the father figure they had never had. （读后续写·亲情·代替父亲）
As a public figure, she knew that every word she spoke could inspire — or mislead — thousands. （议论文·名人责任）

idioms.translation: 显得体面 / 显得狼狈
idioms.example: Drenched and shivering at the door, he cut a sorry figure indeed, yet his eyes still burned with quiet pride. （读后续写·落魄·尊严）

collocations.translation: 【课件】销售数字／官方数字（n. number 数字）
collocations.example: The latest sales figures show a sharp rise. 最新的销售数字显示大幅上升。（课件义项①）

collocations.translation: 【课件】主要／公众人物（n. person 人物）
collocations.example: He is a leading figure in modern science. 他是现代科学界的领军人物。（课件义项②）

collocations.translation: 【课件】保持身材（n. shape of body 体型，身材）
collocations.example: She works out daily to keep her figure. 她每天健身以保持身材。a middle-sized figure 中等身材（课件义项③）

collocations.translation: 【课件】高高的身影（n. 身影，隐约可见的人形）
collocations.example: A tall figure approached me. 一个高大的身影朝我走来。（课件义项3.1）

collocations.translation: 【课件】认为，认定（v. to think or decide that sth will happen/is true）
collocations.example: We figured the right thing to do was to wait. 我们认为正确的做法是等待。（课件原句）
I can't figure out how to do this. 我弄不清楚这要怎么做。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 又写下一个数字（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Then she wrote down another figure. 然后她又写下另一个数字。（课文原句）
As a public figure, she chooses her words with care. 作为公众人物，她说话很谨慎。
She keeps her figure by jogging every morning. 她靠每天晨跑保持身材。

collocations.translation: 领军人物 / 关键人物
collocations.example: He is a leading figure in modern science. 他是现代科学界的领军人物。
According to the latest figures, air quality in our city has improved dramatically over the past five years. （议论文·环境改善·引数据）

collocations.translation: 黑暗中的 / 模糊的 / 孤独的身影
collocations.example: A shadowy figure slipped past the streetlamp, and my heart pounded so loudly I feared it would give me away. （读后续写·悬疑·紧张）
It is hard to put a figure on how much a mother's encouragement is worth. （议论文·亲情·无价）
Honesty has always figured prominently in the values our family holds dear. （读后续写·家风）

collocations.translation: 整数 / 六位数的金额
collocations.example: The charity raised a six-figure sum in a single evening, far beyond anyone's wildest hopes. （应用文·慈善报道）

synonyms.example: The number of volunteers doubled within a week. 一周内志愿者人数翻了一番。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：number 最普通，泛指'数字/数量'；figure 特指官方统计或计算中出现的具体数字，更书面，常用于报告数据（the latest figures）。二者作可数名词。

synonyms.example: The novel's most unforgettable character was the quiet servant. 小说里最难忘的人物是那位沉默的仆人。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：character 多指作品中的'角色'或人的'品格'；figure 指现实中'某类人物'尤其是重要人物（historical figure），二者侧重不同。

synonyms.example: In the fog, the mountains lost their shape. 雾中群山失去了轮廓。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：shape 强调物体的外形轮廓；figure 特指人的身形或隐约可见的人影，续写描写'远处人影'时首选 figure，且 figure 还可指'身材'。

advancedExpressions.expression: figure out / figure prominently in / put a figure on / a six-figure sum
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举：figure out 弄清楚；figure prominently in 在…中占重要地位；put a figure on 给…估个数；a six-figure sum 六位数金额；a public / leading figure 公众/领军人物。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表示'弄清楚/想明白'，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: figure out = work out = make sense of = get to the bottom of
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举可替换：figure out / work out / make sense of / get to the bottom of，均可表示'弄清楚、搞明白'（后接 wh- 从句或 sth）。

advancedExpressions.expression: out of the ... emerged a figure ...
advancedExpressions.example: Out of the thickening mist emerged a figure I would have known anywhere — my father, walking home at last after twenty long years. （out of...emerged 倒装 + 破折号揭示身份，制造重逢震撼）

advancedExpressions.expression: the figures speak for themselves
advancedExpressions.example: The figures speak for themselves: participation has tripled, and satisfaction has never been higher. （报告结论套语，用数据自证观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. stands as a towering figure whose ...
advancedExpressions.example: She stands as a towering figure in the history of medicine, whose courage saved not merely lives but the very idea of what one person can achieve. （whose 定语从句 + not merely...but 递进拔高历史人物）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A person appeared in the distance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In the far distance a solitary figure took shape against the fading light, growing larger with every step, until my breath caught — it was the very person I had waited three long years to see. （读后续写·等待·重逢）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置 + 'took shape against the fading light' 意象化出场 + 破折号情感爆发（my breath caught）+ 悬念揭底

sentenceUpgrade.original: The report gives some numbers about our survey.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The figures gathered in our survey paint an unmistakable picture: an overwhelming majority of students long for more hands-on activities, a demand our school can no longer afford to ignore. （应用文·调查报告）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'paint a picture' 拟人化呈现数据 + 冒号引出结论 + 'can no longer afford to ignore' 增强建议紧迫感

classPractice.question: For hours the detectives tried to figure ____ how the thief had escaped unseen.
classPractice.note: figure out 弄清楚、想明白，后接 wh- 从句

classPractice.question: 选 figure / number 填空：According to the official ____, over eighty per cent of students support the plan.
classPractice.note: 官方统计数据用 figures；此处用复数

classPractice.question: 作为一名公众人物，她的一言一行都受到关注。As a ____ ____, her every word and deed is watched closely.
classPractice.note: a public figure 公众人物

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: We all felt very good because we did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account.
readingExamples: We all felt very good because we did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. to, towards, or in the central part or business district of a town or city
(2) adj. located in or relating to the central or main business area of a city
(3) n. (chiefly North American) the central business district of a city

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①在市中心，往市中心（前不加 to/in，直接 go downtown）
uncommonMeanings.example: We did not have to go downtown. 我们不必去市中心。（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②市中心的，商业区的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The downtown streets were choked with traffic. 市中心的街道车流拥堵。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（美式）市中心，商业区（作主语/宾语）
uncommonMeanings.example: By nightfall the downtown had transformed into a glittering sea of neon. （读后续写·进城·震撼）

posExamples.sentence: We all felt a quiet relief that we would not have to go downtown to withdraw money, for Mama's calm confidence alone had steadied the whole trembling family. （读后续写·亲情·安全感）
If you wish to join our city walking tour, please gather downtown at the clock tower this Saturday at nine, where a guide in a red cap will be waiting. （应用文·活动通知·集合安排）
As more families move downtown in search of opportunity, city planners face an urgent question: how can we keep our urban centres both prosperous and livable? （议论文·城市化·思辨）
The old bookshop, tucked away in a quiet downtown alley, had witnessed half a century of the city's joys and sorrows. （读后续写·老店·怀旧）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词：down + town → downtown。反义词 uptown(住宅区/上城区)；对比 uphill/downhill、upstairs/downstairs。小贴士：downtown 一词三用(adv./adj./n.)且拼写不变；作副词时前不加 to/in——go downtown 正确，go to downtown 错误。

collocations.translation: 去市中心（downtown 作副词，前不加介词，课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account. 我们不必去市中心从妈妈的银行账户取钱。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 住在 / 在市中心工作
collocations.example: She works downtown but lives in the suburbs. 她在市中心上班，却住在郊区。

collocations.translation: 市中心区，商业区（作定语）
collocations.example: The downtown area was closed to cars for the festival. 节庆期间市中心禁止车辆通行。

collocations.translation: 开车 / 乘公交去市中心
collocations.example: Every morning she takes the bus downtown to work. 她每天早上乘公交去市中心上班。
The heavy downtown traffic taught me a hard lesson: to arrive on time, one must always set out early. （议论文·守时·反思）
Right in the heart of downtown stood a tiny park, a green island of calm amid the roaring tide of the city. （读后续写·都市·静谧角落）

synonyms.example: The city centre buzzed with shoppers and street performers. 市中心挤满了购物者和街头艺人。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：city centre 是英式说法，中性通用，前面要用介词（in the city centre）；downtown 是美式说法，且可直接作副词（go downtown 不加介词），这是二者最大区别。

synonyms.translation: 城里，市区（相对郊区/乡下）
synonyms.example: After years in the countryside, the noise of the city both thrilled and frightened him. 在乡下住了多年，城里的喧闹既令他兴奋又令他害怕。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：the city 常与 the country（乡下）相对，泛指城区；downtown 特指市中心核心地段，范围更小更聚焦。

synonyms.example: Skyscrapers rose one after another in the central business district. 中央商务区里摩天大楼拔地而起。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：CBD 是正式术语，专指商务办公密集区，多用于报告、规划语境；downtown 更口语，泛指市中心商业繁华地带。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表示'市中心'，注意句法差异）
advancedExpressions.expression: downtown (adv., go downtown) / the city centre (英式, in the ...) / the CBD (正式)
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举：downtown（美式，可作副词 go downtown 不加介词）/ the city centre（英式，需介词 in）/ the central business district(CBD)（正式书面）。

advancedExpressions.expression: downtown / uptown / downstairs / upstairs / indoors / outdoors
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举同类合成方位副词：downtown(市中心)、uptown(上城)、downstairs(楼下)、upstairs(楼上)、indoors(室内)、outdoors(户外)——均可直接作副词，前不加介词。

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had sb. arrived downtown than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had we arrived downtown than the rain came pouring down, scattering the crowd and driving us into a warm little café that would change everything. （no sooner...than 倒装衔接场景 + 埋下转折伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: as more people flock downtown, we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: As more and more people flock downtown in pursuit of a better life, we must ask ourselves whether our cities are growing wiser, or merely larger. （as 引导背景 + whether...or 设问深化思辨）

advancedExpressions.expression: we shall meet downtown at ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We shall meet downtown at the central square at eight sharp, so that we may set off together and let no one be left behind. （通知中约定集合，so that 引导目的，体现周到）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We went downtown and saw the bright lights.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The moment we stepped downtown, a dazzling world unfolded before us — rivers of light poured down every street, and the whole city seemed to pulse with a heartbeat of its own. （读后续写·进城·惊叹）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The moment 引导瞬间 + 破折号展开画面 + 比喻（rivers of light）+ 拟人（city...pulse with a heartbeat）营造都市奇观

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people are moving downtown now.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is an undeniable trend that ever-growing numbers of people are streaming downtown, drawn by the promise of opportunity, yet this very tide raises pressing questions about crowding and livability. （议论文·城市化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is an undeniable trend that 立论 + 现在分词状语（drawn by...）补充动因 + yet 转折抛出思辨议题

classPractice.question: We didn't have to go ____ (downtown) and draw money out of the account.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；downtown 作副词，前不加介词 to/in

classPractice.question: 选 downtown / to downtown：After the film we decided to walk ____ for a late-night snack.
classPractice.note: downtown 作副词直接跟动词，不能说 to downtown

classPractice.question: 这家老书店藏在一条安静的市中心小巷里。The old bookshop was tucked away in a quiet ____ alley.
classPractice.note: downtown 作定语'市中心的'

sub_section: Extended reading
original_sentence: We all felt very good because we did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account.
readingExamples: We all felt very good because we did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to take or withdraw money from a bank account
(2) phr. to pull or extract something out of a place or container
(3) phr. to make someone reveal or express something, e.g. feelings or information, that they are reluctant to share

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①从（银行账户）取（款），支取
uncommonMeanings.example: draw money out of Mama's Bank Account 从妈妈的银行账户取钱（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②把某物从某处抽出/取出（包、口袋、井、伤口等）
uncommonMeanings.example: She drew an old photo out of the box. 她从盒子里抽出一张旧照片。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③使（人）说出/表露（本不愿讲的心事、情感）——熟词僻义，续写好用
uncommonMeanings.example: With endless patience the old teacher gently drew the painful truth out of the silent boy. （读后续写·师生·打开心扉）

posExamples.sentence: We were all quietly relieved, for it meant we did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account, that mysterious source of comfort we never dared to touch. （读后续写·亲情·家庭安全感）
I am writing to remind members that, before the trip, each of you should draw enough cash out of your account, since card payment is not accepted at the mountain campsite. （应用文·出行提醒·通知）
A wise teacher does not pour knowledge into students; rather, he draws the best out of them, coaxing forth ideas they never knew they possessed. （议论文·教育理念·启发式教学）
She reached into the drawer and drew an old, faded photograph out of a stack of letters, and at the sight of it her eyes brimmed with tears. （读后续写·睹物思人·翻找）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：draw 为不规则动词 draw-drew-drawn；本短语核心是'取出/抽出'，from 可与 out of 换用(draw money from the account)。派生短语群见下：draw up 起草、draw on 利用、draw sb out 使某人开口。

idioms.translation: 使某人放松开口，引其吐露心声
idioms.example: Shy at first, the new student was slowly drawn out by his kind classmates. （读后续写·友情·融入集体）

idioms.translation: 起草，拟定（计划、名单、合同）
idioms.example: The committee drew up a detailed plan for the charity sale. 委员会为义卖拟定了一份详细计划。

idioms.translation: 利用，凭借，动用（经验、储备等）
idioms.example: In the crisis she drew on years of experience to steady the team. 危机中她凭借多年经验稳住了团队。

idioms.idiom: draw the best / worst out of sb
idioms.translation: 激发某人最好 / 最坏的一面
idioms.example: Hardship, she came to understand, has a way of drawing the very best out of ordinary people. （议论文·逆境·成长）

collocations.phrase: draw money from / out of sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】从（银行账户）提取，支取（= withdraw；反义 pay it into account = deposit money into 存钱进账户）
collocations.example: We did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account. 我们不必去市中心从妈妈的银行账户取钱。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把……拖／拉（近）；抽出（draw = pull 拖，拉）
collocations.example: I drew my chair up closer to the fire. 我把椅子向火旁拉近了点。Ali reached into his pocket and drew out a piece of paper. 阿里把手伸进口袋，抽出一张纸。（课件原句；drew out = take out 取出）

collocations.translation: 【课件】某人的目光被……吸引（draw = attract 吸引）
collocations.example: My eyes were drawn to the man in the corner. 角落里的那个男人引起了我的注意。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】吸引学生／招致批评（draw = attract 吸引；arouse 引起）
collocations.example: The course draws students from all over the country. 这门课程吸引了来自全国各地的学生。The plan has drawn a lot of criticism. 这项计划招致了很多批评。（课件原句）
What conclusions did you draw from the report? 你从这份报告中得出了什么结论？（课件原句）
They had to draw lots/straws to decide who would go. 他们只好抽签决定谁去。（课件原句）
Where do you draw the line between genius and madness? 天才与疯狂之间，界限该划在哪里呢？（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: draw money out of an account
collocations.translation: 从账户里取钱（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We did not have to go downtown and draw money out of Mama's Bank Account. 我们不必去市中心从妈妈的银行账户取钱。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: draw sth out of a bag / pocket / drawer
collocations.translation: 从包 / 口袋 / 抽屉里取出某物
collocations.example: He drew a letter out of his coat and handed it to me. 他从外套里取出一封信递给我。

collocations.phrase: draw the truth / a confession out of sb
collocations.translation: 使某人说出真相 / 招供
collocations.example: A single word of kindness finally drew the truth out of him. 一句善意的话终于让他说出了真相。

collocations.phrase: draw information / a response out of sb
collocations.translation: 从某人处套出信息 / 引出回应
collocations.example: The reporter's gentle questions drew a heartfelt response out of the reluctant hero. （应用文·采访报道）

collocations.phrase: draw water out of a well
collocations.example: Every dawn the girl drew water out of the deep village well. （读后续写·农村·坚韧）

definitionEn:

(2) n. the way that the parts of a machine, system or organization work together, or the state of working
(3) n. a planned activity involving a number of people, especially soldiers, police, or a business

definitionEn:
