wordForms.other: 构词法·-er 表'做某动作的人'：tell + -er → teller(讲述者/出纳员)。同类：sing→singer, teach→teacher, write→writer。合成人称：story-teller 讲故事的人、fortune-teller 算命者、truth-teller 说真话的人。tell 不规则动词 tell-told-told。

collocations.translation: 把它递给（银行）出纳员（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Just hand it to the teller. 直接把它递给出纳员就行。（课文原句）
The young bank teller noticed the old woman's trembling hands and came to help. （读后续写·善意·细节）
Every village once had its teller of tales, a keeper of memories. （读后续写·传统·怀旧）
Late at night, the glowing screen of the automatic teller machine was the only light on the street. （读后续写·环境描写·孤独）
The fortune-teller studied his palm before whispering a single word. （读后续写·悬念·转折）

synonyms.example: The cashier smiled as she handed back the change. 收银员微笑着把找零递回来。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：cashier 泛指商店、超市里的收银员，也可指银行出纳；teller 主要指银行柜台的出纳员，词义更专、更聚焦于银行。

synonyms.example: The narrator's calm voice guided listeners through the story. 叙述者平静的嗓音引领听众走过故事。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：narrator 是文学、影视中正式的'叙述者'；teller（尤其 story-teller）更口语，强调当面讲故事的人。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-er 施动者家族
advancedExpressions.expression: teller / story-teller / fortune-teller / truth-teller / bookkeeper
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举 tell+er 及合成人称：teller(出纳/讲述者)、story-teller(讲故事的人)、fortune-teller(算命者)、truth-teller(说真话者)——'动词+er/合成'表'做…的人'。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. was a born teller of ..., whose ... could ...
advancedExpressions.example: She was a born teller of stories, whose gentle voice could turn a rainy afternoon into an adventure across distant lands. （whose 定语从句刻画人物魅力）

advancedExpressions.expression: one may ask whether the human teller still ... in an age of ...
advancedExpressions.example: One may ask whether the human teller still matters in an age of automation, yet warmth and understanding remain services no machine can render. （设问+yet 转折突出观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to ..., a teller who ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to a teller who went out of his way to help a stranger in need. （表扬信开门见山点明对象）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I gave the check to the teller.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With my heart pounding against my ribs, I handed the precious check to the teller, and only when she flashed me an encouraging smile did the knot in my stomach finally loosen. （读后续写·成长+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: With my heart pounding 独立主格开头 + 'the knot in my stomach loosen' 身体隐喻心理 + only when...did 部分倒装强调转折

sentenceUpgrade.original: The teller was very kind to my grandmother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I shall never forget how the young teller, seeing my grandmother struggle with the unfamiliar form, gently stepped forward and guided her hand as though she were his own kin. （应用文·表扬信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: I shall never forget how 强调难忘 + seeing...现在分词状语 + as though 从句升华人情味

classPractice.question: Mama said gently, "Just hand it to the ____ (tell)."
classPractice.note: 课文原句；tell + -er 构成名词 teller，指银行出纳员

classPractice.question: 选 teller / cashier：Grandma was a born ____ of tales, holding the whole room spellbound.
classPractice.note: teller of tales 讲故事的人；cashier 仅指收银员

translation: (戏剧等)场；场面，片段；地点，现场；景象，风光
sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening.
readingExamples: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time
(2) n. a view or picture of a place, event, or activity; a particular area of activity
(3) n. the place where an event, especially an accident or crime, happens
(4) n. a loud or angry display of feelings in public; a public argument

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（戏剧、电影的）一场，场景
uncommonMeanings.example: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening. 第一幕第一场，周五晚上。（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②景象，风光，画面
uncommonMeanings.example: A breathtaking scene unfolded before my eyes. 一幅令人叹为观止的景象在我眼前展开。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（事故、犯罪的）现场，地点
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time the officers reached the scene, only a shivering dog remained. （读后续写·悬念·现场）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（当众的）吵闹，出洋相，发脾气（make a scene）
uncommonMeanings.example: Rather than make a scene in front of the whole restaurant, she walked out with quiet dignity. （读后续写·人物·克制）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤（某一）活动领域，圈子（the art/music scene）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fresh out of college, she threw herself into the city's vibrant art scene. （读后续写·追梦·奋斗）

posExamples.sentence: In Act 1, Scene 1, the curtain rises on a dimly lit living room, where a lonely old man sits waiting by a telephone that never rings. （读后续写·戏剧·氛围）
As I climbed the last ridge, a breathtaking scene unfolded before my eyes: golden fields rolling towards a horizon set ablaze by the setting sun. （读后续写·登山·景色）
I would like to invite all members to our photography exhibition, where scenes of our beautiful campus captured through student lenses will be on display. （应用文·邀请函）
Behind every glittering scene of success on the stage lie countless unseen hours of sweat, doubt, and quiet perseverance. （议论文·励志·成功背后）

wordForms.other: 构词法·scene 家族：scene(场景/景象) → scenery(风景，不可数) → scenic(风景优美的) → scenically。易错辨析：scene(可数，一个场面) ≠ scenery(不可数，泛指风景) ≠ sight(引发情感的一幕/名胜) ≠ view(从某处望出去的景色)。

idioms.example: He wanted to make a scene, but one look at his mother's tired face made him bite back every angry word. （读后续写·情绪·克制）
While the star took the applause, volunteers worked behind the scenes to make the concert a success. （议论文·团队·默默付出）

idioms.translation: 为……做铺垫；描述场景背景
idioms.example: The dim streetlights set the scene for the reunion that would change both their lives. （读后续写·铺垫·转折）
Just when all hope seemed lost, a young doctor came on the scene and took charge. （读后续写·英雄登场·转折）

collocations.translation: 【课件】开场（戏剧、电影的一场；Act 1, Scene 1 第1幕第1场）
collocations.example: Act 1, Scene 1. 第一幕第一场。The opening scene is set in a busy market. 开场设在一个繁忙的集市。（课件原句）
Dozens of volunteers worked tirelessly behind the scenes. 数十名志愿者在幕后不知疲倦地忙碌着。（课件原句）
The team's victory produced scenes of joy all over the country. 球队的胜利使举国上下出现一派欢乐的场面。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】犯罪现场（n. 现场，地点）
collocations.example: Firefighters were on the scene immediately. 消防队立刻赶到了现场。（课件原句 the scene of the crime 犯罪现场 / on the scene 在现场）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（乡村）风光，景象（cn. 景象，风光）
collocations.example: It is a delightful rural scene. 这是一派赏心悦目的乡村风光。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 第一幕第一场（戏剧分场，课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Act 1, Scene 1 Friday evening. 第一幕第一场，周五晚上。（课文原句）
Rather than make a scene, she swallowed her anger and walked out. 她没有当众吵闹，而是压下怒火走了出去。
Dozens of volunteers worked tirelessly behind the scenes. 数十名志愿者在幕后不知疲倦地忙碌着。

collocations.phrase: the scene of the accident / crime
collocations.example: The detective knelt at the scene of the crime, certain that even the smallest clue mattered. （读后续写·悬疑·侦查）

collocations.translation: 令人叹为观止的／美丽的景象
collocations.example: From the mountaintop we gazed in silence at the breathtaking scene. （读后续写·景色·感悟）
The soft rain set the scene for the unexpected reunion. （读后续写·铺垫·转折）
The firefighters were on the scene within minutes. （读后续写·救援·赞颂）

collocations.phrase: a scene of chaos / joy / devastation
collocations.translation: 一片混乱／欢乐／破坏的景象
collocations.example: The rescue team was met with a scene of devastation no words could describe. （读后续写·灾难·现场）
The doctor advised a change of scene, so the exhausted teacher packed her bags and headed for the quiet seaside town. （读后续写·疗愈·转折）
In just two years she rose from an unknown newcomer to a familiar face on the national music scene. （读后续写·追梦·成就）

synonyms.example: The train wound through valleys of unspoilt scenery. 火车蜿蜒穿过一片片未受破坏的自然风光。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：scenery 是不可数名词，泛指某地区连绵的自然风光（beautiful scenery）；scene 是可数名词，指一个具体的场面或画面（a beautiful scene）。

synonyms.example: The sight of the wounded bird tugged at every heart. 那只受伤小鸟的情景牵动着每个人的心。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：sight 强调映入眼帘、引发情感反应的一幕，复数 sights 指'名胜'；scene 更中性，可指电影场景、事故现场等多种场面。

synonyms.translation: 景色，视野（从某处望出去）
synonyms.example: From our window we enjoyed a stunning view of the peaks. 从窗口望去，群峰美景尽收眼底。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：view 侧重从某个位置望出去所见的景色（a view of sth）；scene 更强调眼前构成一幅完整画面的场面，可含人物和活动。

advancedExpressions.expression: make a scene / behind the scenes / set the scene / on the scene / a change of scene
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举：make a scene 大吵大闹；behind the scenes 幕后；set the scene 做铺垫；on the scene 在现场；a change of scene 换个环境；come on the scene 登场。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表示'景色/景象'，注意可数性差异）
advancedExpressions.expression: scene (可数, a beautiful scene) / scenery (不可数) / view (a view of) / sight
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举'景色'词：scene(可数，一个场面)、scenery(不可数，自然风光)、view(从某处望出的景色)、sight(引发情感的一幕)——可数性与侧重各不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: a(n) ... scene unfolded before sb.'s eyes
advancedExpressions.example: As the mist lifted, a magnificent scene unfolded before our eyes, and for one timeless moment the whole world seemed to hold its breath. （unfold 使景色如画卷徐徐展开）

advancedExpressions.expression: behind every glittering scene of ... lie ...
advancedExpressions.example: Behind every glittering scene of triumph lie the unseen struggles that no spotlight ever reveals. （倒装+对比，揭示成功背后）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are warmly invited to witness scenes of ...
advancedExpressions.example: You are warmly invited to witness scenes of our school's proud history, brought vividly to life in this year's drama festival. （邀请函中制造吸引力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I saw a beautiful scene from the mountain.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I reached the summit, a scene of astonishing beauty unfolded before me: valleys draped in morning mist, and a river winding like a silver ribbon towards the golden dawn. （读后续写·登山+景物描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语从句 + unfold before me 动态呈现 + 冒号引出细节 + 'like a silver ribbon' 比喻 + 色彩词(golden)烘托

sentenceUpgrade.original: The play has many good scenes.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What lingered in my mind long after the final curtain was not any single line of dialogue, but the way each carefully crafted scene wove sorrow and hope into an unforgettable whole. （应用文·观后感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What 引导主语从句强调 + not...but 对比结构 + 'wove...into' 隐喻 + 三音节形容词(unforgettable)收尾

classPractice.question: 选 scene / scenery / sight：From the mountaintop, a breathtaking ____ of golden fields unfolded before us.
classPractice.note: scene 可数，指眼前一幅完整画面；scenery 不可数不能加 a

classPractice.question: While the singer took the applause, dozens of workers toiled ____ ____ ____ to make the show perfect.
classPractice.note: behind the scenes 在幕后（scene 用复数）

classPractice.question: 她没有当众大吵大闹，而是默默走开了。Rather than ____ ____ ____, she quietly walked away.
classPractice.note: make a scene 当众吵闹、大吵大闹

sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: The living room of a flat.
readingExamples: The living room of a flat.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (British English) a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a larger building; an apartment
(2) adj. smooth and level, without curves, bumps, or slopes
(3) adj. (of a tyre or ball) having lost air; (of a drink) having lost its bubbles; (of a battery) having lost its power
(4) adj. (of a voice, colour, or feeling) dull, lacking energy, interest, or emotion

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（英式）公寓（一层住宅；美式作 apartment）
uncommonMeanings.example: The living room of a flat. 一套公寓的客厅。（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②平坦的，平的，扁的（无凸起或斜坡）
uncommonMeanings.example: The desert stretched flat and endless before us. 沙漠在我们面前平坦无际地延展。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（轮胎）瘪了的，没气的；（饮料）走了气的
uncommonMeanings.example: Halfway up the mountain road, a flat tyre brought the car to a halt. （读后续写·困境·转折）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④（语气、情绪）平淡的，无精打采的
uncommonMeanings.example: Her voice was flat and lifeless as she read out the results. （读后续写·情绪·低落）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤断然地，直截了当地（turn sb. down flat）；恰好（two minutes flat）
uncommonMeanings.example: When he asked for a second chance, she turned him down flat. （读后续写·决绝·转折）

posExamples.sentence: The curtain rises on the living room of a small flat, where a single lamp casts long shadows across walls covered with faded family photographs. （读后续写·戏剧·舞台描写）
The desert stretched flat and endless before us, and for a moment I wondered whether we would ever see the edge of it. （读后续写·探险·环境）
I am writing to inform all residents that repairs to the water pipes in our flat block will begin next Monday and may cause a brief interruption to the supply. （应用文·通知）
A society that values only material wealth risks becoming as flat and colourless as a picture drawn in a single shade of grey. （议论文·价值观·比喻论证）

wordForms.other: 构词法·flat 家族：flat + -en→flatten(使平坦) + -ness→flatness + -mate→flatmate(合租室友)。易错：flat 作副词有两形——flat(平放/断然/恰好) 与 flatly(断然拒绝 refuse flatly)。英式公寓 flat / 美式 apartment；a block of flats 一栋公寓楼。

idioms.translation: （笑话、计划）失败，未产生预期效果
idioms.example: His carefully rehearsed joke fell flat, and the awkward silence made his cheeks burn. （读后续写·尴尬·校园）
For three straight weeks the volunteers worked flat out, and finally brought the old library back to life. （读后续写·奋斗·团队）
The shy new boy solved the puzzle in two minutes flat. （读后续写·反转·惊喜）

collocations.phrase: rent a flat / a block of flats
collocations.translation: 【课件】租一套公寓／一幢公寓楼（n. 公寓 = apartment）
collocations.example: The living room of a flat. 一套公寓的客厅。（课文原句）They live in a block of flats near the park. 他们住在公园附近的一幢公寓楼里。（课件原句 rent a flat 租住公寓 / a block of flats 一幢公寓楼）

collocations.translation: 【课件】像煎饼一样平（= completely flat 极其平坦；adj. 平坦的）
collocations.example: The land here is as flat as a pancake. 这里的地极其平坦。（课件习语原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】瘪了的轮胎，没气的轮胎（adj. 瘪了的）
collocations.example: Halfway up the mountain road, a flat tyre brought the car to a halt. 上山路上，一只瘪胎让车停了下来。（课件义项③）

collocations.phrase: the living room of a flat
collocations.translation: 一套公寓的客厅（英式公寓，课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The living room of a flat. 一套公寓的客厅。（课文原句）
After graduation, the three friends decided to share a tiny flat. 毕业后，三个朋友决定合租一套小公寓。
From the top of the block of flats, the whole city lay spread out beneath us. （读后续写·环境·景色）
A flat tyre on a deserted road turned our joyful trip into a test of patience. （读后续写·困境·成长）
His carefully rehearsed joke fell flat, and the classroom went awkwardly silent. （读后续写·尴尬·校园）
Exhausted, she lay flat on the cool grass and watched the clouds drift by. （读后续写·放松·景物）
In a flat, defeated voice he admitted that he had failed. （读后续写·失意·情绪）
The runners went flat out over the final hundred metres. （读后续写·比赛·冲刺）
The scouts pitched their tents on a stretch of flat and level ground beside the murmuring stream. （读后续写·露营）

synonyms.example: The family moved into a bright new apartment overlooking the river. 这家人搬进了一套明亮的、俯瞰河景的新公寓。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：apartment 是美式英语，flat 是英式英语，二者意义相同；教材语境和英式写作用 flat 更地道，常搭 a block of flats / a flat block。

synonyms.example: The workers made sure the foundation was perfectly level. 工人们确保地基完全水平。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：level 强调水平、高低一致（无高差）；flat 强调表面平整、无凸起或斜坡，二者常可换用但侧重略不同。

synonyms.example: The path grew even and smooth as it left the hillside. 小路离开山坡后变得平坦光滑。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：even 强调平整、均匀、无起伏；flat 更强调没有斜度、完全水平，描述地面、平原时二者接近。

advancedExpressions.expression: fall flat / flat out / a flat tyre / lie flat / turn sb down flat / a block of flats
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举：fall flat 失败；flat out 全力以赴；a flat tyre 瘪胎；lie flat 平躺/躺平；turn sb down flat 断然拒绝；a block of flats 公寓楼。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表示'平坦的'，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: flat = level = even = smooth
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举可替换（描述地面'平坦'）：flat / level / even / smooth，四者都可修饰 ground/surface，侧重略不同（flat 无斜坡，level 无高差，even/smooth 无起伏）。

advancedExpressions.expression: a flat ... left sb. stranded ...
advancedExpressions.example: A flat tyre left us stranded on a lonely stretch of road, with dusk falling and not a single house in sight. （用小意外触发续写转折，制造张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... would be as flat and colourless as ...
advancedExpressions.example: A life without dreams would be as flat and colourless as a stage with no lights, no music, and no applause. （明喻+三项排比强化空洞感）

advancedExpressions.expression: residents of the flats are kindly asked to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Residents of the flats are kindly asked to keep the corridors clear so that everyone can move about safely in an emergency. （通知中礼貌提出要求）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We had a flat tyre and were stuck on the road.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: No sooner had we set off in high spirits than a flat tyre brought the car to a jolting halt, stranding us on a deserted road as the last light drained from the sky. （读后续写·转折+环境烘托）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: No sooner...than 部分倒装制造突变 + 'jolting halt' 拟声细节 + 'the last light drained from the sky' 拟人化环境暗示危机

sentenceUpgrade.original: The living room of the flat was small and quiet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The living room of the tiny flat lay silent and still, a single flickering lamp throwing restless shadows across walls that seemed to hold a lifetime of unspoken memories. （读后续写·戏剧舞台描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 形容词前置(silent and still) + 独立主格(a lamp throwing shadows) + 'walls that seemed to hold memories' 拟人化定语从句渲染氛围

classPractice.question: 选 flat / apartment（英式语境）：The curtain rises on the living room of a small ____.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文；英式英语公寓用 flat，美式才用 apartment

classPractice.question: His carefully rehearsed joke ____ ____, and an awkward silence filled the room.
classPractice.note: fall flat （笑话、计划）失败；fall 过去式 fell

classPractice.question: A ____ tyre on the deserted road left us stranded as darkness closed in.
classPractice.note: a flat tyre 瘪胎；flat 作形容词'没气的'

sub_section: C 短剧示例与表演
original_sentence: He waits for a response but doesn't get one.
readingExamples: He waits for a response but doesn't get one.
definitionEn:
(1) n. something that is said, written, or done as a reaction or reply to something else
(2) n. a reaction to something that has happened or been said, especially a feeling or the way people behave
(3) n. an answer or reply, especially a formal one, to a question, letter, or request
(4) n. a physical reaction of the body to a stimulus, such as a drug or a change in conditions

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①回应，答复（尤指对信件、请求的正式答复）
uncommonMeanings.example: He waits for a response but doesn't get one. 他等着回应，却没得到。（课文原句词块）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②反应，反响（对事件、言论的反应或大众反响）
uncommonMeanings.example: The overwhelming public response proved kindness still runs deep. 热烈的公众反响证明善意仍深植人心。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（身体、生理的）反应，应答（医学）
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor watched anxiously for any response to the new medicine. （读后续写·医院·希望）

posExamples.sentence: He knocked again and waited for a response, but the house stayed dark and silent, as though it were holding some secret it refused to share. （读后续写·悬念·环境）
I am writing in response to your advertisement for volunteers, as I firmly believe my experience and enthusiasm make me a suitable candidate for the position. （应用文·申请信）
The overwhelming public response to the charity appeal proved, beyond all doubt, that kindness still runs deep in the heart of our community. （议论文·社会·论证）
Her only response to the cruel remark was a calm, forgiving smile, and somehow that silence spoke louder than any furious words could have. （读后续写·人物·气度）

wordForms.adjective: responsive (adj. 反应敏捷的，积极响应的)
wordForms.other: 构词法·respond 家族：respond(v.回应) → response(n.回应) → responsive(adj.反应敏捷的) → responsiveness / responsively。搭配区别：动词 respond to sth；名词 in response to sth。易错：respond 与 response 拼写不同(d/se)，勿混。

idioms.example: In response to the growing plastic crisis, our school launched a campaign that turned bottles into flower pots. （议论文·环保·响应行动）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……未作答复（n. a spoken or written answer 答复）
collocations.example: She made no response to your enquiry. 她没有回复你的询问。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】作为对……的反应／响应（n. a reaction 反应，响应）
collocations.example: The product was developed in response to customer demand. 这种产品是为了满足顾客的需要而开发的。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】回复率，回收率（回复的人数比例）
collocations.example: We sent out over 1,000 questionnaires but the response rate has been low. 我们发出了一千多份问卷，但回收得很少。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】某人的第一反应，即时反应
collocations.example: When emergencies occur, his immediate response is to keep himself safe. 出现紧急情况时，他的第一反应是保证自身安全。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 等待回应（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He waits for a response but doesn't get one. 他等着回应，却没有得到。（课文原句）
In response to the growing plastic crisis, our school launched a campaign. 为响应日益严重的塑料危机，学校发起了一项活动。
She waited, hardly breathing, for him to make some response. （读后续写·对峙·心理）
The positive response from the audience gave the young speaker courage. （读后续写·演讲·成长）
The lifeguard's immediate response saved the drowning child. （读后续写·救援·英雄）
The book fair received an overwhelming response, with students queuing round the block. （应用文·活动报道）
I look forward to receiving a favourable response at your earliest convenience. （应用文·求职信结尾）
The film provoked such a strong emotional response that half the cinema was in tears. （议论文·艺术·感染力）
In response, he simply extended a helping hand, and that quiet gesture healed a friendship that words had failed to mend. （读后续写·和解·细节）

synonyms.example: She sent a warm reply the very next morning. 第二天一早她就回了一封热情的信。
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：reply 多指口头或书面的直接答复（reply to a letter/question）；response 语义更广，既可指答复，也可指反应、反响或生理反应，更正式。

synonyms.example: His first reaction to the news was one of stunned disbelief. 他对这消息的第一反应是震惊得难以置信。
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：reaction 强调不由自主、即时的生理或情绪反应；response 常带有'经过考虑后作出'的意味，更主动、正式。

synonyms.example: The student gave a clear and confident answer. 那名学生给出了清晰而自信的回答。
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：answer 侧重对问题的直接回答（an answer to a question）；response 可指对更广泛情境（请求、事件、刺激）的回应，正式度更高。

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to / make a response / await a response / a positive response
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举：in response to sth 回应/响应；make/give a response 作出回应；await/receive a response 等待/收到回复；a positive/prompt/overwhelming response 积极/迅速/热烈的反响。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能（表示'回应/反应'，可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: response = reply = reaction = answer
advancedExpressions.example: 枚举可替换（表'回应'）：response(最正式最宽泛) / reply(直接答复) / reaction(即时本能反应) / answer(对问题的回答)——正式度与侧重递减。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·respond vs response 搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: respond to sth (v.) ↔ in response to sth (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: 对照记忆：动词 respond to the letter（回复信件）；名词 in response to the letter（作为对信件的回应）——同一个意思，动词/名词句法不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing in response to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing in response to the notice recruiting student guides for the coming English festival, and I would be honoured to contribute. （申请信开门见山点明来意）

advancedExpressions.expression: the overwhelming response to ... is telling proof that ...
advancedExpressions.example: The overwhelming response to the volunteer campaign is telling proof that young people today are far from indifferent to the world around them. （用反响作为论据反驳偏见）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s only response was ..., which spoke louder than ...
advancedExpressions.example: His only response was a gentle nod, which spoke louder than a thousand hurried apologies ever could. （以微小动作代替言语，含蓄有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He waited for a response but got none.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He knocked once more and stood waiting, straining his ears for the faintest response, but only the hollow echo of his own heartbeat answered him in the deepening silence. （读后续写·悬念+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 'straining his ears' 动作细节 + 'the faintest response' 弱化对比 + 'the hollow echo of his own heartbeat' 以声写静的隐喻 + 'deepening silence' 环境递进

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people responded to our activity.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The enthusiastic response our activity received far exceeded our expectations, and it dawned on us that a small idea, once shared with sincerity, can move an entire community to act. （应用文·活动总结）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 主语后置强调 response + far exceeded 程度提升 + 'it dawned on us that' 顿悟结构 + 'once shared with sincerity' 省略状语点明道理

classPractice.question: 应观众的强烈要求，这部戏将会在这个剧院每周上演两次。____ ____ ____ the audience's great demand, the play will be ____ ____ in this theatre twice a week.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；in response to sth 应……的要求／作为对……的回应；put on (a play) 上演（剧目）

classPractice.question: He knocked again and waited for a ____ (respond), but the house stayed dark and silent.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句；此处需名词 response，动词 respond 的名词形式

classPractice.question: ____ ____ ____ the growing plastic crisis, our school launched a recycling campaign.
classPractice.note: in response to sth 作为对……的回应/响应

classPractice.question: 改写：Many students responded to our activity. → Our activity received an enthusiastic ____ from many students.
classPractice.note: 动词 respond 转名词 response；respond to → receive a response from
